title: Website Manager (CRO / E-commerce)
description:
Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

- Lead performance and optimization of e\-commerce websites across multiple regions

- Localize website content, product pages, pricing, promotions, and customer journeys

- Monitor website performance and customer behavior using GA4, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and similar tools

- Plan and execute A/B tests to improve landing pages, product pages, cart, and checkout conversion

- Optimize UX/UI, reduce cart abandonment, and improve website conversion rates

- Manage regional merchandising, inventory visibility, and seasonal launches

- Track website sales KPIs and provide actionable performance insights

- Collaborate with Marketing, Design, Product, Development, and Supply Chain teams to deliver seamless digital experiences

- Location: NIBM, Pune

- This is a new hire position

- Role involves leading website performance optimization and international market expansion initiatives

- Focus on data\-driven optimization and continuous improvement of website conversions

 Requirements
   

  

  

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

* Strong E\-commerce Website Manager Profile with CRO and digital\-analytics expertise

* Mandatory (Experience 2\): Must have hands\-on CRO experience — monitoring visitor behaviour, traffic, and conversion, and systematically improving it, including planning/running A/B tests on landing, product, cart, and checkout pages and reducing cart abandonment.

* Preferred (Experience): International SEO, website localization, and cross\-border e\-commerce.



 Experience: 3–5 years · Work from office · 6 days a week · Notice period up to 30 days

title: Digital Community & Customer Engagement Specialist
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.
   

  

**The Role**
 Digital Customer Success provides structured, scalable Customer Success engagement for customers outside dedicated one\-to\-one coverage. The function combines customer intelligence, proactive risk identification, digital engagement and cross\-functional coordination to help customers realise value and enable account teams to take timely, informed action.
   

  

 You will own the community and digital\-engagement workstream, combining online community operations, structured customer outreach, content governance, customer\-feedback enablement and engagement measurement. The role requires strong operational ownership, editorial judgement and disciplined stakeholder coordination.
   

  

**Your Impact**
**Community platform ownership:** 
 Administer online customer community spaces, roles, permissions, onboarding, approvals, notifications, moderation and analytics.
   

  

**Community operations:** 
 Run operating cadences across multiple product communities and support new community launches.
   

  

* Content planning and publishing: Maintain content calendars and coordinate the sourcing, review, scheduling and publishing of value\-led posts, polls, events, release information and webinar content.


**Stakeholder governance:** 
 Own recurring coordination with product and marketing stakeholders, including agendas, action tracking, approval routes and community roadmaps.
   

  

**Customer outreach:** 
 Execute structured customer introduction, invitation, re\-engagement and information campaigns using validated contacts and account\-owner alignment.
   

  

**VOC and NPS enablement:** 
 Coordinate pre\-survey awareness, recipient alignment and follow\-up inputs supporting customer\-feedback programmes.
   

  

**Campaign operations:** 
 Manage shared mailboxes, communication templates, audience logic, response ownership and applicable opt\-out or marketability controls.
   

  

**Community growth and advocacy:** 
 Increase qualified membership and participation and identify appropriate customer stories, testimonials and advocacy opportunities.
   

  

**Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Partner with account teams, Solution Consultants, Product Management, Product Marketing, IT and platform partners to remove dependencies.
   

  

**Measurement and continuity:** 
 Track membership, reach, publishing cadence, engagement and outreach response; maintain SOPs, access records and repositories.
   

  

 What You'll Need
   

  

**Experience:** 
 3–6 years in community management, digital customer engagement, customer marketing, Customer Success or comparable work.
   

  

**Education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Engineering or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
   

  

**Platform capability:** 
 Hands\-on experience administering an online community or digital engagement platform.
   

  

**Content and communication:** 
 Strong professional writing, content curation and editorial judgement across posts, events, newsletters and customer communications.
   

  

**Campaign execution:** 
 Experience with structured email outreach, audience segmentation and basic communication\-compliance concepts.
   

  

**Stakeholder management:** 
 Ability to manage multiple stakeholder groups, approval flows, calendars and commitments with disciplined follow\-through.
   

  

**Measurement:** 
 Ability to track and explain community or outreach performance using practical engagement metrics.
   

  

**Operating discipline:** 
 Strong organisation across trackers, minutes, action logs, content calendars and document repositories.
   

  

**Preferred / Nice To Have**
**Community platforms:** 
 Experience with Mighty Networks, Higher Logic, Khoros or a comparable platform.
   

  

**Customer feedback:** 
 Experience supporting VOC, NPS or broader customer\-experience programmes.
   

  

**Growth programmes:** 
 Exposure to community analytics, advocacy, customer stories, event or webinar promotion.
   

  

**Business systems:** 
 Familiarity with CRM or a Customer Success platform and B2B enterprise software.
   

  

**Creative judgement:** 
 Basic design awareness for banners, landing pages and social\-style content assets.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

**Operational consistency:** 
 Communities have clear operating cadences, active calendars, timely approvals and accurate access management.
   

  

**Engagement quality:** 
 Customer outreach is aligned, measurable and professionally executed.
   

  

**Stakeholder confidence:** 
 Commitments, actions and dependencies are visible and actively managed.
   

  

**Continuity:** 
 Roadmaps, access records, working files and SOPs remain current and transferable, avoiding single\-person dependency.
   

  

 How This Role Works
   

  

 This role supports customers and internal stakeholders across multiple regions and requires effective collaboration in a globally distributed environment. The role enables account teams with structured insights or scaled engagement and does not replace commercial account ownership.

**Associate Director\- Growth**

 The client is is an AI\-first commercial management company for hotels and hotel operators in the US. They help clients grow revenue through a unified, tech\-led solution and service. They are a rapidly growing startup, 230\+ members strong, funded by top investors, and already profitable with several million USD in revenue.

 In this role you will own the entire revenue pipeline — from generating new hotel client leads across all channels to retaining and expanding our existing client base. You will also lead the lead generation and customer success teams. This is a high ownership, senior role.

* Lead Generation \- Own and optimize lead generation across email campaigns, Meta ads, cold calling, and expansion and referrals from the existing client base.

* Team Leadership \- Set clear goals, run regular reviews, and build a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.
* Strategy and Execution \- Use data across the funnel to identify opportunities and drive decisions — on lead quality, conversion, retention, and expansion.
* Cross Functional Collaboration \- Partner with product and tech teams on tools and automation that can improve the growth engine.

* Strong track record in multi\-channel outbound — email, ads, cold calling — and building lead generation engines from the ground up.

* You thrive in fast\-moving environments and take ownership without waiting to be directed.
* Prior experience building and executing GTM strategies for the US market is a strong advantage.

title: Experience and Content Associate
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ecoville is an art farm in the Pune District that brings together nature, creativity, and community in an urban setting. The Farm Ecoville curates immersive, art\- and nature\-centric experiences for diverse age groups, encouraging visitors to explore and learn. Guided by principles of sustainability, all activities are organic, mindful, and aligned with conscious living. The space is designed to help people slow down, reconnect with the natural environment, and adopt a more intentional lifestyle. Visits are offered by prior reservation to maintain a thoughtful, curated experience for guests.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Experience and Content Associate is a full\-time, on\-site role based at The Farm Ecoville in Pune District. The associate will help design, coordinate, and host immersive experiences, including workshops, events, and guided activities that reflect Ecoville’s focus on art, nature, and mindful living. Daily responsibilities include engaging with visitors, answering queries, collecting feedback, and ensuring a welcoming, well\-organized environment. The role also involves creating and managing content for digital platforms and on\-site communication materials, including writing web content, social media posts, and informational guides that accurately represent Ecoville’s offerings and values. The associate will collaborate with the core team to plan upcoming experiences, conduct research on relevant topics, and support administrative tasks related to reservations and event logistics.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong Communication skills, including the ability to engage with visitors of different age groups and backgrounds.
* Writing and Web Content Writing skills to create clear, engaging, and accurate content for digital and print materials.
* Content Management skills to organize, update, and maintain online platforms and experience\-related information.
* Research skills to develop thoughtful program ideas, understand audience needs, and stay informed about sustainability and mindful living practices.
* Interest in or experience with art, nature\-based experiences, and sustainable living.
* Ability to work on\-site full time, including occasional weekends or special events as needed.
* Strong organizational skills, reliability, and comfort working in a dynamic, outdoor\-oriented environment.
* Relevant education or experience in communications, hospitality, arts, environmental studies, or related fields is beneficial.
* Pune Based Candidates Only
* Fresher Can apply

**About The Job**
 We are seeking a Performance Architect – QA to join our R\&D team as a senior individual contributor. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on performance engineering expert with a deep architectural pedigree in core products, platforms, or large\-scale enterprise software. You will shape our overarching performance strategy and partner closely with Product Engineering, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, and R\&D teams to deliver highly scalable, resilient, and low\-latency products.
   

  

 In this role, you will own the performance engineering domain from an architectural perspective—driving strategies that build performance into the core system design. While performance remains your primary focus, you will also bring critical insights into end\-to\-end, system\-level Quality Assurance. By bridging the gap between functional automation and non\-functional engineering, you will ensure a holistic approach to system reliability, helping elevate our entire QA framework. This role involves technical ownership and cross\-functional influence, with no people\-management responsibilities.
   

  

**About You**
* Experience: 15\+ years in QA, software/performance engineering, and automation, with 10\+ years of hands\-on SaaS experience. Mandatory background in a Core Product or R\&D organization.
* Architecture \& Systems: Expertise in distributed systems, microservices, cloud\-native patterns, multi\-tenant platforms, and load balancing (e.g., Istio service mesh).
* Performance \& Reliability: Experience establishing data\-driven SLOs/SLIs and error budgets. Proven ability to lead chaos engineering initiatives (fault injection, failovers) and capacity planning using real\-time SRE/APM telemetry.
* Testing \& Tooling: Expert in performance testing frameworks (K6, JMeter, Gatling, or custom simulators) and stateful/protocol\-level fuzzing (HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket). Advanced proficiency in functional automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium).
* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Hands\-on with Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes (AKS preferred) for autoscaling and high availability.
* Development \& CI/CD: Strong programming skills in Java, Python, C\#, or Go. Seamless integration of continuous verification into CI/CD pipelines.
* Observability: Mastery of APM tools, distributed tracing, database tuning, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.


**Why Join \& Who Should Apply**
 This is a high\-impact role focused heavily on technical depth, engineering judgment, and cross\-functional mentorship. You are a strong fit if you:
   

  

* Have scaled complex, distributed products in an R\&D environment and deeply understand the entire product lifecycle.
* Can authoritatively influence architectural decisions using data\-driven performance insights.
* Possess a big\-picture vision for end\-to\-end QA, optimizing both functional boundaries and non\-functional baselines.
* Can perfectly balance hands\-on coding, debugging, and production analysis with strategic architecture ownership.

 We are seeking an experienced Senior Linux \& AWS Administrator to lead the administration, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise infrastructure across hybrid cloud environments. This role is responsible for ensuring high availability, security, scalability, and operational excellence across cloud and on\-premises platforms while supporting critical business applications and infrastructure services.

* **Experience: 6 to 9 Years**

* Administer, maintain, and support enterprise Linux server environments including RHEL, Ubuntu, and CentOS.
* Design, deploy, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure services including EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, FSx, Route 53, and related services.
* Implement and manage hybrid cloud connectivity between on\-premises data centers and AWS environments using VPN and Direct Connect solutions.
* Perform infrastructure capacity planning, resource optimization, and performance tuning activities.
* Monitor server, storage, and cloud infrastructure health to ensure high availability and operational stability.

title: NPD & VAVE Mechanical Engineer
description:
Job Title: NPD \& VAVE Mechanical Engineer
 



 Job Type: Full\-Time
 



 Duration: Long Term
 



 Work Preference: Onsite
 



 Experience: 7\-10 years
 



 Work Location: Pune, MH
 



  





 We are seeking a hands\-on NPD \& VAVE Mechanical Engineer, with 7\-10 years of experience, to develop new products and implement value\-engineering, redesign, and lifecycle improvements across fire suppression and nitrogen\-generation products. The role combines mechanical system engineering for compressors, pneumatic and pressure circuits, tanks, membranes, filters, regulators, valves, tubing, and manifolds with detailed product design for sheet\-metal enclosures, skids, brackets, mounting, vibration isolation, service access, and product integration. The candidate must be able to translate requirements into concepts, calculations, SolidWorks models, production drawings, BOMs, prototypes, verification evidence, and controlled engineering releases. Demonstrated hands\-on contribution to both NPD and implemented VAVE or cost\-reduction programs is required; this is not a teardown\-only, costing\-only, or CAD\-documentation\-only role.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Value Engineering \& Cost\-Down Execution** 




 • Perform product teardown, functional decomposition, BOM/material analysis, benchmarking, and function\-cost assessment, translate findings into NPD requirements and redesign opportunities.
 



 • Identify opportunities for part\-count reduction, common components, alternate materials, simplified interfaces, target\-cost achievement, platform reuse, and model\-variant rationalization.
 



 • Develop VAVE and NPD concepts into complete mechanical designs, calculations, CAD models, prototypes, cost estimates, BOM and drawing updates, and release\-ready engineering changes.
 



 • Ensure that new and redesigned products improve total value without compromising safety, performance, reliability, serviceability, installation, manufacturability, or compliance.
 



**Pneumatic, Compressor \& Pressure\-System Engineering** 




 • Translate product requirements into pneumatic and mechanical architectures and analyse compressor packages, air and nitrogen flow paths, membrane interfaces, water separators, filters,
 



 regulators, back\-pressure regulators, solenoid valves, check valves, relief valves, gauges, pressure switches, drains, and unloaders.
 



 • Design and optimize tubing, hoses, NPT or equivalent fittings, manifolds, seals, receiver tanks, storage tanks, and Air Maintenance Device interfaces for new and existing products.
 



 • Perform engineering calculations for flow, pressure drop, fill time, compressor duty cycle, leakage, loads, forces, thermal effects, vibration, structural integrity, and safety margins as applicable.
 



 • Select and technically qualify compressors, valves, regulators, filters, fittings, tanks, and other mechanical or electromechanical components for NPD, redesign, and VAVE programs.
 



**Mechanical Product Design, Packaging \& DFMA** 




 • Develop and optimize sheet\-metal cabinets, doors, frames, brackets, compressor and tank mounts, vibration isolators, guards, handles, and service\-access features for new products.
 



 • Create SolidWorks 3D parts and assemblies, layouts, detailed drawings, GD\&T, tolerance stacks, material specifications, finish requirements, critical characteristics, and mechanical BOMs.
 



 • Apply DFM and DFA from concept stage through release to reduce fabrication steps, welding, machining, fasteners, assembly time, handling, tooling, inspection, rework, and installation effort.
 



 • Drive modularity and standardize cabinet, skid, bracket, mounting, fitting, fastener, and tank accessory architectures across representative product platforms.
 



 • Own prototype fabrication, fitment checks, assembly trials, design reviews, root\-cause analysis, design iterations, corrective actions, and engineering\-release updates.
 



**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Implementation** 




 • Own mechanical work packages on NPD, redesign, sustenance, and VAVE programs while working closely with the Senior Engineer, Electrical, Firmware, Validation, lab, and US stakeholders.
 



 • Define interfaces among compressor and motor packages, control panels, sensors, solenoid valves, controller enclosures, wiring, tanks, tubing, installation hardware, and field connections.
 



 • Release requirements, CAD models, drawings, BOMs, specifications, assembly requirements, test criteria, and ECO/ECN documentation through controlled PDM/PLM processes.
 



 • Provide technical support to US Supply Chain for supplier reviews, RFQs, component and process qualification, tooling, production trials, new\-product launch, and VAVE implementation.
 



**Quantitative Analysis \& Business\-Case Development** 




 • Build target\-cost and fact\-based cost breakdowns covering material, fabrication, machining, welding, coating, purchased components, tooling, assembly labor, test, packaging, installation, warranty, and lifecycle impact.
 



 • Prepare concept and design trade\-offs, feasibility assessments, target\-cost analysis, ROI, payback, implementation effort, and risk inputs for NPD architecture and VAVE decisions.
 



 • Track NPD product cost against target and projected versus implemented VAVE savings, and support validation of recurring benefits with US Finance and Supply Chain.
 



**Validation, Compliance \& Risk Management** 




 • Prepare mechanical and pneumatic requirements, DFMEA, design reviews, verification plans, tolerance analyses, and risk assessments for new and modified designs.
 



 • Plan and support DVP\&R covering dimensional and functional performance, pressure and leak integrity, flow, nitrogen purity, fill time, compressor duty cycle, temperature, vibration, acoustics, endurance, transport, installation, and serviceability.
 



 • Assess impact on applicable UL, FM, NFPA, IEC, pressure\-system, pressure\-vessel, and regional tank\-certification requirements and provide technical evidence to the Compliance team.
 



**Sustenance \& Lifecycle Optimization** 




 • Use field\-return, warranty, service, production, and maintenance data to identify reliability, costof\-quality, serviceability, and next\-generation product improvements.
 



 • Resolve component obsolescence, availability, quality, and supplier\-process risks through technically validated alternatives and design changes.
 



 • Create reusable mechanical standards, preferred component and material strategies, common CAD models and drawings, design guidelines, test methods, VAVE practices, and lessons learned.
 



  





**Qualifications** 




 • 7\-10 years of mechanical product\-design experience with demonstrated hands\-on responsibility in both NPD and VAVE or cost\-reduction programs for industrial or electromechanical products.
 



 • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.
 



 • Demonstrated end\-to\-end contribution from requirements and concept development through detailed CAD design, prototype, verification, drawing/BOM release, and production support,
 



 including implementation of measurable mechanical cost reductions.
 



 • Practical experience with compressors, pneumatic systems, pressure vessels, valves, regulators, filters, tubing, fittings, manifolds, seals, and related electromechanical components.
 



 • Strong experience in sheet\-metal product design, skids, enclosures, brackets, mounts, vibration isolation, material selection, GD\&T, tolerance analysis, and industrial equipment packaging.
 



 • Strong hands\-on proficiency in SolidWorks for 3D part and assembly modelling, configurations, sheet metal, routing, and detailed manufacturing drawings, with ownership of mechanical BOMs.
 



 • Strong working knowledge of the NPD lifecycle and VAVE methods, including requirements, architecture, product teardown, FAST or function analysis, benchmarking, design\-to\-cost, should
 



 costing, material and process substitution, commonization, and platform strategy.
 



 • Practical knowledge of DFM, DFA, DFMEA, DVP\&R, root\-cause analysis, tolerance stacks, supplier process capability, PDM/PLM, configuration control, and engineering change release.
 



 • Ability to evaluate target cost and material, tooling, fabrication, assembly, test, packaging, installation, maintenance, warranty, service, and lifecycle cost impacts.
 



 • Strong hands\-on capability with physical teardown, prototypes, measurement, fitment, assembly trials, laboratory test setups, failure analysis, design troubleshooting, and corrective action.
 



 • Ownership mindset and willingness to develop deep product knowledge of the assigned suppression and nitrogen\-generator platforms and contribute to both NPD and VAVE roadmaps.
 



 • Willingness to travel periodically to locations, suppliers, manufacturing sites, and test laboratories as required.
 



  





**Core Competencies** 




 • Ownership Mindset \| Product Development \| Mechanical Systems Thinking \| Design\-for\-Cost \| DFM/DFA \| Technical Rigor \| Hands\-on Execution \| Reliability \| Collaboration

title: Process Design Engineer / Senior Process Design Engineer
description:
Role – Process Design Engineer / Senior Process Design Engineer
 



 Industry: Water \& Wastewater Treatment
 



 Department: Engineering / Process Design
 



 Location: Pune
 



 Reporting To: Head – Engineering / Process Design Manager
 



  





 About the Company
 



 We are a leading multinational organization working in water treatment, wastewater management, sanitation, and sustainable infrastructure solutions.
 



 The company delivers engineering solutions for municipal, industrial, and commercial water and wastewater projects across different markets.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a Process Design Engineer / Senior Process Design Engineer who has experience in designing and developing treatment processes for Water Treatment Plants (WTP), Sewage Treatment Plants (STP), Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP), and Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) systems.
 



 The candidate will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, selecting suitable treatment technologies, developing process designs, and preparing engineering documents for water and wastewater treatment projects.
 



 You will work closely with Process, Mechanical, Piping, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, Project, and Site teams to ensure the process design is technically correct and meets project requirements.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**1\. Process Design \& Engineering** 



* Develop process designs for:
* Water Treatment Plants (WTP)
* Sewage Treatment Plants (STP)
* Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP)
* Zero Liquid Discharge (ZLD) Systems
* Understand client requirements and project specifications.
* Study raw water and wastewater characteristics and determine the appropriate treatment process.
* Understand treated\-water quality requirements and applicable discharge standards.
* Select suitable water/wastewater treatment technologies based on project requirements.
* Develop complete process treatment schemes for projects.



**2\. Engineering Drawings \& Documents** 




 Prepare and review important process engineering documents such as:
 


* Process Flow Diagrams (PFD)
* Process \& Instrumentation Diagrams (P\&ID)
* Process design calculations
* Equipment sizing calculations
* Hydraulic calculations
* Equipment and instrument datasheets
* Process design basis
* Technical specifications
* Equipment/process schedules
* Water and chemical balance
* Process descriptions and narratives



**3\. Process Calculations \& Equipment Sizing** 



* Perform process calculations for various treatment units.
* Carry out sizing of tanks, clarifiers, filters, biological treatment systems, pumps, pipelines, membranes, and other process equipment.
* Prepare and review hydraulic calculations and mass balance.
* Ensure equipment selection and sizing meet the required treatment capacity and performance.



**4\. Treatment Technology Selection** 



* Evaluate and select suitable treatment technologies based on:
* Raw water/wastewater characteristics
* Required treated\-water quality
* Plant capacity
* Client requirements
* Applicable environmental/discharge standards
* Work with technologies such as physical, chemical, biological, membrane, and advanced treatment processes.
* Experience with RO, UF, MBR, ETP, STP, WTP, ZLD, MEE, or similar technologies will be an advantage.



**5\. Coordination with Engineering \& Project Teams** 



* Coordinate with Mechanical, Piping, Electrical, Instrumentation, Civil, Procurement, and Project teams.
* Provide process inputs required for detailed engineering and equipment selection.
* Review vendor technical documents and ensure compliance with process requirements.
* Support project teams during installation, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting when required.



**6\. Client \& Project Support** 



* Understand client technical requirements and provide suitable process solutions.
* Participate in technical discussions with clients, consultants, and vendors.
* Support preparation of technical proposals and project documentation when required.
* Resolve process\-related technical queries during project execution.
* Ensure designs comply with project specifications, applicable codes, safety requirements, and company engineering standards.



 Candidate Requirements
 



 We are looking for candidates with:
 


* Experience in Process Design / Process Engineering in the Water \& Wastewater Treatment industry.
* Hands\-on experience in WTP, STP, ETP, ZLD, or industrial wastewater projects.
* Good understanding of water and wastewater treatment processes.
* Experience preparing and reviewing PFDs and P\&IDs.
* Knowledge of process calculations, hydraulic calculations, mass balance, and equipment sizing.
* Understanding of treatment technologies and process equipment.
* Ability to read and understand engineering drawings, datasheets, specifications, and technical documents.
* Good coordination skills with multidisciplinary engineering and project teams.
* Good technical communication and problem\-solving skills.



 Preferred Technical Experience
 



 Candidates with experience in the following areas will be preferred:
 



 WTP \| STP \| ETP \| ZLD \| RO \| UF \| MBR \| MEE \| Water Treatment \| Wastewater Treatment \| Process Design \| PFD \| P\&ID \| Hydraulic Calculation \| Mass Balance \| Equipment Sizing
 



 Who Should Apply?
 



 This role is suitable for candidates currently working as:
 


* Process Design Engineer
* Process Engineer – Water Treatment
* Water Treatment Design Engineer
* Wastewater Process Engineer
* Process Design Engineer – WTP/ETP/STP
* Senior Process Design Engineer

title: Escalation Manager
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
 QAD Inc. is a leading provider of adaptive, cloud\-based enterprise software and services for global manufacturing companies. Global manufacturers face ever\-increasing disruption caused by technology\-driven innovation and changing consumer preferences. In order to survive and thrive, manufacturers must be able to innovate and change business models at unprecedented rates of speed. QAD calls these companies Adaptive Manufacturing Enterprises. QAD solutions help customers in the automotive, life sciences, packaging, consumer products, food and beverage, high tech and industrial manufacturing industries rapidly adapt to change and innovate for competitive advantage. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
   

  

**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune, with 3\-4 days of in\-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
 The
 **Escalation Manager** 
 is a specialized individual contributor role within the Global Support organization, responsible for owning and managing critical customer account escalations from onset through stabilization and closure. This role acts as the single point of accountability within Support for escalated accounts, ensuring issues are addressed with urgency, structure, and cross\-functional alignment.
   

  

 The EM’s primary objective is to stabilize high\-risk customer accounts by driving the resolution of critical issues, coordinating closely with Support, Engineering, Cloud Operations, and Product teams. This includes ensuring proper prioritization of P1 and high\-impact cases, enforcing case hygiene, facilitating timely Engineering engagement, and ensuring that internal escalation paths are triggered proactively before the customer or Sales team raises concerns externally.
   

  

 This role requires strong technical depth across ERP application architecture, infrastructure, and troubleshooting. The EM must be able to understand complex technical landscapes, challenge and guide resolution strategies, and hold teams accountable for progress. While not responsible for direct implementation or relationship management, the EM acts as the technical escalation leader for the account, ensuring a coordinated and transparent support response.
   

  

**Beyond day\-to\-day escalation handling, the Escalation Manager plays a critical role in:**
* Identifying systemic or recurring issues contributing to account instability.
* Driving and participating in account\-level stabilization plans.
* Engaging in post\-escalation reviews to strengthen processes and prevent recurrence.
* Ensuring clear and structured internal and external communication.


 This is a high\-visibility role requiring composure under pressure, strong cross\-functional leadership without formal authority, and the ability to influence outcomes across multiple teams. Given the nature of escalated accounts, the position may require flexible working hours, on\-call participation, and direct executive visibility.
   

  

**Escalated Account Ownership**
* Act as the primary escalation lead for high\-impact customer accounts, ensuring structured management of escalations from initiation through stabilization and closure.
* Drive internal alignment and ensure timely execution of action plans across Support, Engineering, Cloud Ops, and Product.


**Stabilization And Resolution Strategy**
* Develop and execute account\-level stabilization plans to address critical issues, reduce ticket volumes, and restore customer confidence.
* Proactively identify systemic issues contributing to escalations and drive resolution with the right internal stakeholders.


**Escalation Governance**
* Ensure proper prioritization, case hygiene, and timely engagement of technical resources for all escalated accounts.
* Trigger and manage internal escalation paths proactively to avoid external escalations through CSM or Sales.
* Set customer expectations and provide updates regarding troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer\-facing communications.


**Technical Engagement And Resolution Acceleration**
* Leverage strong technical knowledge of ERP architecture and infrastructure to guide resolution strategies and validate progress.
* Collaborate closely with Critical Support team, Tier 2/3 engineers, SMEs, and product teams to remove technical blockers and accelerate resolution timelines.


**Cross\-Functional Coordination And Communication**
* Coordinate across Support, Engineering, Cloud Ops, Product Management, and CSM/CSDM teams to ensure alignment and accountability.
* Deliver clear, structured, and timely communications on escalation status, risks, and next steps to all stakeholders.


**Feedback Loop And Product Improvement**
* Partner with CSM/CSDMs and Product Management to share customer feedback, recurring pain points, and systemic issues observed during escalations.
* Work with Engineering teams to help prioritize critical fixes and influence product stability and supportability improvements.


**Shift Coverage And Flexibility**
* Participate in shift rotations, weekend shifts, and on\-call coverage to provide uninterrupted global support.
* Adapt to varying scheduling requirements to ensure timely assistance for customers in different time zones.


**Continuous Improvement And Post\-Escalation Review**
* Lead or contribute to post\-escalation reviews to identify root causes, process gaps, and product opportunities.
* Support implementation of preventive measures to minimize future escalations and strengthen overall support readiness.
* Collaborate with people managers and business leaders to drive continuous improvement in people, processes, and technology through a closed\-loop process by identifying drivers for escalation.


**Qualifications**
**Education:**
 A Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.
   

  

**Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in enterprise product support, technical escalation management, or critical response roles in a SaaS or ERP environment.
* Demonstrated ability to own and drive critical account escalations, ensuring cross\-functional alignment and rapid resolution.
* Proven experience in working closely with Engineering, Product Management, and Customer Success teams to resolve high\-impact technical issues.
* Strong background in ERP systems (such as QAD, SAP, Oracle ERP, or Dynamics 365\) with the ability to understand complex technical landscapes and influence resolution strategies.
* Experience coordinating multiple high\-priority issues simultaneously under pressure, with clear accountability and customer focus.
* Experience leveraging AI tools (such as generative AI assistants, diagnostic copilots, or predictive analytics platforms) to analyze incident data, perform rapid root cause analysis, and identify systemic escalation patterns across ticket histories.
* Hands\-on experience using Jira Service Management and Salesforce Service Cloud to manage critical account escalations, track ticket SLA compliance, enforce case hygiene, and link Tier\-3 engineering bugs with customer\-facing cases.
* Background operating within multi\-tenant SaaS or hybrid\-cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP), managing incident workflows involving cloud infrastructure, microservices, database performance, or server deployment issues.
* Proven track record of driving rapid war\-room coordination, real\-time stakeholder updates, and post\-incident documentation.


**Technical Skills**

* Mastery of Google Workspace (Google Docs, Sheets, Slides) for building real\-time escalation trackers, publishing root cause analysis (RCA) reports, and delivering executive\-ready presentations.
* Cloud Infrastructure \& Architecture: Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), including cloud infrastructure components, APIs, microservices, containerized environments, and log management tools (e.g., Datadog, Splunk, CloudWatch).
* Ability to understand and validate technical resolution paths proposed by Support, Engineering, or Cloud Ops teams.
* Familiarity with incident and escalation management frameworks and best practices in SaaS or on\-prem environments.
* Preferred / Bonus Qualifications: Prompt Engineering \& Generative AI Tools: Hands\-on experience utilizing Generative AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, MS Copilot, or custom internal LLMs) for prompt\-driven summary generation, ticket sentiment analysis, incident documentation, and automated stakeholder communication drafting.
* QAD PKS or relevant industry certifications are a plus.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.

 QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

title: Principal, Software Engineering
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Principal, Software Engineering
   

  

**Overview**
 In the time between when you swipe your Mastercard and you receive the approval, Authorization Decisioning has provided your transaction with more than 20 different market\-facing services—including industry leading fraud detection. Everyday Authorization Decisioning provides these same robust computational intelligence services to more than a billion transactions around the planet.
   

  

 As a Principal Software Engineer for Authorization Decisioning, you are a technical authority. You are responsible for providing a broad spectrum of technical leadership and decision making across our program and its partners in technology and product. You are a way finder. You are working across organizational lines to partner with architects, product managers, analysts, managers, and engineers to collaboratively and creatively find solutions to evolving our growing platform. You are an enabler. You are hands\-on experimenting, building, creating, guiding, and mentoring engineering teams through to seeing the realization of these solutions into production.
   

  

 Role
   

  

* Between 20\-40% individual contributor with technical team leadership. Who is recognized as a team/s technical expert within a discipline and drives innovation and organizational growth through their contributions.
* Work on complex enterprise\-wide initiatives spanning multiple services/programs and drives resolution by collaborating with business/product owners, engineers, and architects to design and deliver on new services to introduce new products and bundles
* Has skills to succinctly articulate architecture patterns of complex systems, with business and technical implications, to executive and customer stakeholders
* Responsible for the analysis, design, development and delivery of software solutions
* Defines requirements for new applications and customizations, adhering to standards, processes and best practices.
* Set priorities, objectives, and drive deliverables within global technology domains and sub\-domains and engage with the broader technical community to anticipate developments in innovation and evaluate new solutions for future business platform system requirements.
* Leverages input of partners and personal experience to make thoughtful decisions on technical direction and then has the ownership to see those decisions through
* Practice sustainable incident response and conduct blameless postmortems, taking a holistic approach to problem\-solving during production events.
* Explain technical issues and solution strategies to stakeholders, ensure timely accomplishment of technical designs and delivery milestones and liaise with stakeholders to understand business needs.


**All About You**
* You’ve made your career in designing and building high performance, high transaction volume, and globally scalable platforms.
* As an individual contributor you made your name by solving the hard problems that no one else could and as your career grew so did the complexity. You still love getting your hands dirty, but now look forward to working with your friends to solve the big stuff that no one person can solve on their own.
* Designing and crafting the best software this world has ever seen might be your favorite thing, but you know that’s not the alpha and omega of your problem set. You relish your time with the SRE, Performance Engineering, and Infrastructure teams to ensure the architectures are correct and tuned and that your teams’ code is optimized for each system.
* You know you are responsible for software that is critical financial infrastructure for multiple nation states, but you also know that you can’t be everyone all the time, so you’ve extended your ownership to ensure the SDLC and governance processes are both efficient and responsible.
* You are intelligent and industrious, but people don’t know that because you tell them. Its because they see it in the way you lead. From ideation where you make everyone’s ideas feel heard and respected all the way through to production crisis where you stick with the engineers to overcome oversights not found until the last minute. Your personal culture sets the team culture.


 Proficiencies
   

  

* Deep experience in financial services — particularly in payments industry and hands on experience designing for standard and regulatory compliance – PCI\-DSS, GDPR, etc.
* Data\-intensive designing and architecture patterns – APIs, event\-driven\-services, batch\-services, messaging systems, and big data.
* Data\-intensive programming – Java, REST API, Microservices, Kafka, Axon, MQ, and Spring.
* Cloud and DevOps Architecture – Kubernetes, Docker, and Pivotal Cloud Foundry
* Databases – Oracle, SQL server, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, ElasticSearch
* Tools – Eclipse or IntelliJ, Sonar, GIT, Maven, SQL Developer, Jenkins, CI/CD, Gatling


 Education
   

  

* Required undergraduate degree in Computer Science or in a STEM\-intensive degree program with related experience in software engineering.
* Preferred graduate degree in Computer Science or Business with related experience in fintech and payments.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Product Systems Validation Engineer
description:
Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop and execute component, subsystem, and system\-level verification and validation plans based on technical requirements and stakeholder inputs.
* Support creation and maintenance of Design Verification Plan \& Report (DVP\&R) documentation and ensure adequate test coverage.
* Perform requirement analysis and derive test cases using techniques such as Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), Equivalence Class (EC) testing, and risk\-based methodologies.
* Conduct verification and validation activities using HIL (Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop), SIL (Software\-in\-the\-Loop), and MIL (Model\-in\-the\-Loop) environments.
* Execute and support closed\-loop testing activities to validate product functionality and system performance.
* Analyze test results, identify failures, investigate root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
* Own resolution of moderately complex product, component, or system issues with guidance from senior engineers when required.
* Evaluate analytical, simulation, and physical test data to validate product capability against requirements.
* Utilize systems engineering principles to manage interfaces, requirements traceability, integration activities, and product risk.
* Support product failure mode avoidance activities, including identification of potential failure modes and mitigation strategies.
* Apply statistical methods and data\-driven approaches to support engineering decisions and improve product quality.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, test reports, issue logs, and validation records.
* Support change request (CR) management and verification of engineering changes.
* Use engineering tools and processes including Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, DVP\&R, Integrity, Power BI, and other validation systems.
* Create and maintain test automation scripts using Python, CAPL, NI TestStand, ECU\-Test, or similar tools.
* Work with communication protocols such as CAN, J1939, UDS, and related diagnostics systems.
* Coordinate testing activities with technicians, interns, or other supporting resources as needed.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for test methodologies, tools, and validation processes.
* Collaborate effectively with global and cross\-functional teams to meet project timelines, quality targets, and business objectives.


**Qualifications**
**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related STEM discipline from an accredited university.
* Strong academic foundation in systems engineering, product validation, testing methodologies, or related engineering disciplines.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's Degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
* Internship, co\-op, project, research, Formula Student, Baja, or other relevant hands\-on engineering experience.
* Exposure to automotive, powertrain, controls, embedded systems, electronics, or product validation environments.
* ISTQB Certification or equivalent testing certification is desirable.
* Knowledge of export control or regulatory compliance requirements may be required for some roles.


**Skills \& Competencies**
**Technical Skills**
* Product Verification \& Validation Management
* System Requirements Engineering
* Systems Thinking and System Integration
* Product Test Integration and Optimization
* Product Failure Mode Avoidance (FMEA, DFMEA)
* Product Problem Solving and Root Cause Analysis
* Technical Troubleshooting
* Requirement Analysis and Test Strategy Development
* Test Case Design using BVA and Equivalence Classes
* HIL, SIL, and MIL Based Testing
* Closed\-Loop Testing Methodologies
* CAN, J1939, UDS, and Vehicle Network Diagnostics
* Statistical Analysis and Data Interpretation
* Technical Documentation and Reporting
* Product Development Execution, Monitoring, and Control


**Tools \& Technologies**
* Python Scripting
* CAPL Programming
* NI TestStand
* ECU\-Test
* NI Toolchain
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Microsoft Power BI
* Integrity
* McParts
* Test Automation Frameworks
* Requirements and Defect Management Tools


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Collaborates Effectively
* Communicates Effectively
* Decision Quality
* Drives Results
* Manages Complexity
* Self\-Development and Continuous Learning
* Values Differences and Inclusion
* Problem Solving Mindset
* Customer Focus
* Strong Analytical Thinking


**Experience**
* Entry level or early career engineering professional.
* Internship, co\-op, academic project, research, extracurricular engineering team experience, or up to 2 years of relevant industry experience in product development, validation, testing, embedded systems, or systems engineering.
* Experience working with testing environments, automation tools, and engineering analysis techniques is preferred.
* Exposure to verification and validation of electronic control systems, automotive systems, or embedded products is desirable.
* Familiarity with scripting, test automation, diagnostics protocols, and systems\-level testing methodologies is an advantage.

title: Tool & Die Maker
description:
**Company Description** 
 TARA RELAYS Private Limited is a consumer services company headquartered in Pune, Maharashtra, India. The company operates from Supreme Industrial Estate at Aruyeshwar Corner and serves a diverse range of customers in the region. As a growing organization, TARA RELAYS focuses on reliable service delivery and consistent product quality. Team members join a workplace that values practical skills, on\-the\-job learning, and collaborative problem\-solving. The company offers opportunities to contribute to manufacturing and service operations that support its expanding customer base.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site Tool \& Die Maker role is based in Khed and supports the company’s manufacturing and production activities. The Tool \& Die Maker will interpret technical drawings and specifications to design, build, modify, and maintain tools, dies, jigs, and fixtures used in production. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include operating machine tools such as milling machines, lathes, grinders, and CNC equipment, ensuring precise measurements and tolerances, and performing routine inspections of tools to identify wear or defects. The role also involves troubleshooting tooling issues on the shop floor, collaborating with production and engineering teams to improve tool performance, and following safety, quality, and maintenance procedures. The Tool \& Die Maker is expected to document work performed, support continuous improvement initiatives, and help minimize downtime through timely repairs and adjustments.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong technical skills in tool and die making, including reading engineering drawings, using precision measuring instruments, and working with a variety of metals and materials.
* Proficiency in operating conventional and CNC machine tools (e.g., lathes, milling machines, surface grinders) and understanding machining processes and tolerances.
* Experience in maintenance and repair of tools, dies, jigs, and fixtures, with the ability to diagnose issues and implement effective corrective actions.
* Knowledge of manufacturing workflows, quality standards, and safety practices in an industrial or workshop environment.
* Relevant technical education or vocational training in Tool \& Die Making, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline; apprenticeship or prior shop\-floor experience is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work hands\-on in an on\-site setting in Khed, manage time effectively, and collaborate with production and engineering teams.
* Attention to detail, problem\-solving mindset, and willingness to learn and adapt to new tools, processes, and technologies.

title: Senior Specialist - Fiduciary (Accounts Receivable)
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our accounting team at Marsh. This role will be based in Pune. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office
   

  

**Specialist – Fiduciary**
 We’re seeking for an individual who can manage end\-to\-end cash application for complex accounts, ensure accurate ERP postings, resolve exceptions within SLAs, support close activities, maintain compliance and audit readiness, drive process improvements, and guide junior team members. At Marsh, this opportunity offers challenging global exposure, a collaborative and inclusive work environment, strong career growth, and competitive benefits including health coverage, flexible options, and work\-life balance.
   

  

**We will count on you to:**
* Own end\-to\-end cash application for complex, high\-volume, or strategic client accounts across multiple payment types (wire, ACH, lockbox, cheques)
* Post cash receipts (wire transfers, ACH, cheques, lockbox) accurately in ERP
* Investigate and resolve aged unapplied cash, short payments, and matching exceptions within agreed SLAs
* Support month\-end and quarter\-end close activities including AR subledger reconciliation and variance commentary
* Ensure audit\-ready documentation and adherence to SOX
* Prepare and review daily/weekly cash application dashboards and aging reports for Manager review
* Leverage tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, or Excel macros to improve reporting efficiency
* Act as first point of escalation for junior analysts on posting exceptions, ERP queries, and client\-specific complexities
* Contribute to SOP development, updates, and knowledge base maintenance
* Train and onboard new team members on SOPs, ERP workflows, and client processes
* Provide backup coverage and redistribute workload during team member absences to ensure uninterrupted SLA delivery
* Support Manager in daily queue management and productivity monitoring
* Step in as the operational lead for the Cash Applications team when the Team Lead or Deputy Manager is unavailable
* Maintain audit\-ready documentation for all cash posting transactions
* Adhere to internal controls, SOX compliance requirements, and standard operating procedures
* Participate in process improvement initiatives as directed
* Own end\-to\-end cash application for complex, high\-volume, or strategic client accounts
* Investigate and resolve aged unapplied cash, short payments, and cross\-currency matching exceptions
* Participate in ERP upgrades, system migrations, and process automation rollouts
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream teams to resolve interdependencies


**What you need to have:**
* Any relevant accounting degree
* 5\-8 years of experience in accounting
* Prior experience in working in similar roles


**What makes you stand out?**
* Experience in the insurance, financial services, or professional services sector
* Prior experience in Order to Cash
* Prior shared services / GCC experience at MNC scale
* Exposure to Lean / Six Sigma frameworks for process improvement


**Why join our team:**
* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.


 Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Automation Test Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
 Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey \- quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
   

  

**Who Are We Looking For**
 Skilled testers who are passionate about ensuring high\-quality software solutions and contributing to a collaborative team environment. In practice, this means:
   

  

* A university degree (master's/bachelor's) in computer science, engineering, or a related field.
* Practical experience in software testing or test automation (at least 4 years) in electronic payments and the payment lifecycle.
* Understanding of payment processing, acquiring systems, issuing systems, switching and authorization, credit/debit card transactions, mobile payments, POS/ATM transactions, and card management.
* Basic knowledge of Unix, bash, shell scripting, and other scripting languages.
* Familiarity with relational databases and SQL.
* Basic understanding of object\-oriented programming in C\+\+ , C\# or Java is a plus.
* Knowledge of agile methodologies is an advantage.
* Experience with tools such as JIRA and Confluence is beneficial.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* High motivation, efficiency, and a proactive, self\-reliant attitude.
* Open\-minded and inquisitive, with strong teamwork and communication skills.
* Proficient in both oral and written English.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Create Test for testing the processing of electronic payments based on the "Worldline Pay Front Office" software suite.
* Coordinate requirements with the Service Delivery team.
* Design, build, and execute a comprehensive test plan with test cases and scenarios.
* Develop and review high\-quality test scenarios, including input test data and expected results throughout all test phases.
* Plan and conduct both manual and automated testing, monitoring test runs and addressing software errors in collaboration with the Service Delivery and development teams.
* Design, implement, and maintain automated test scripts.
* Document the test plan and execution results, producing thorough test reports and participating in peer reviews.
* Implement standard processes and tools established by the organization, proactively promoting best practices in testing within the project team.
* Monitor and track defects across the testing lifecycle, reporting test results and conducting initial investigations of defects to propose solutions to developers or team leads.
* Support the development of testing capabilities and competencies within the testing practice.
* Identify risks and issues within your scope of responsibility, ensuring all risks and issues are documented with appropriate mitigation strategies and corrective actions.
* Write and maintain the Master Test Plan (Test Strategy) for projects.
* Plan, lead, follow up, and coach assigned test resources for projects, adhering to budget and milestone commitments.
* Address blocking issues and propose workarounds to expedite test execution.
* Write audit reports that include risk assessments.
* Validate test scripts produced by Application Testers and ensure complete end\-to\-end test coverage.
* Determine regression test sets at the end of the project cycle for non\-regression readiness.
* Facilitate training and knowledge transfer for non\-regression and maintenance purposes.


**Shape the evolution**
 We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can\-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career \- wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own.
   

  

 Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description:

The company has established a strong reputation for high\-quality engineering and fabrication, serving diverse industrial sectors. Ravi Industries holds respected certifications, including ASME U and U2 Stamp for manufacturing pressure vessels, ASME R Stamp for metallic repairs, and ASME S Stamp for power boiler manufacturing and assembly. Additional accreditations such as ISO 9001:2015, BS OHSAS 18001:2007, National Board Certification, and approvals from ADNOC and EIL underscore the company’s focus on safety, quality, and compliance.  Job Description:

 is Mastercard?

* Excellent communication skills for collaborating with engineering, legal, IT, and leadership during high‑severity incidents.

* Background in cloud security (Azure, AWS, GCP) including log sources, identity models, and incident patterns.

 activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an
   

  

 inherent risk to the organization and therefore, it is expected that the successful candidate for

description:
**About AppDirect**



 Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world. AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device \- as a service. We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations. We do this by our values\-driven culture \- one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.
   

  




**About You**



 The Network Operations Center (NOC) Analyst is an active participant in network incident management for managed WAN interfaces and managed security sites with circuits varying in size from T1’s to DS3, which employ technologies such as AVPN, ADI, MPLS, Multilink T1s, Ethernet, Cellular and Broadband. The role relies heavily on knowledge and understanding of monitoring and ticketing platforms to effectively troubleshoot and resolve issues.
 







 The NOC Analyst interacts regularly with and is an advocate for all customers with whom he/she is working and who have subscribed to AppDirect’s Managed Network Services. This position requires a strong customer focus and an ability to deal with different customer requirements and priorities.
 







 The successful candidate for this position will effectively utilize prior education and demonstrated work experience to make an immediate, independent contribution to the Network Operations Center team.
 







 The NOC is an integral part of AppDirect’s 24x7x365 operational environment. This position may require occasional shift rotation to cover holidays, weekends, and other normal scheduling requirements as needed to support the business. Flexibility to work any shift as needed is required.
 






**What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact** 




* Own, triage, and resolve customer network (WAN/LAN) related trouble tickets to successful completion
* Detection, tracking, and restoration of customer’s network connectivity via their data circuits and/or equipment
* Remotely troubleshoot and configure WAN equipment, including routers, firewalls, switches, and load balancers from various vendors
* Engage, escalate, and work with carriers and other 3rd parties when needed as part of service restoral
* Participate in incident command bridges, hypercare, and major incidents when required
* Understand and use network monitoring tools such as Zenoss or Logic Monitor to assist in troubleshooting or analyzing network issues and performance
* Converse with technical and non\-technical contacts depending on the situation.
* Perform effective ticket management including but not limited to queue management, timely ticket documentation, proper hand\-off to other analysts, teams, 3rd parties, etc., communications to customers, ticket resolution
* Adhere to established Service Level Objectives and/or Service Level Agreements
* Work both autonomously and also as part of a team, assisting, when necessary, on identifying and diagnosing issues




**What we’re looking for** 






*Required*




* Minimum of two (2\) years of WAN/LAN implementation and support/troubleshooting experience
* Well\-versed in TCP/IP protocols and able to troubleshoot issues remotely
* Strong understanding of the OSI Model, SD\-WAN, Transport, and TCP/IP
* Demonstrable experience with routing and troubleshooting routing issues with BGP, IGRP, RIP, and OSPF
* Must be knowledgeable in NAT, access lists, policy\-based mapping, traffic shaping, and priority queuing
* Must have supported data networks and telecommunications functions in mid\-size enterprises, including VPN, ADI, MPLS, Ethernet, Cellular, Broadband, Wireless (WWAN), Multilink T1s
* Must have experience in command line configuration using two or more of the following product lines: Cisco, SonicWall, Juniper, ADTRAN, Meraki, Fortinet, or other relevant technologies
* Knowledgeable with DNS, DHCP, VRRP, HSRP, VLANs, and Inter\-VLAN routing.
* Knowledge of network monitoring and traffic capturing tools
* Must be conceptually familiar with security\-related terms, and technologies, encryption, authentication, IPsec, VPN tunnels including GRE, and controlling traffic
* VoIP knowledge and experience is a plus
* Ability to interact, communicate, and collaborate with internal/external customers, service providers, and field technicians
* Strong verbal communication and documentation skills
* Strong process improvement and customer\-focused skills




*Preferred*




* Large enterprise LAN/WAN environment or telecommunications company experience preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
* Experience working in a Managed Services organization a plus
* Experience with ServiceNow and monitoring tools such as Logic Monitor or Zenoss
* Possess or be working towards ITIL v3 or v4 Foundations Certification
* Relevant technical certifications a plus, i.e., CCNA, Network\+, etc.
* Conceptual knowledge of Security Operations or experience is a plus

title: IT Security Systems Administrator
description:
**About ACA:**
 ACA Group is the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. We empower our clients to reimagine GRC and protect and grow their business. **Position Summary**
 The IT Security Systems Administrator is responsible for the implementation and ongoing management of the security related technology systems utilized by ACA Group (“ACA”).
   

  

 This position needs to understand the IT vision and work towards realizing it. Individuals would be responsible for finding ways to apply departmental new ideas into their daily work. This position needs a self\-starter who works to improve their own effectiveness as well as provides ad\-hoc suggestions for broader improvements for IT Security Systems. Execution of assigned tasks on time and on quality with some oversight and assistance from others.

title: Specialist - Integration (AEM-IS)
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a seasoned SAP Integration Specialist with deep expertise in SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), SAP Integration Suite, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), and Advanced Event Mesh. In this role, you’ll design, develop, and maintain scalable integration solutions that bridge cloud and on\-premise applications across global enterprise environments. You will also be instrumental in mentoring junior developers and driving best practices for integration design, security, and performance.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect and lead the design of scalable, secure, and high\-performance integration solutions using SAP BTP Integration Suite, CPI, and Solace PubSub\+.
* Define integration strategies and roadmaps aligned with enterprise architecture and digital transformation goals.
* Lead the migration of legacy interfaces from SAP PI/PO to SAP Integration Suite, ensuring minimal disruption and optimal performance.
* Govern and optimize the use of SAP BTP services including API Management, Event Mesh, Open Connectors, and CPI\-DS.
* Oversee the configuration and administration of Solace messaging infrastructure, including advanced topic routing and durable subscriptions.
* Champion API\-first design principles, ensuring robust, reusable, and secure APIs using REST/SOAP standards.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to define integration requirements and governance models.
* Mentor and guide junior developers, conduct code reviews, and lead knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* Establish best practices for monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting using tools like SAP Solution Manager, ElasticSearch, and Splunk.
* Drive continuous improvement through Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and innovation initiatives.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 10\+ years of experience Integration with 6\+ years in SAP integration, including SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI, and SAP BTP.
* Proven experience in leading large\-scale integration projects across cloud and on\-premise systems.
* Deep technical expertise in ABAP, IDOCs, BAPI, RFC, and ALE.
* Strong command of Solace CLI, Solace APIs, and Solace Cloud Console.
* AI\-augmented development experience
* Proficiency in Java, Groovy, Python, and integration\-specific scripting.
* In\-depth understanding of security protocols (OAuth, SAML, SSL) and API lifecycle management.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, and hybrid integration scenarios.
* Exposure to AI tools/technology would be nice to have.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Good understanding of API Management tools like IBM API Connect, Apigee etc.
* Experience with DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with event\-driven architectures, microservices, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Exposure to SAP Open Connectors, Graph API, and CAPM.
* Strong background in Agile delivery and tools like JIRA and Confluence.


**Technical Skills**
* Integration Tools: SAP CPI, SAP PI/PO, SAP BTP, API Management, Event Mesh, Cloud Connector
* Languages: Java, ABAP, Groovy, Python, JavaScript, XML/XSLT
* Protocols: REST, SOAP, IDOC, OData, RFC, BAPI, SFTP, HTTP
* Platforms: SAP S/4HANA, ECC, Fiori, HANA
* Tools: Eclipse, NetWeaver Studio, Postman, SoapUI, GitHub
* Cloud \& DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git, CI/CD


**Soft Skills**
* Strategic mindset with strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Analytical thinker with a passion for innovation and continuous improvement.
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, global, and collaborative environment.


**About Medline India**
 Medline India was setup in 2010 in Pune, primarily as an offshore Development centre and to augment resources for Medline Industries LP headquartered in Chicago, USA. We are a 1500\+ strong and growing team of technology, finance \& and business support professionals who support our businesses worldwide towards a mission to make healthcare run better. We are proud to be certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ by the Great Place to Work Institute® (India) for the duration May 2023 – May 2024\.

Our clientele includes hospitals, extended care facilities, surgery centres, physician offices, home care agencies, providers, and retailers. title: Chief Operating Officer
description:
Chief Operating Officer
 



  





**Reporting to: Executive Director Location: Pune, Maharashtra** 




  





 A dynamic and diversified portfolio comprising Hospital (a 300\-bed tertiary care facility in Pune) and a premium chain of Schools (a network of 3 campuses in Alandi, Latur, and Indore with over 3,500 enrolled students). The cluster currently generates combined revenues in excess of ₹100 crores. The mandate for the incoming leadership is to aggressively double this revenue over the next 4 years while simultaneously upholding the highest standards of quality excellence across all institutions.
 



  





**Position Summary:** 




  





 The Chief Operating Officer (COO) will take end\-to\-end ownership of cluster operations, acting as the primary driver of execution. This is not a purely advisory or high\-level strategic role; it requires a hands\-on operator who has built systems from the ground up, understands ground\-level realities, and focuses strictly on getting work done. The COO will ensure that every strategic decision is relentlessly executed, operational bottlenecks are unblocked, and both financial growth and institutional quality benchmarks are achieved on schedule.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL EXECUTION \& LEADERSHIP
 


1. **Drive Absolute Execution:** 
 Ensure that all finalized strategies are rigorously executed on the ground without dilution or delay.
2. **Unblock \& Resolve:** 
 Proactively identify what is stuck across the institutions, intervene directly, and resolve operational roadblocks on a daily/weekly basis.
3. **Goal \& Schedule Management:** 
 Conduct relentless reviews of operational goals, ensuring all initiatives, capacity expansions, and daily operations remain perfectly on schedule.
4. **Cross\-Functional Tracking:** 
 Track end\-to\-end workflows across all administrative, clinical, and academic functions to ensure tight alignment and efficiency.
5. **Direct Ownership:** 
 Take personal, hands\-on ownership of mission\-critical activities, high\-stakes projects, and the overarching 4\-year revenue\-doubling mandate.



  





**HOSPITAL OPERATIONS** 




  




1. **Patient Care Quality \& Clinical Excellence:** 
 Establish and enforce uncompromising standards for patient care, clinical outcomes, and strict adherence to healthcare regulations.
2. **Hospital P\&L \& Growth:** 
 Drive capacity utilization, expand specialty service lines, and optimize cost efficiencies to accelerate revenue growth.
3. **Operational Discipline:** 
 Institutionalize robust SOPs for daily hospital administration, minimizing turnaround times and elevating the overall patient experience.



  





**SCHOOL OPERATIONS** 




  




1. **Academic Excellence \& Student Success:** 
 Uphold and elevate the quality of education, ensuring rigorous academic standards, robust student development, and excellent campus environments.
2. **School P\&L \& Expansion:** 
 Drive student enrolment growth, optimize campus operations, and manage expansion plans across all three current and future locations.
3. **Stakeholder Alignment:** 
 Implement strong performance management and governance frameworks for academic and administrative staff.



  





 Candidate Profile:
 



  




1. **Experience:** 
 15 to 20 years of progressive leadership experience, with a proven track record of managing end\-to\-end operations in multi\-unit healthcare, education, or allied service sectors.
2. **Ground\-Up Operator:** 
 Demonstrated experience building operations from the ground up.
3. **Scale \& Growth:** 
 Proven history of managing a business with revenues of ₹100 crores or above, with a successful track record of aggressively scaling operations and doubling metrics within tight timeframes.
4. **Quality Focus:** 
 Deep commitment to institutionalizing quality—both in patient care and academic excellence—balancing aggressive growth with superior service delivery.
5. **Education:** 
 Postgraduate qualification in Business Management, Hospital Administration, or a related discipline.
