title: Senior SAP Basis Administrator
description:
**About Advanced Energy**
 Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ: AEIS), enables design breakthroughs and drives growth for leading semiconductor and industrial customers. Our precision power and control technologies, along with our applications know\-how, inspire close partnerships and innovation in thin\-film and industrial manufacturing. We are proud of our rich heritage, award\-winning technologies, and we value the talents and contributions of all Advanced Energy's employees worldwide.
   

  

**Position Summary:**
 The Senior SAP Basis Administrator is responsible for the administration, support, optimization, and continuous improvement of the organization's SAP landscape, ensuring high availability, performance, security, and reliability of business\-critical systems. This role serves as a fully qualified technical professional with comprehensive knowledge of SAP Basis administration, SAP architecture, system operations, database management, and infrastructure platforms.
   

  

 The incumbent provides advanced technical expertise across SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver ABAP and Java environments, supporting system installations, upgrades, migrations, performance tuning, transport management, troubleshooting, and operational excellence initiatives. The role requires independent evaluation of complex technical issues, application of analytical problem\-solving techniques, and recommendation of effective solutions across diverse SAP environments.
   

  

 The Senior SAP Basis Administrator collaborates closely with SAP functional teams, developers, infrastructure teams, database administrators, security teams, and external partners to resolve system issues, implement enhancements, and support strategic technology initiatives. The role also contributes to SAP transformation projects, including cloud adoption, platform modernization, and S/4HANA programs, while ensuring adherence to security, compliance, and change management standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* SAP Landscape Administration \& Support
* Administer, monitor, and maintain SAP environments including SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver ABAP, Java, and related SAP platforms.
* Perform SAP system installations, upgrades, patches, kernel updates, system refreshes, client copies, and migration activities.
* Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) and coordinate transport activities across Development, Quality Assurance, and Production environments.
* Support SAP HANA, Oracle, and other supported SAP databases, including monitoring, backup, recovery, restore, and performance optimization activities.
* Conduct proactive system monitoring, health checks, capacity planning, and performance tuning to ensure system stability and availability.
* Technical Troubleshooting \& Problem Resolution
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex SAP Basis\-related incidents, including system performance issues, short dumps, background job failures, interface failures, and connectivity problems.
* Evaluate system logs and technical data to identify root causes and develop sustainable corrective actions.
* Assess unusual situations, determine appropriate solutions, and recommend improvements to enhance operational effectiveness.
* Support high\-availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity requirements for SAP systems.
* SAP Technology \& Infrastructure Support
* Support SAP ecosystem technologies including SAP Solution Manager, SAP BusinessObjects (BOBJ), SAP Data Services (BODS), HANA Studio, HANA Cockpit, SAP Cloud ALM, and CTS\+.
* Provide Basis support for SAP cloud solutions, including SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Ariba, Integrated Business Planning (IBP), and other SAP cloud services as applicable.
* Collaborate with infrastructure teams supporting Linux, Unix, Windows Server, and cloud\-hosted SAP environments.
* Ensure SAP systems comply with security standards, audit requirements, and organizational governance processes
* Project \& Continuous Improvement Activities
* Participate in SAP upgrade, migration, transformation, and system enhancement projects, including ECC\-to\-S/4HANA initiatives.
* Contribute technical expertise to architecture reviews, system design discussions, and infrastructure planning activities.
* Identify opportunities to improve SAP performance, system reliability, operational efficiency, and support processes.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, standards, and knowledge base materials.
* Collaboration \& Knowledge Sharing
* Partner with business, technical, and external stakeholders to resolve complex technical issues and support business priorities.
* Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to less experienced team members and project participants.
* Build effective relationships across IT functions to facilitate efficient issue resolution and project execution.
* Communicate technical concepts and recommendations effectively to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Education –
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Master's Degree in a related field is advantageous.
* Experience –
* Bachelor's Degree with 6\+ years of relevant experience, or Master’s Degree with 3\+ years of relevant experience.
* Minimum 6\-8 years of hands\-on SAP Basis Administration experience within enterprise environments.
* Experience supporting SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA landscapes.
* Proven experience with SAP system installations, upgrades, migrations, patching, refreshes, and transport management.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP HANA database administration and exposure to Oracle database environments.
* Experience supporting high\-availability SAP systems and business\-critical production environments.
* Experience with SAP cloud technologies and services is preferred.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong knowledge of SAP Basis Administration, SAP Architecture, and SAP System Operations.
* Expertise in SAP NetWeaver ABAP and Java administration.
* Experience with SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, Oracle Database, and related SAP technologies.
* Proficiency in SAP Transport Management System (TMS), system monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Hands\-on experience with SAP Solution Manager, SAP Cloud ALM, HANA Studio, and HANA Cockpit.
* Experience supporting SAP BusinessObjects (BOBJ) and SAP Data Services (BODS).
* Working knowledge of Linux, Unix, Windows Server, and cloud\-hosted infrastructure environments.
* Understanding of backup, recovery, disaster recovery, security, and compliance requirements within SAP ecosystems.


**Core Competencies**
* Technical \& Problem Solving
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Ability to evaluate complex technical issues and develop effective solutions with limited precedent.
* Sound judgment and decision\-making skills in high\-impact operational environments.
* Collaboration \& Communication
* Effective stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to influence decisions through technical expertise and professional credibility.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Execution \& Ownership
* Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and assignments.
* Proactive approach to operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, and process discipline.


**Working Conditions**
* Location: Pune, India
* Environment: Standard office environment utilizing standard office equipment; some travel may be necessary.
* Ability to work on projects with global team members outside of standard office hours.
* Weekend work and overtime may be required.
* Works in team and individual environments.
* Up to 25% travel (more may be necessary for projects); domestic and international


**Work Environment:**

description:
Are you looking for an opportunity to help solve one of today's biggest business challenges? AI is changing the pace of business, and organizations everywhere are struggling to help their workforce, partners, and customers keep up. At Litmos, we're building the Learning Acceleration Platform that helps organizations build human capability faster—and we're looking for people who are passionate about making a meaningful impact for customers while growing alongside a collaborative, people\-first team.
   

  

 Litmos is the Learning Acceleration Platform that helps organizations build capability faster, adapt at the speed business changes, and scale learning to anyone, anywhere. Combining an intuitive platform, AI\-powered capabilities, trusted content, expert services, and a broad ecosystem of integrations, Litmos helps organizations accelerate workforce productivity, improve customer adoption and retention, enable high\-performing partners, and reduce organizational risk through continuous learning.
   

  

 Organizations such as Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Graco, Sabre, and Russell Mineral Equipment trust Litmos to accelerate learning across their workforce, partners, and customers. Today, more than 11K customers with 30 million learners across 150 countries and 37 languages use Litmos to build the capabilities their organizations need to succeed. Backed by Francisco Partners, one of the world's leading technology investment firms, we're investing in the future of learning—and the people who are building it. Learn more at www.litmos.com.
   

  

 Network Operations Engineer
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a Network Operations Engineer to join our CloudOps team and keep our infrastructure secure, patched, and available around the clock. You'll monitor and support a multi\-cloud environment, primarily Azure, with an AWS footprint, spanning Windows, Linux, and SQL Server systems. Coverage runs follow\-the\-sun, so you'll be part of a rotation that ensures alerts never go unwatched, wherever in the world they fire.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**Monitor \& Respond**
* Watch infrastructure health, performance, and security across Azure, AWS, Windows, Linux, and SQL Server using our monitoring and observability tools.
* Triage incoming alerts, assess severity, and take action — or escalate with clear context — as part of a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation.
* Diagnose and resolve incidents using established runbooks, and document what happened, why, and how it was fixed.


**Patch \& Maintain**
* Plan, schedule, and execute patches and updates across cloud resources, servers, and databases, coordinating maintenance windows to minimize business impact.
* Keep patch and compliance records current to meet security and regulatory requirements.


**Improve \& Report**
* Track SLA, MTTR, and MTBF metrics, and report on system reliability to stakeholders.
* Contribute to post\-incident reviews and refine runbooks, alert thresholds, and escalation policies based on what you learn.
* Flag opportunities to automate repetitive operational work.


 What You Bring
   

  

* 2–4 years in cloud operations, systems administration, or network operations.
* Network Configuration experience:\- set up and troubleshot VPNs, DNS, subnets, and routing.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure; exposure to AWS is a plus.
* Comfort administering both Windows and Linux systems, plus familiarity with SQL Server.
* Experience with monitoring/alerting tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, or equivalent) and patch management processes.
* A track record of clear incident documentation and communication under pressure.
* Willingness to work a follow\-the\-sun on\-call rotation, including off\-hours coverage.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Azure certifications (AZ\-104, AZ\-900\) or AWS equivalents.
* Scripting experience (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automation.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Bicep, Terraform, ARM) or CI/CD pipelines.
* Background in SRE practices or backup/disaster recovery (RTO/RPO).


**Salary Range:** 
 ₹12,00,000 to ₹18,00,000 plus 10% bonus
   

  

 As a learning company we believe in the potential of everyone; if you don't have experience in all the details mentioned in this job post, then we still encourage you to apply and we'll get back to you as soon as we can.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity workplace employer. We are committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provide accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities.
   

  

 Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability.

Focus should be on complex, interdependent, highly visible customer issues that have broad impact. Serve as a cross\-functional technical advisor by applying depth and breadth of knowledge to drive customer success.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 As a Cisco Network Consulting Security Engineer, you will translate business requirements into technical solutions and design, implement, and manage enterprise security solutions, with a focus on Cisco ISE. You will provide architecture and consulting expertise across customer projects, ensuring alignment with security, compliance, and business objectives. You will lead and guide teams delivering Architecture \& Consulting Services, owning key deliverables such as design documents, migration plans, MoPs, test plans, and campus network best\-practice recommendations. You will facilitate design workshops, provide customer consultancy, and ensure successful delivery against expectations. You will collaborate with customers, SMEs, project managers, account teams, and Product \& Services Sales and Systems/Consulting Engineers to solve complex technology challenges. You will drive process optimization, automation, thought leadership, customer outcomes, and continuous improvement across the practice.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Architect, design, deploy, and manage enterprise\-level Cisco security solutions, including firewalls, web and email security, VPNs, access control.
* Conduct thorough network security assessments, vulnerability analysis, to identify weaknesses and propose solutions.
* Configure, administer, and optimize Cisco Secure Firewall ASA and Firepower (FTD) firewalls, including Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC), for perimeter defense, data center segmentation, VPN enforcement, and secure segmentation.
* Implement and maintain robust security protocols and measures, including Access Control Lists (ACLs), Network Address Translation (NAT), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS).
* Develop, document, and enforce network security policies, procedures, and standards in compliance with industry best practices and regulatory requirements (e.g., NIST, PCI, DoD STIGs).
* Deploy and manage Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, specifically Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), for 802\.1X authentication, profiling, posture assessments, and policy enforcement across wired, wireless, and data center environments. Including but not limited to Guest Services, Trustsec, pxGrid and 3rd party integrations.
* Troubleshoot complex network, security, and data center incidents, performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective measures to restore services swiftly and prevent future occurrences.
* Design, implement, and enforce security policies with Secure Access, including but not limited to VPN as a Service, Zero Trust Network Access, Secure Web Gateway, Cloud Access Security Broker, Data Loss Prevention, Firewall as a Service with IPS, Cloud Secure Malware Analytics, DNS\-layer security, Secure Internet Access, Secure Private Access and Umbrella.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field \& A minimum of 8\-10 years of experience in network and security engineering with a strong focus on network security, firewalls and Network Access.
* Active professional/expert\-level certifications such as CCNP Security, CCIE Security or CCIE Enterprise or CCIE Data Center are highly preferred.
* Other valuable certifications include ITIL Foundational, CISSP, Palo Alto PCNSE, or CompTIA Security\+.
* Expert\-level knowledge of Cisco routing and switching technologies and protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, VLANs, STP).
* Strong understanding of security principles, including IDS/IPS, VPN (IPsec, SSL), encryption protocols, and endpoint security.
* Experience with network monitoring, packet capture analysis (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump), and SIEM tools.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Familiarity with network automation tools, scripting languages such as Python and Ansible, and AI agents is a plus.
* Knowledge of cloud networking concepts and hybrid cloud architectures, including AWS and Azure.
* Ability to lead and mentor security network engineers, provide technical guidance, and foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with excellent attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive initiatives effectively.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

 Experience designing or operating GPU/accelerated compute, distributed training setups, containerized deployments and model\-serving workloads.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Bicep/ARM/Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and observability practices.
   

  

 Ability to optimize infrastructure for performance, reliability, scalability, cost and security.
   

  

 Understanding of MLOps patterns including experiment tracking, model registry, model deployment, monitoring and rollback approaches.

This team is dedicated to providing exceptional support and service to customers across the APAC region, fostering a strong customer\-centric culture characterized by collaboration, transparency, and mutual respect. The mission of the team is to drive customer success and maximize the value of Nutanix products, ensuring that clients realize their full potential and return on investment through proactive engagement and expert guidance.

The position primarily involves remote service delivery to customers, maintaining the flexibility to accommodate varying customer preferences.

 AWS AI Services

 AI Agents \& Workflow Integration

**Educational Qualification :**

**Role Summary / Description**
 AI Powered Tech Talent
   

  

 As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for AWS, you will own significant portions of the end\-to\-end architecture and engineering of optimized compute infrastructure for large\-scale AI and machine learning systems. You will design scalable distributed training environments, model\-serving foundations, automation patterns and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost\-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, cloud modernization, regulated workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust AWS\-based AI infrastructure solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Own end\-to\-end architecture and design of optimized AWS compute infrastructure for large\-scale AI/ML systems, including distributed training, GPU/accelerated compute, container platforms and model\-serving environments.
   

  

 Design and tune large\-scale AWS GPU clusters and distributed training systems using services such as EC2, EKS, SageMaker, S3, FSx/EFS, VPC, IAM and CloudWatch, including accelerator selection, interconnect/networking and high\-throughput storage design.
   

  

 Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on AWS, applying deep knowledge of AWS AI/ML services, accelerators, networking, security and cost levers.
   

  

 Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade\-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
   

  

 Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
   

  

 Drive architecture decision\-making by documenting rationale, trade\-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
   

  

 Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
   

  

 Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
   

  

 Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
   

  

 Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
   

  

 Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
   

  

 Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large\-scale engineering solutions.
   

  

 Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C\+\+, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
   

  

 Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform\-native workflow tooling.
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
   

  

 Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
   

  

 Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large\-scale solutions.
   

  

 Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
   

  

 Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
   

  

**Required Skills/ Experience**
 Strong hands\-on experience with AWS AI infrastructure services including EC2, EKS, SageMaker, S3, FSx/EFS, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch and AWS DevOps/security services.
   

  

 Experience architecting GPU/accelerated compute, distributed training, model serving, high\-throughput storage, container platforms and secure cloud networking.
   

  

 Strong working knowledge of Terraform/CloudFormation, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, InfraOps, MLOps, observability and incident response practices.
   

  

 Ability to optimize AWS AI infrastructure for performance, power, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
   

  

 Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable infrastructure patterns.
   

  

 Good to Have Skills
   

  

 AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional or Machine Learning/AI specialty or associate credentials.
   

  

 Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e\-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where AI infrastructure must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost\-control requirements.
   

  

 Exposure to LLM infrastructure, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, GPU scheduling, high\-performance storage, low\-latency model serving and model optimization techniques.
   

  

 Knowledge of enterprise architecture governance, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models.

 As a key member of the Technology Services team, the Technical Expert will help define, prototype, govern, and scale AI\-enabled delivery capabilities across our global Professional Services organization. title: Sr. Specialist, Product Management
description:
**Our Purpose**

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. **Title And Summary**
 Sr. Specialist, Product Management
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. We support a wide range of digital payment choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart, and accessible. Our technology, innovation, partnerships, and networks combine to deliver products and services that help individuals, businesses, and governments realize their greatest potential.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Disputes Solutions team is looking for a Senior Specialist, Product Owner to help shape and deliver Mastercard's next\-generation disputes platform. This individual will play a critical role in defining product requirements, driving feature development, and ensuring the platform can successfully support both global capabilities and regional market needs across Mastercard's worldwide network.
   

  

 Based in Pune, this role will be embedded within a cross\-functional product and engineering organization, partnering closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Architects, UX Designers, Data Scientists, Operations teams, and Regional stakeholders. The successful candidate will help evolve a scalable global platform while supporting the flexibility needed to address localized business requirements, regulatory considerations, customer expectations, and market\-specific operational processes.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is passionate about product development, thrives in agile environments, and enjoys translating complex customer, regional, and business needs into actionable product outcomes that can scale globally while supporting local market differentiation.
   

  

 Role
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Own requirements and roadmap execution for key areas of Mastercard's next\-generation disputes platform.
* Partner with global and regional stakeholders to gather, analyze, prioritize, and document customer, operational, regulatory, and business requirements.
* Help define platform capabilities that balance global standardization with the flexibility needed to support localized market requirements.
* Translate business needs into clearly defined epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.
* Serve as Product Owner for an agile development pod, maintaining and prioritizing the product backlog to maximize customer and business value.
* Collaborate closely with Engineering and Architecture teams to ensure solutions align with platform strategy, extensibility, scalability, and regional deployment needs.
* Partner with Product Management leadership to support the evolution of a globally consistent disputes platform while enabling regional market customization where appropriate.
* Help drive adoption of AI\-powered capabilities by identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency, automate workflows, enhance decision\-making, and improve customer experiences.
* Work with Data Science, Analytics, and Engineering teams to define intelligent automation, case management, and decision\-support capabilities.
* Facilitate discovery workshops and stakeholder engagement sessions to uncover emerging market requirements and platform enhancement opportunities.
* Leverage customer feedback, operational analytics, market insights, and regional input to inform prioritization and roadmap decisions.
* Support release planning, testing, go\-to\-market readiness, and implementation activities across global and regional deployments.
* Monitor product performance and customer outcomes across markets, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and increased adoption.
* Act as a customer advocate and champion agile product development practices throughout the delivery lifecycle.


**All About You**
 The ideal candidate for this position should:
   

  

* Be passionate about building products that solve meaningful customer and business problems.
* Demonstrate strong product ownership and backlog management capabilities.
* Have experience translating complex business requirements into scalable product solutions.
* Possess strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to collaborate across global and regional teams.
* Be comfortable working with stakeholders across multiple geographies, time zones, and business functions.
* Have excellent communication skills and the ability to engage both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities using both qualitative and quantitative insights.
* Be capable of balancing global platform objectives with local market needs and customer requirements.
* Have experience working in agile product development environments.
* Be comfortable navigating ambiguity and driving clarity in rapidly evolving environments.
* Demonstrate curiosity and enthusiasm for leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve customer experiences and operational outcomes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience building enterprise SaaS, platform, fintech, banking, or payments products.
* Knowledge of disputes, chargebacks, fraud management, case management, or transaction lifecycle processes.
* Experience supporting products deployed across multiple regions, markets, or countries.
* Understanding of how regulatory, operational, and customer requirements vary across global markets.
* Experience working with AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, or data\-driven products.
* Familiarity with modern product development practices including discovery\-led development and outcome\-based roadmaps.
* Experience partnering closely with engineering organizations and technical teams.
* Exposure to platform modernization, digital transformation, or large\-scale migration initiatives.
* Experience leveraging customer feedback and market insights to influence product direction.
* Experience working within financial services, payments, or other highly regulated industries.


 Success Measures
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will**
* Deliver impactful product capabilities that support Mastercard's disputes modernization strategy.
* Successfully evolve product capabilities that support both global platform objectives and localized market requirements.
* Create clear, actionable requirements that enable efficient and predictable delivery by engineering teams.
* Drive adoption of AI\-powered capabilities that improve customer and operational outcomes.
* Deliver innovative product features that improve platform usability, efficiency, flexibility, and customer satisfaction.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, Customer Delivery, and Regional teams.
* Contribute to product strategy through customer insights, market trends, regional feedback, and data\-driven recommendations.
* Drive measurable improvements in platform adoption, operational effectiveness, implementation scalability, and customer experience across global markets.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: B2B Copywriter & LinkedIn Ghostwriter
description:
**Location:** 
 Remote (India) ·
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time ·
 



**Comp:** 
 Competitive
 



  





 We're looking for someone who already writes for an audience and knows what lands. The core of this job is LinkedIn: ghostwriting for the founders, consistently, in their voice. From there it extends to email, the website, and how we talk about what we sell.
 



  





 If you've built a following writing for someone else — or for yourself — that's the experience we're weighting most.
 



  





**What you'd own** 




  





*LinkedIn, first and foremost* 



* Ghostwriting for the founders. Their voice, their opinions, their stories — not a house tone
* Working out what actually gets read in our category, and doing more of it
* Building a rhythm we can sustain, given the founders have very little time to give you



  





*Email* 



* Cold email copy for the services business, written with our GTM engineer who owns the infrastructure and the campaigns
* Product emails for Muntin — onboarding, trial nudges, launch announcements



  





*Everything else we say* 



* Landing pages, comparison pages, case studies from delivered projects
* Positioning: the offer angles, the objections, what we say to whom
* Keeping the two brands separate. They sell to very different people at very different prices



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* You've written for an audience and watched the numbers. Posts, newsletters, articles, anything — what matters is that you saw what worked and adjusted
* Ghostwriting experience, or a clear sense of how you'd get inside someone else's voice
* You write for US readers and it sounds like it
* Some B2B or tech exposure. Any SaaS category is fine; you don't need to have written about software development specifically
* Opinions about the work. We want someone who'll tell us the offer is the problem, not the subject line
* Comfortable with AI\-assisted drafting, and clear about where you don't use it



  





**Nice to have** 



* You've written cold email that was actually sent, and saw the reply data
* You've grown a LinkedIn account — yours or a client's — from a standing start
* Product marketing for a low\-price, self\-serve product and high price service as well.

title: Animator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Skelia Entertainment is a tier\-one international animation studio focused on turnkey production and co\-production of long\-form animated series and episodic content. The studio combines creative storytelling with large\-scale technical execution, partnering with streaming platforms, television networks, and global IP owners. Operating through a unified production ecosystem, Skelia manages hundreds of minutes of complex animation annually. Its end\-to\-end capabilities span concept design, scripting, animatics, animation, rendering, compositing, sound engineering, and mastering. This structure ensures consistency, creative integrity, and reliable delivery against demanding broadcast schedules.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Animator is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Pune Division. This role involves creating high\-quality character and environment animations for long\-form series and episodic content, aligned with project style guides and narrative requirements. Day\-to\-day activities include interpreting storyboards and animatics, working with motion capture data, developing motion graphics sequences, and collaborating with directors and other artists to refine timing, performance, and visual storytelling. The Animator will participate in review sessions, incorporate feedback efficiently, and maintain production standards across multiple episodes. The role also includes close coordination with production teams to meet deadlines while ensuring technical accuracy and creative fidelity.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess Animation and Motion Capture skills to produce expressive, technically sound character and scene animations.
* Candidates should possess Storyboarding and Motion Graphics skills to support visual storytelling and create dynamic sequences.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills to collaborate effectively with directors, production teams, and fellow artists.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard animation tools (e.g., Maya, Blender, or equivalent) and familiarity with compositing pipelines.
* Understanding of timing, weight, acting principles, and cinematic language for long\-form and episodic content.
* Ability to work on\-site in Pune Division, manage multiple tasks, and meet production deadlines in a fast\-paced studio environment.
* Relevant diploma or degree in Animation, Fine Arts, Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience in series production, streaming or broadcast animation workflows is an advantage.

title: Network Operations Consultant
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Senior technical lead for the SOC and for the PulseAI platform layer. Runs major\-incident response for security and PulseAI platform events, owns the detection\-content and tuning program — including Kubernetes/OpenShift security telemetry — and is L3 for PulseAI platform operations: owns root cause analysis, works platform defects with the Gruve PulseAI engineering team, leads OpenShift cluster lifecycle operations and emergency remediation, acts as vendor engineering liaison for Red Hat, the NVIDIA software stack and third\-party platform vendors, partners with the Network Operations Consultant on infrastructure\-side events, and deputises for the Security Operation Manager.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead technical response on Severity 1/2 security and PulseAI platform incidents until management command engages; own the SLA status cadence (hourly / every 30 minutes on Severity 1\) to customer authorised contacts; hand infrastructure\-side events (network fabric, GPU hardware, storage) to the Network Operations Consultant and stay engaged on cross\-domain incidents.
* Own root cause analysis for PulseAI platform and OpenShift cluster incidents; reproduce and characterise platform defects and route them to Gruve PulseAI product engineering; own the corrective\-action backlog and problem management to eliminate recurring incidents.
* Own the PulseAI platform operations practice: severity classification standards, diagnostic runbooks for the PulseAI and OpenShift layers (control plane, operators, authentication/SSO, RBAC, tenancy and quota enforcement, model\-serving endpoints, observability), Grafana observability standards, alert thresholds for the SLA appendix, and the monitor / remediate / escalate matrix as applied per customer.
* Lead OpenShift cluster lifecycle operations for PulseAI customers — y\-stream upgrades on customer approval within the agreed window of the Red Hat release, operator and platform\-component changes, emergency vulnerability remediation of the cluster and platform — enforcing the pre\-change backup gate, and coordinating node\-pool, GPU driver/firmware and fabric changes with the Network Operations Consultant.
* Own Kubernetes/OpenShift security operations for the engagement: onboarding kube\-audit and workload telemetry into the SIEM, detection content for container attack paths (MITRE ATT\&CK for Containers), Cilium/Hubble and OVN\-Kubernetes flow use cases, admission\-control and image/runtime security posture, and RBAC / service\-account hygiene reviews.
* Act as vendor engineering liaison for the platform stack: Red Hat for OpenShift product defects, NVIDIA for GPU Operator / driver / NVIDIA AI Enterprise (NIM) software issues, and the third\-party platform variant (Rafay, vCluster, vNode, NVIDIA Run:ai, Red Hat OpenShift AI) where restoration is best\-effort with committed vendor escalation.
* Lead customer onboarding technically for the platform layer: deploy and validate OpenShift and PulseAI within the 14\-day Ready\-for\-Install window, configure identity provider federation and initial tenancy structure, onboard the platform to monitoring via the agreed connectivity pattern (outbound collector, site\-to\-site VPN or jump host with just\-in\-time elevation), and complete the platform sections of the countersigned environment validation checklist.
* Own the detection\-content backlog and tuning program; own log\-pipeline integration health with escalation into engineering.
* Approve and execute high\-risk security and platform changes; cross\-train the SOC L1/L2 bench on Kubernetes/OpenShift platform operations; drive shift\-quality audits and post\-incident reviews for the SOC pod.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 8–11 years with prior senior/lead experience in SOC or 24×7 platform operations and genuine security\-to\-platform cross\-domain fluency.
* Incident command capability; deep SIEM content and query skills.
* Strong Kubernetes/GKE security operations depth — onboarding kube\-audit and workload telemetry, building detection content for container attack paths (MITRE ATT\&CK for Containers), and tuning Cilium/Hubble\-based use cases.
* Deep Red Hat OpenShift / Kubernetes operations experience in production — multi\-node cluster administration, operators, y/z\-stream upgrades, RBAC, storage and networking, observability stack (Grafana, metrics, logs, alerting), backup/restore of cluster and platform state — with a track record of platform diagnostics and RCA.
* GPU\-cluster platform operations experience: NVIDIA GPU Operator/driver lifecycle, NVIDIA AI Enterprise components (NIM), DCGM\-class telemetry, node health and capacity management for AI inference workloads on RTX PRO 6000 / HGX B300\-class servers or equivalent.
* Experience operating against contractual SLAs (acknowledgement, restoration, availability, service credits) and running vendor engineering escalations through to fix.

**Job Description Summary**
 We are seeking
 ***Manager Database Operations Manager***
 to join our
 ***GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure)***
 in Global Technology \& Operations.
   

  

**Team/Group Description**
 This position operates in a fast\-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On\-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value
   

  

**Role Description**
 The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands\-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.
   

  

**Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports**
 Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission\-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer\-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high\-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real\-time global decision\-making, powers enterprise\-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large\-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.
* The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high\-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies—in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T\-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent \& ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application\-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise\-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long\-term organizational objectives.


**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
 This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise\-scale data infrastructure.
   

  

 You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large\-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high\-impact challenges.
   

  

 With global scope, mission\-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands\-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
   

  

**Professional development value of this role**
 Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization \- such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise\-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
   

  

**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale, global or multi\-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission\-critical system reliability.


**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 8\+ years of progressive, hands\-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.


**Skills**
* Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase \& IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
* Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services).
* Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T\-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with .NET development is advantageous.
* Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e.g., SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.
* Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components.
* Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root\-cause analysis.
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization.


**Soft Skills And Other Requirements**
* Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross\-team collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high\-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server\-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications.

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a FinOps Engineer with a DevOps backbone who has an almost obsessive eye for cost leaks, idle resources, and inefficiencies across our platform. If unused EBS volumes, oversized instances, or a forgotten dev environment running on weekends genuinely bother you, you'll fit right in. This isn't a passive reporting role. You'll be expected to proactively hunt for waste, propose optimisations, and drive strategic cost conversations with engineering, SRE, and leadership across ZOOP's entire platform from infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters to data pipelines and third\-party services.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Continuously audit ZOOP's cloud footprint (AWS/Azure/GCP) end\-to\-end compute, storage, networking, databases, observability stack, and SaaS tooling and flag every form of waste, big or small.
* Proactively propose cost\-reduction strategies rather than waiting to be asked; bring data, options, trade\-offs, and a recommendation to the table.
* Lead monthly/quarterly cost reviews with engineering and product leadership; turn billing data into actionable conversations.
* Build cost visibility dashboards and chargeback/showback models so every team at ZOOP knows what they're spending and why.
* Drive rightsizing, autoscaling tuning, Spot/Reserved Instance/Savings Plan strategies, and storage tiering across the platform.
* Embed cost guardrails into CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), and Kubernetes manifests to catch wasteful resources before they're deployed.
* Optimise Kubernetes cost efficiency using tools like Kubecost, OpenCost, or Karpenter; tune requests/limits, HPA/VPA, and node pools.
* Set up automated alerts and anomaly detection for budget breaches, idle resources, and runaway costs.
* Partner with Finance for forecasting, unit economics (cost per user/transaction), and cloud budget planning.
* Evangelise a cost\-aware engineering culture, run internal sessions, write playbooks, and make FinOps a shared responsibility, not a finance afterthought.


**Requirements**
* Someone with genuine OCD around cost and wastage; you can't sleep knowing a non\-prod cluster ran all weekend at full capacity.
* A DevOps practitioner first, who understands why costs happen at the infrastructure level, not just someone reading billing reports.
* Naturally proactive; you don't wait for tickets; you spot patterns, dig in, and propose changes before anyone asks.
* Comfortable challenging engineering decisions diplomatically when they're expensive, and equally comfortable defending necessary spend to finance.
* A clear communicator who can talk to both a senior engineer about Karpenter configs and a CFO about quarterly burn.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE, or Cloud FinOps roles.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (AWS preferred), including native cost tools (Cost Explorer, CUR, Azure Cost Management, or GCP Billing).
* Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi).
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE).
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or Go for automation, reporting, and cost tooling.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD).
* Solid grasp of cloud pricing models: On\-Demand, Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, Spot/Preemptible, committed\-use discounts.
* SQL skills for querying billing data (AWS CUR via Athena/Redshift, BigQuery billing exports).


**Nice To Have**
* FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) certification.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Experience with FinOps platforms (CloudHealth, Cloudability/Apptio, Spot.io, Vantage, Kubecost).
* Exposure to multi\-cloud or hybrid\-cloud cost optimisation.
* Understanding of SaaS unit economics (cost per customer, cost per transaction, gross margin impact).


 This job was posted by Malavika Kannoth from ZOOP.

title: Manager-FP&A
description:
****Who We Are****
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

****About This Role****
 We are seeking an Opex \& Capex Financial Analyst to support the Vodafone Business International (VBI) function in managing opex and capex budgets. The individual will play a critical role in delivering high\-quality financial reporting, analysis, forecasting and insights by partnering with regional finance teams and cross\-functional stakeholders. This position suits someone who is analytical, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working with complex data across a fast\-paced and collaborative environment.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Manage, review and report monthly opex and capex within defined timelines, ensuring accuracy and adherence to financial controls
* Partner with FinOps teams to deliver timely and accurate month\-end results
* Provide variance analysis, commentary and insights to explain performance and inform business decision‑making
* Act as a financial translator for business leads by presenting clear commercial and analytical narratives
* Deliver baseline forecasting, working closely with regional teams such as HR and Sales
* Support annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, gap tracking and performance challenge discussions with business leads
* Handle large data sets from multiple systems, ensuring accuracy while meeting tight deadlines
* Independently manage multiple priorities and maintain strong stakeholder engagement across levels


****Who You Are****
* Experienced in operating within a multi\-functional, complex matrix environment
* Curious, collaborative and someone who challenges traditional approaches to drive better ways of working
* Skilled at engaging with senior and non\-financial stakeholders, with the ability to simplify complex financial concepts
* Proactive with experience driving change and implementing process improvements or complex financial projects
* Strong analytical thinker with financial modelling experience and exceptional attention to detail
* CA/CWA qualified (or equivalent) with 5–10 years of experience in Finance or Commercial analysis
* Proficient in Advanced Excel, SAP, Power BI and financial planning systems
* Clear and articulate communicator, both in writing and verbally


**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

****What's In It For You****
 At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Opportunity to collaborate with global finance teams across APAC and the Americas
* Exposure to international business operations and end‑to‑end financial planning cycles
* Scope to contribute to process transformation and efficiency improvements
* A role that strengthens stakeholder management, analytical reasoning, and strategic thinking capabilities


****What Skills You Will Learn****
* Advanced financial modelling and forecasting techniques
* Cross\-regional stakeholder engagement and business partnering
* Use of enterprise finance tools such as SAP and Power BI in complex environments
* Enhanced skills in articulating financial insights for non\-finance audiences
* Experience driving process excellence and influencing business outcomes

 Date: Sep 19, 2026

 Pune, IN
   

  

 YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
   

  

 At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
   

  

**We are looking forward to hire Master Data Management (MDM) Professionals in the following areas :**
**Experience Level 4\+ Years**
**Job Title: MDM Quality Engineer / Test Engineer –**
****Role Overview****
 We're looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Engineer with experience in Master Data Management testing to ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our MDM platform. You'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies across data models, integrations, match \& merge rules, workflows, and data quality processes — ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent, and fit for business use.
   

  

****Key Responsibilities****
* Design, develop, and execute test strategies and test plans for MDM implementations, including unit, functional, integration, regression, and performance testing.
* Validate Reltio data models, entity configurations, relationships, attributes, and reference data for accuracy and completeness.
* Test match \& merge rules, survivorship logic, and deduplication processes to ensure golden record quality meets business expectations.
* Validate integration pipelines (batch and real\-time) between Reltio and source/target systems (ERP, CRM, data lakes, APIs) for data accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
* Perform data quality testing — profiling, validation, and reconciliation — across source systems and the Reltio MDM hub.
* Test Reltio workflows, business rules, stewardship processes, and exception handling scenarios.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts for regression and data validation testing using tools such as Python, SQL, or Selenium.
* Perform API testing of Reltio REST APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or similar.
* Conduct performance and load testing on Reltio integrations and platform configurations.
* Log, track, and manage defects through the full lifecycle using JIRA or similar tools, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution.
* Collaborate with business analysts, data stewards, and developers to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.
* Validate data migration activities — pre\-migration, mid\-migration, and post\-migration — ensuring data integrity and completeness.
* Participate in UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and support business stakeholders during testing cycles.
* Develop and maintain test documentation including test cases, test scripts, test data, and test summary reports.
* Contribute to the definition and enforcement of QA best practices within MDM projects.


****Required Skills \& Experience****
* 3\+ years of experience in software or data quality engineering, with at least 1–2 years of exposure to MDM platforms (Reltio preferred, or Informatica MDM, Semarchy, SAP MDG, Stibo STEP, or similar).
* Hands\-on understanding of Reltio MDM concepts — entities, relationships, match \& merge, survivorship, hierarchies, and workflows — sufficient to design meaningful test cases.
* Strong SQL skills for data validation, reconciliation, and querying across relational/cloud databases.
* Experience testing REST APIs using Postman, REST Assured, or similar API testing tools.
* Experience with test management tools (JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
* Familiarity with ETL/integration testing (validating data pipelines, transformation logic, and data flow accuracy).
* Experience with data quality testing concepts — completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to define test scenarios from complex business and data requirements.
* Good understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience working within sprint\-based delivery teams.


****Preferred Qualifications****
* Experience with test automation frameworks (Selenium, PyTest, or similar) and scripting in Python or Groovy.
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (JMeter, Gatling, or similar) for MDM and integration pipelines.
* Reltio platform certification or formal training is a plus.
* Experience testing Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP data platforms integrated with Reltio.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) for automated testing workflows.
* Experience with data migration testing in large\-scale MDM implementation projects.
* Knowledge of data privacy/compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA) and their impact on data quality and testing requirements.
* Experience in industries such as Manufacturing, life sciences, healthcare, retail, or financial services.


**Key Competencies**
* Meticulous attention to detail and strong data analytical mindset.
* Ability to understand complex data relationships and identify edge cases in match/merge scenarios.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills to work across data engineering, business, and architecture teams.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple test deliverables across concurrent project tracks.
* Proactive in identifying risks, raising issues early, and proposing pragmatic testing solutions.

title: Principal, Enterprise Arch
description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

 The Principal Enterprise Architect is responsible for defining and advancing architecture for Global Engineering. The candidate will be a key member of the Global Engineering Architecture team whose collective responsibility is to enable system development through aligned enterprise strategies, roadmaps, golden paths, reference architectures, design patterns, standards, and governance frameworks. This role will partner with executives, enterprise architects, solution architects, application development teams, platform engineering, data, security, and the business. Must demonstrate a proven history of shaping large\-scale technology solutions that address the business objectives of a complex global organization. Ensures that business strategy, market trends, technology evolution, and AI\-enabled opportunities are effectively represented in the organization’s systems, platforms, data architecture, and business processes. Analyzes architectural requirements, defines the vision and target\-state architecture, assesses the current state, establishes transformation roadmaps, governs the project portfolio, and partners with solution architects and engineers to realize the target state.
   

  

 This individual must be delivery\-oriented, enterprise\-minded, and able to influence across senior business, technology, risk, security, and engineering audiences. Must be able to guide strategic direction and make pragmatic decisions that optimize business value, engineering velocity, resiliency, cost, security, regulatory expectations, and risk. Identify reusable platforms, shared engineering capabilities, overlapping functions, and opportunities to converge on standards in order to improve efficiency, quality, developer experience, and time to value across Global Engineering. The preferred candidate will have a broad background in enterprise architecture, application development, cloud\-native delivery, integration, data architecture, AI\-enabled solutions, platform engineering, security, and architecture governance. Must be able to work independently to solve complex problems, create and manage technology roadmaps, and collaborate effectively with a diverse set of partners.
   

  

**Knowledge / Skills**
* Previous or current hands\-on software development experience using modern application development frameworks such as Java/Spring, JavaScript/ReactJS, APIs, cloud\-native services, and engineering automation.
* Significant experience with enterprise architecture patterns, architecture governance, capability modeling, target\-state definition, and enterprise architecture best practices.
* Hands on experience designing and building of cloud\-native architectures; preference using Azure, AWS, Tanzu, and/or Kubernetes
* Deep knowledge of API and microservice style architectures
* Experience shaping AI\-enabled architecture strategies, including generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, model lifecycle management, prompt and context engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and integration of AI capabilities into enterprise platforms.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI, AI risk management, model governance, explainability, data privacy, security controls, regulatory considerations, and production observability for AI\-enabled systems.
* Experience using API Management Platforms and Storefronts (e.g. APIGEE, Software AG, etc)
* Experience using Kafka, Solace, and/or MQ for messaging/event streaming
* Deep knowledge of architecture frameworks such as TOGAF and/or Zachman, with the ability to apply frameworks pragmatically across business, application, data, technology, security, cloud, and AI architecture domains.
* Experience with SQL, NoSQL, data platforms, metadata, data quality, lineage, and governance capabilities required to support analytics, AI, and enterprise\-scale decisioning; e.g. Oracle, Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server, Mongo, data lakehouse, and cloud data services.
* Knowledge of software development methodologies and tools such as Agile, product\-oriented delivery, Github, GH Copilot, ADO Boards, Maven/Gradle, CI/CD (Actions), MLOps, LLMOps, and architecture\-as\-code practices.
* Experience with DevOps best practices and toolchain / pipeline automation, Azure DevOps and Atlassian Suite preferred
* Knowledge of the financial services industry and in particular, a broad and deep understanding of products and services provided by Northern Trust.
* Has an understanding of Global Engineering domains, enterprise platforms, software delivery practices, developer experience, cloud enablement, integration, data, security, and operational resiliency in a large financial services environment.
* Strong knowledge of security frameworks and controls.


**Major Duties**
* Define enterprise architecture strategies and target\-state roadmaps that provide business value while reducing complexity, technical debt, operational risk, and duplicated capabilities.
* Mediate conflicting priorities to drive optimal solutions.
* Identify and escalate duplication of effort, functional and technical redundancy, and opportunities to reuse Global Engineering platforms, standards, and shared enterprise capabilities.
* Create reference architectures and reusable patterns for common archetypes, including web, microservice, mobile, third\-party platforms, cloud\-native services, data platforms, AI\-enabled applications, and automation solutions.
* Quickly build proof of concept prototypes with new technologies being researched.
* Establish AI architecture guardrails, responsible AI design patterns, model governance expectations, data readiness criteria, and production readiness standards for AI\-enabled solutions.
* Partner with platform engineering, data, security, risk, and application teams to integrate AI capabilities safely into enterprise platforms and business processes.
* Enable the development organization by creating working examples
* Create cloud, platform, data, and AI\-related frameworks that embed non\-functional requirements, including resiliency, observability, security, privacy, performance, scalability, cost management, and operational supportability.
* Define cloud, platform engineering, DevSecOps, data, and AI delivery best practices for Global Engineering.
* Training technologists and provide project\-based consulting/expertise
* Liaise with Enterprise Architecture, Global Engineering, Security, Data, Risk, Infrastructure, and application delivery groups to align architecture direction and execution.
* Solve problems collaboratively.
* Act as a subject matter expert on technologies and trends in enterprise architecture, cloud, platform engineering, middleware, data, security, infrastructure, generative AI, and AI\-enabled automation.


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 12\+ years of technology experience across application development, engineering, architecture, platform, data, cloud, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 8\+ years of enterprise, solution, domain, or platform architecture experience, with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and govern architecture decisions at scale.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI, data, automation, cloud, and platform architecture concepts to enterprise transformation, including responsible AI and AI governance considerations.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; MBA or Master’s degree preferred


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. ****Title And Summary****

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

 The Global Business Service Center (GBSC) is looking for a Manager for their Transaction Services team to deliver end\-to\-end support across the Procure\-to\-Pay lifecycle and oversee corporate card administration programs, including Travel \& Entertainment (T\&E), Purchasing Cards (P\-Cards), and B2B payment solutions. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, and a natural problem solver.
   

  

 Role
   

  

**In This Position, You Will:**
* Administer and support Mastercard's corporate card programs, including Travel \& Entertainment (T\&E), Purchasing Card (P\-Card), and B2B payment solutions, ensuring compliance with company policies and driving an optimal cardholder experience.
* Partner with cardholders, managers, banks, and internal stakeholders to resolve card program inquiries, support audits, manage exceptions, and identify opportunities to increase card adoption and program effectiveness.
* Ensure new suppliers are onboarded efficiently and timely with proper due diligence and risk assessments completed.
* Monitor PO spend and proactively submit requests to add funds to POs as needed.
