* Possess a deep understanding of the Procure\-to\-Pay lifecycle and supplier management processes.
* Have experience administering corporate card programs, including Travel \& Entertainment (T\&E), Purchasing Cards (P\-Cards), and B2B payment solutions, with a strong understanding of card controls, policy compliance, expense management, and payment optimization strategies.
* Have excellent customer service skills, understand the customer journey, and advocate for process improvements that benefit both customers and operational teams.
* Work effectively across functions to drive resolution, maintain customer satisfaction, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. You turn problems into opportunities.
* Be skilled at explaining technical and process\-related issues succinctly and clearly.
* Have experience with ERP and expense management platforms such as Coupa, Oracle (R12/Fusion), Concur, or similar systems (preferred).
* Demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to identify trends, manage risk, and provide actionable recommendations to stakeholders.
* Be highly organized, self\-motivated, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

title: Lead Engineer - Digital Design
description:
**What You’ll Do**
 The Lead Engineer will provide technical leadership in defining and executing the Digital Design technology strategy, driving capability development to support the Digital Engineering organizations vision of achieving zero engineering lead time. Primary responsibility of this role is to lead the development of the Digital Design technology roadmap and align it with the needs of key business stakeholders.
   

  

 The individual will be expected to collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams within the Modeling \& Simulation organization, as well as with product stakeholders, to develop and deploy impactful Digital Design solutions that support key NPI and NTI programs. The role also requires identifying emerging technologies, fostering innovation, and ensuring successful adoption of digital engineering capabilities across the organization.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities Would Include**
* Lead Digital Design Deployment for Strategic Programs


 Serve as the Technical Lead/Project Lead for Digital Design solution development and deployment across key NPI/NTI programs. Drive initiatives that enable 2x engineering design speed, reduce product development costs, and support Product Line strategic objectives.
   

  

* Drive Advanced AI/ML Capability Development


 Lead capability development programs focused on applying advanced AI and Machine Learning techniques in engineering, including Scientific Machine Learning (SciML), Generative AI, Reduced Order Modeling (ROM), and AI\-enabled vertical integration of engineering models.

 Partner with business and technology leadership teams to define and execute the long\-term Digital Design technology roadmap. Key focus areas include: Multi\-Objective and Multi\-Disciplinary Design Optimization (MDO), AI/ML and SciML\-based hybrid models, Geometric Deep Learning, Generative Design, RAG and LLM\-based workflows for Engineering and RFQ processes

 Continuously monitor and evaluate emerging advancements in AI/ML for physics\-based engineering applications. Identify, assess, and facilitate adoption of relevant technologies that create competitive advantages for Eaton.

 Lead the implementation of DFSS methodologies within Digital Design initiatives for NPI programs. Mentor teams, support Green Belt reviews, and promote data\-driven decision\-making to improve project outcomes.
   

  

* Foster a Culture of Continuous Improvement


 Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on improving Cost, Quality, and Schedule performance through effective application of ECIS tools, methodologies, and best practices.
   

  

* Mentor and Develop Engineering Talent


 Coach and mentor engineers to ensure high\-quality technical execution, foster innovation, and accelerate professional growth within the team.
   

  

* Build and Strengthen the Digital Design Ecosystem


 Represent Eaton in external forums, industry conferences, and technology consortiums. Establish and nurture collaborations with ecosystem partners, research institutions, and universities to accelerate innovation and capability development.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Masters degree in Engineering

* Experience building Agentic AI, LLM, and RAG\-based solutions using Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Vector Databases, and Knowledge Graphs to automate engineering processes.

title: Community Outreach Coordinator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Health Within Reach Foundation is a non\-profit Section 8 company dedicated to expanding access to quality healthcare for people who currently cannot benefit from existing services. The organization focuses on reaching powerless and resource\-limited communities that face barriers related to distance, poverty, or conflict. Using mobile healthcare infrastructure and technology, Health Within Reach Foundation delivers care directly to individuals’ doorsteps in rural, remote, and underserved urban areas. The team works to bridge access gaps so that essential healthcare becomes practical and attainable for those who need it most. This mission\-driven environment offers opportunities for professionals who want their work to have measurable social impact.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Community Outreach Coordinator is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Pune Division. This position is responsible for planning and executing outreach initiatives that connect underserved communities with the foundation’s mobile healthcare services. Day\-to\-day tasks include organizing community events, coordinating with local leaders and partner organizations, managing volunteer activities, and conducting field visits to identify healthcare needs. The coordinator will develop and distribute informational materials, maintain accurate records of outreach efforts, and gather feedback from community members to improve program delivery. This role also involves collaborating closely with healthcare teams and administrative staff to ensure that outreach activities align with the foundation’s mission and operational goals.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Interpersonal Skills and Cooperation abilities to build trust and effective working relationships with diverse community members and partners.
* Candidates should possess clear and empathetic Communication skills to convey health information and program details in an accessible and culturally sensitive manner.
* Candidates should possess Community Outreach experience, including planning and implementing outreach campaigns, community meetings, and awareness drives.
* Candidates should possess Volunteer Management skills to recruit, train, coordinate, and support volunteers in field and event activities.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in social work, public health, community development, or a related field are preferred.
* Experience working with non\-profit organizations or in rural and underserved urban communities is beneficial.
* Ability to travel within the Pune Division, work flexibly in the field, and maintain accurate documentation and reports.
* Proficiency in local languages and basic computer skills (email, spreadsheets, documentation tools) will be an advantage.

title: School Outreach Manager
description:
You've never met the principal you're calling. Sixty seconds in, you need them to hand you fifteen minutes of an assembly, or ten minutes of their own time.
 



  





 This job is a hundred of those calls a month, and then actually turning up when someone says yes.
 



  





**WHY THIS JOB EXISTS** 




 Let's Enterprise runs The Working BBA, a three\-year degree where the real work is the curriculum. Students run projects for real companies, do real apprenticeships, and leave with a portfolio rather than a transcript. Families choose it over a normal college with a normal degree, and that is not a small decision.
 



  





 Almost nobody discovers the Working BBA on their own. A school has to say yes to a presentation. A career fair has to have a stall we're standing at. Someone has to be the person a principal actually picks up the phone for, and then the person who shows up and makes the case to a room of students. That's you.
 



  





**HALF THE JOB: THE PHONE** 




 • Cold call schools you've never spoken to, and ask the principal or the right decision\-maker for time. Most of them say no, or say nothing at all.
 



 • Get an actual date on the calendar. Not "let's stay in touch," a scheduled slot for a presentation, an assembly, or a career fair stall.
 



 • Keep a live list of every school you've called, where each one stands, and when you're calling back. Nothing goes cold because you forgot it.
 



 • Follow up like it's the job, because it is. Most yeses come from the third call, not the first.
 



  





**THE OTHER HALF: ON THE ROAD** 




 • Travel to the schools that say yes. Some weeks that's a day trip, some weeks it's back to back across a region.
 



 • Stand in front of a room of students you've never met and make the Working BBA make sense in twenty minutes, then take their questions.
 



 • Work career fairs. Hours on your feet at a stall, talking to student after student and their parents.
 



 • Hand off every interested student and parent to admissions with the context that got them interested, so the conversation doesn't restart from zero.
 



  





**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 




 • One to three years in education sales, admissions outreach, or a similarly rejection\-heavy sales or relationship role.
 



 • You can call a stranger, get past a receptionist, and ask a busy principal for their time without flinching.
 



 • You can hold a room of teenagers for twenty minutes and actually keep them listening.
 



 • You're genuinely fine with a full travel calendar. Some weeks you're barely at a desk. Your own two\-wheeler and a valid licence make this workable day to day.
 



 • You keep a pipeline organised, in your head or on a sheet. A hundred schools, a hundred different stages, nothing slips.
 



  





**NICE TO HAVE** 




 • An existing network of schools or principals in and around Pune
 



 • Experience specifically working a school career fair or education exhibition stall
 



 • Marathi or Hindi alongside English, useful well beyond Pune's city limits
 



 • Any CRM experience, even a spreadsheet you built and kept alive yourself
 



  





**WHAT IT PAYS** 




 ₹4,00,000 to ₹6,00,000 a year, plus travel reimbursed separately on top of that. Where you land in that range comes down to how much of your own pipeline you can build, and how fast a cold call turns into a scheduled meeting.
 



  





**HOW WE WORK** 




 Small team, so the work is hands\-on and the ownership is real from your first week. Alongside the usual leave and public holidays, we fund your learning every year, give you paid days for volunteering and for looking after yourself, and let you pick a few extra holidays that actually matter to you. How you grow here comes down to what you contribute, not your degree or your background.
 



  





**WHEN YOU'D START** 




 We'd like whoever we hire to join within a month of us making an offer. Sooner, if you can manage it.
 



  





 We read that answer before we read the CV.

title: Quality Manager
description:

**Job Summary**
 The Quality Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) systems across real estate development and construction projects. The role ensures compliance with project specifications, regulatory requirements, industry standards, and company quality objectives to deliver high\-quality residential, commercial, or mixed\-use developments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement project quality plans, procedures, and inspection protocols.
* Establish quality standards for construction activities, materials, and workmanship.
* Ensure compliance with ISO standards and company quality policies.
* Monitor and continuously improve QA/QC processes.


**Site Quality Control**
* Conduct regular site inspections and quality audits.
* Verify construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, and method statements.
* Review and approve Inspection Requests (IRs) and Material Inspection Requests (MIRs).

* Track closure of quality observations and NCRs.


**Documentation Reporting**
* Maintain quality records, inspection reports, test certificates, and audit findings.
* Prepare periodic quality performance reports for management.
* Support project handover documentation and snag\-free delivery.


**Stakeholder Coordination**
* Coordinate with project managers, consultants, contractors, and clients on quality matters.

* Strong knowledge of QA/QC procedures in construction.

title: EMS and Controls Engineer (BESS)
description:
Industrial Automation, BESS Controls and Energy Management Systems
 



  





 As a Control Systems Engineer, you will play a key role in the development, integration, commissioning and
 



 troubleshooting of control systems for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), renewable energy and industrial power applications. You will be responsible for PLC programming and troubleshooting, control panel integration, communication interfaces, electrical control systems and field commissioning. This is an excellent opportunity for a highly motivated and hands\-on engineer with a strong foundation in PLC, industrial automation, electrical systems and control engineering to join a fast\-paced cleantech startup and work on next\-generation energy solutions.
 



 Place of Posting – Nashik, Maharashtra
 



  





 RESPONSIBILITIES
 


1. Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC programs for BESS, EMS and industrial automation applications.
2. Troubleshoot PLC systems, I/O, control logic, interlocks, alarms and permissive sequences.
3. Work with PLC platforms such as Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron, Delta or equivalent.
4. Design, configure and troubleshoot control panels, including PLC panels, relay logic, contactors, MCBs/MCCBs and control circuits.
5. Read and interpret electrical SLDs, control schematics, wiring diagrams and panel drawings.
6. Perform PLC panel wiring, I/O checking, loop checking and control\-system testing.
7. Integrate PLCs with PCS, BMS, EMS, energy meters, DGs, protection relays, switchgear and other field devices.
8. Configure and troubleshoot industrial communication protocols such as Modbus RTU/TCP, Ethernet and CAN.
9. Develop and test control sequences for BESS charging, discharging, DG operation, load management, backup power and energy optimization.
10. Perform installation, testing and commissioning of control systems at customer/project sites.
11. Conduct FAT and SAT activities including I/O testing, communication testing, functional testing and sequence validation.
12. Troubleshoot electrical and control\-system issues during commissioning and operation.
13. Perform root\-cause analysis and implement corrective actions to improve system reliability.
14. Coordinate with electrical, software, PCS, BMS and project teams to ensure seamless system integration.
15. Support integration of solar PV, DG, grid, BESS and industrial loads with the EMS and control system.
16. Maintain accurate records of PLC programs, control logic, communication mappings, drawings, test reports and system configurations.
17. Prepare commissioning reports, troubleshooting reports and technical documentation.
18. Provide technical support to customers and site teams during commissioning and post\-commissioning activities.
19. Follow project safety procedures and ensure compliance with applicable electrical and site safety requirements.



  





 QUALIFICATIONS
 



 o Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation Engineering, Diploma or a related field.
 



 o 4–7 years of hands\-on experience in industrial automation, PV/substation SCADA, PLC, control systems, electrical maintenance, commissioning or a similar field.
 




 o
 
 o Strong hands\-on experience in PLC programming and troubleshooting.
 



 o Experience with one or more PLC platforms such as Siemens, Mitsubishi, Omron, Delta or equivalent.
 



 o Good understanding of PLC I/O, DI/DO, AI/AO, sensors, relays, contactors and control circuits.
 



 o Good understanding of electrical and control schematic diagrams.
 



 o Hands\-on experience with PLC panels, panel wiring, control\-panel troubleshooting and commissioning.
 



 o Good understanding of industrial electrical systems including LT panels, transformers, DGs, switchgear,
 



 VCB/ACB/MCCB and protection systems.
 



 o Knowledge of industrial communication protocols, particularly Modbus RTU/TCP and Ethernet\-based
 



 communication.
 



  





 How to Apply
 



 Please submit your resume to
 **hr@rebuffr.com**

title: Sr Analyst Data Management
description:
**Job Summary**
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a motivated and detail\-oriented Vendor Master Sr. Analyst to support end\-to\-end vendor onboarding and vendor master data maintenance across Coupa and SAP. This role is responsible for ensuring accurate vendor creation/updates, completing required due diligence, validating banking details, and maintaining strong controls to mitigate fraud and compliance risk. The ideal candidate has strong stakeholder management skills, excellent attention to detail, and a solid understanding of Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) controls.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Vendor Onboarding (Coupa \& SAP): Manage end\-to\-end vendor onboarding requests including vendor creation, changes, extensions and deactivations in Coupa and SAP (ECC/S4\) in line with defined policies and approval matrices.
* Vendor Onboarding \& Maintenance: Create, update, and inactivate vendor master records per documented procedures; perform duplicate checks, validate required documentation (e.g., tax/legal forms, supplier onboarding forms), and ensure accurate capture of critical data elements.
* Bank Detail Validation / Fraud Prevention: Perform bank account validation and change controls (independent verification callbacks, bank letter/cancelled check review, IBAN/SWIFT validation, 2\-person verification) to mitigate payment diversion risk.
* Document Verification: Review and validate required documents (W\-9/W\-8, VAT/GST certificates, incorporation documents, address proof, remittance details) for completeness, authenticity, and alignment to the vendor request.
* Ticket/Queue Management: Manage vendor master tickets via shared mailbox/workflow tool, prioritize based on business impact and aging, and ensure SLA adherence with timely and professional communication.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with Procurement, AP, Tax, Treasury, Legal, and business requestors to resolve data issues, clarify requirements, and drive first\-time\-right submissions.
* Issue Resolution \& Root Cause: Investigate and resolve vendor setup failures, duplicate records, payment blocks, and remittance issues; perform root\-cause analysis and recommend preventive actions.
* Knowledge Management: Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, templates, and training material for vendor onboarding and master data processes; support onboarding of new team members.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Self\-Development: Build expertise in vendor master governance and P2P controls; stay current on Coupa/SAP enhancements and policy updates.
* Process Improvement: Identify recurring defects (duplicates, missing documents, bank change errors), implement standard checklists/automation, and partner with upstream teams to improve submission quality and strengthen preventive controls.


**Skills And Qualifications**
* Experience: 3 to 7\+ years of experience in Vendor Master Data, Vendor Onboarding, AP Master Data, or P2P operations in a shared services/BPO/captive environment.
* Systems: Hands\-on experience with Coupa supplier onboarding and SAP vendor master (ECC and/or S/4HANA). Exposure to ticketing/workflow tools is an advantage.
* Due Diligence \& Documentation: Experience performing vendor due diligence and verifying documents such as tax forms (W\-9/W\-8\), VAT/GST certificates, bank letters, and incorporation/address proofs.
* Data Quality: Strong attention to detail, ability to identify duplicates and inconsistencies, and commitment to first\-time\-right processing in a high\-volume environment.
* Communication: Strong and polished English communication (written and verbal) with proven ability to manage stakeholders and drive timely closures.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze trends, track SLA/aging metrics, and perform root\-cause analysis; good working knowledge of Excel.


**Educational Qualification**
* Graduate/Post Graduate in Finance/Commerce/Business Administration (MBA preferred).
* Certifications or training in SAP/Coupa, KYC/due diligence, or compliance controls are an added advantage.

Within this mission, our team, Managed AI Superclusters (MARS) builds and scales the infrastructure, platforms, and tools that enable researchers and engineers to develop the next generation of AI/ML systems.  NVIDIA is looking for a Senior AI/ML HPC Cluster Engineer to join our MARS team. You will provide leadership and strategic guidance on the management of large\-scale HPC systems including the deployment of compute, networking, and storage. You will be working with a team of passionate and skilled engineers across NVIDIA that are continuously working to provide better tools to build and manage this infrastructure. Ideal candidate is strong in building and maintaining distributed clusters, driving improvements, and has the ability to understand researcher computing needs.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Passion for continual learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies and effective approaches in the HPC and AI/ML infrastructure fields.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

title: PBAC Operations Engineer - RDT Identity & Access Management
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**PBAC Operations Engineer \- RDT Identity \& Access Management**
 Location: Pune
   

  

 As part of Roche Digital Technology (RDT), our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team protects the organization’s global digital assets by developing and operating sophisticated security platforms. We work at the forefront of identity governance, fine\-grained authorization, and hybrid cloud security to support users and business\-critical systems in a highly regulated global healthcare ecosystem.
   

  

 As a
 **PBAC Operations Engineer** 
 in the Identity and Access Management (IAM) space, you will be part of a global team responsible for the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of our Policy Based Access Control (PBAC) infrastructure. You will play a critical role in protecting our information and assets by moving beyond traditional access models toward a dynamic, fine\-grained authorization framework that supports our global Zero Trust strategy. In this role, you will be the technical owner of the PBAC infrastructure, ensuring it is scalable, resilient, and deeply integrated into the Roche digital ecosystem.
   

  

 The Opportunity
   

  

 In this role, you will lead complex PBAC implementations and shape the future of dynamic authorization across our global enterprise. You will:
   

  

* Architect and maintain core PBAC components (PDP/PEP) across a hybrid global landscape to ensure high availability, resilience, and performance
* Lead the transition from initial use cases to enterprise\-wide adoption while defining organization\-wide standards for policy\-based authorization
* Act as the primary technical consultant for application and data owners to seamlessly integrate systems via RESTful APIs, SQL/JDBC, and LDAP
* Drive the shift to Policy as Code (PaC) by designing automated pipelines for versioning, testing, and deploying authorization logic like software
* Own the tactical lifecycle of the platform, including version upgrades, security patching, continuous performance tuning, and managing external Managed Service Providers (MSPs)
* Streamline onboarding processes for new assets, ensuring strict alignment with global security standards, ITIL change principles, and regulatory requirements such as GDPR
* Bridge the gap between vendor capabilities and internal business requirements while navigating complex stakeholder networks across global cluster squads
* Collaborate with product managers and developers to resolve unusually complex problems and create secure, user\-friendly authorization flows


 Who you are
   

  

 We are looking for an expert technical leader who combines deep IAM expertise with strong stakeholder alignment skills. To excel in this role, you bring:
   

  

* Experience: 5–9 years of experience in IT/Security, with 4\+ years dedicated to IAM and specific expertise in PBAC/ABAC within large enterprise environments
* Education: A Bachelor's degree in a technical field is required; a Master's degree or Ph.D. is preferred
* Technical Mastery: Advanced knowledge of XACML, Policy as Code (PaC), and decentralized policy management alongside standard IAM protocols (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, SSO, and IGA)
* Development \& DevOps: Proficiency in Java or Python for custom integrations, paired with hands\-on experience using Git and CI/CD pipelines for secure code deployment
* Architectural Mindset: Strong advocacy for Zero Trust principles, prioritizing configurable off\-the\-shelf capabilities over custom builds for long\-term maintainability
* Consulting \& Analysis: Proven ability to apply systems thinking to complex business problems, conducting root cause analysis, eliciting requirements, and advising senior leadership
* Communication \& Collaboration: Excellent English communication skills to explain complex concepts to non\-technical stakeholders, mentor team members, and navigate dynamic cross\-functional environments


 Call to Action
   

  

 Ready to bring your unique qualities to Roche and make an impact? Apply now and join us in our mission to shape the future of healthcare.
   

  

**\#RDT2026**
 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation & Integration-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration\-1
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Senior Specialist, Payroll Implementation \& Integration supports strategic payroll initiatives, including mergers and acquisitions (M\&A), P\&C Modernization programs, system implementations, and process improvement efforts. This role serves as a key execution resource responsible for coordinating testing activities, validating payroll and employee data, supporting implementation readiness, and assisting with solution deployments across payroll operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 M\&A Integration Support
   

  

* Support payroll workstreams during mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and organizational restructures.
* Assist with payroll integration planning and execution activities.
* Coordinate employee data collection, validation, and migration activities.
* Prepare implementation documentation and integration trackers.
* Support payroll readiness assessments and integration milestones.
* Monitor project tasks, risks, issues, and action items.
* Assist in stabilization activities following acquisitions.


 P\&C Modernization Implementation Support
   

  

* Participate in payroll\-related activities supporting Workday and P\&C Modernization initiatives.
* Support configuration validation and business process testing.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to evaluate payroll impacts of system changes.
* Coordinate payroll requirements gathering and documentation.
* Support process redesign and standardization initiatives.


 Testing \& Quality Assurance
   

  

* Execute end\-to\-end payroll testing activities for system implementations and enhancements.
* Develop and assist with unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), parallel payroll testing, regression testing
* Validate payroll calculations and outputs.
* Reconcile testing results and identify variances.
* Document, track, and help resolve defects.
* Verify successful implementation of payroll requirements.


 Process Improvement \& Documentation
   

  

* Create and maintain standard test scripts, process documentation, standard operating procedures
* Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes and implementation methodologies.
* Contribute to payroll implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Support operational readiness reviews.


 Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Collaborate with Payroll Operations, P\&C teams, Benefits, Technology teams, Third\-party payroll providers
* Participate in project meetings and provide implementation status updates.
* Escalate risks, issues, and testing concerns as necessary.
* Support communication and change management activities.


 Post\-Go\-Live Stabilization
   

  

* Assist with issue resolution following implementations.
* Monitor payroll processing and implementation outcomes.
* Validate corrective actions and system fixes.
* Transition completed solutions to operational payroll teams.


**Qualifications**
* 3–5 years of payroll, payroll implementation, or payroll operations experience.
* Experience supporting payroll system implementations or upgrades.
* Understanding of payroll processes, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Experience with testing methodologies and issue management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis capabilities.
* Experience supporting M\&A integrations.
* Experience with Workday, ADP, or other payroll platforms.
* Experience participating in large\-scale HR or payroll transformation programs.
* Knowledge of payroll compliance, tax, benefits, and time management processes.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Academic Counsellor at Toprankers Pune
description:
**ABOUT TOPRANKERS** 




 Toprankers is India’s most preferred digital learning platform for careers beyond engineering and medicine. With a mission to “unlock every learner’s true potential”, we provide curated learning experiences across domains like Law, Management, Design, Judiciary, and more. Through our brands such as Judiciary Gold, Creative Edge, Supergrads, LegalEdge, and Toprankers School of Law, we empower students with personalized learning, best\-in\-class educators, and a tech\-driven ecosystem.
 



 We are trusted by over 3 million aspirants and are rapidly expanding to redefine the way India prepares for competitive exams and careers.
 



  





**JOB OVERVIEW** 




 We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Academic Counsellor to join our team. The primary responsibility of the Academic Counsellor will be to engage with students, understand their educational aspirations, and guide them through the process of enrolling in our various coaching programs (CAT, CLAT, IPM, CUET, Judiciary \& etc). The ideal candidate will have prior experience in counseling students for these specific exams and a passion for helping students succeed.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Student Counseling** 
 : Interact with prospective students and their families to understand their academic goals and recommend appropriate courses and coaching programs (CAT, CLAT, IPM, CUET, Judiciary \& etc).
 



**Admissions Guidance** 
 : Assist students in the entire enrollment process, including course selection, fee structure explanation, and program details.
 



**Lead Conversion:** 
 Follow up with leads, convert inquiries into enrollments by addressing their concerns, and providing them with the right information to make informed decisions.
 



**Performance Tracking:** 
 Maintain records of student inquiries, applications, and conversions. Ensure timely follow\-ups and track the progress of leads.
 



**Student Engagement:** 
 Build and maintain relationships with students to ensure a positive counseling experience and increase student retention.
 



**Information Sharing:** 
 Stay updated on exam details, course offerings, and admission timelines related to CAT, CLAT, IPM, Judiciary and CUET to effectively counsel students.
 



**Feedback and Reporting:** 
 Provide feedback to the management team on student concerns, market trends, and competitor analysis.
 



  





**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS** 




**Experience** 
 : 0\-5 years of experience in academic counseling, preferably with a focus on competitive exams like CAT, CLAT, IPM, CUET, Design \& Judiciary.
 



**Educational Background** 
 : A Bachelor's degree in any discipline (preferably in education, psychology, or business).
 



**Strong Communication Skills:** 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to articulate complex information clearly and concisely to students and parents.
 



**Counseling Expertise:** 
 Experience in understanding student needs, guiding them through course selection, and addressing their academic concerns.
 



**Sales and Conversion Skills** 
 : Ability to follow up with leads, convert inquiries into enrollments, and meet enrollment targets.
 



**Customer\-Centric Approach:** 
 Empathy towards students' academic challenges and a strong desire to help them succeed.
 



**Problem\-Solving Abilities** 
 : Strong analytical skills to handle student concerns and provide effective solutions.
 



**Knowledge of Exams:** 
 In\-depth understanding of CAT, CLAT, IPM, and CUET exams, including their syllabi, eligibility criteria, and application processes.
 



  





**PREFERRED SKILLS** 




 Experience in working with EdTech companies or educational institutes.
 



 Knowledge of digital tools used for counseling and lead management (CRM software, etc.).

The work goes out daily, to millions of people, on channels the audience is genuinely obsessed with.We are hiring hard because the demand in front of us is bigger than the team that exists.
 




  






 🎬 Role Description
 




  






 Full\-time, fully remote, anywhere in India.You'll own animation on complete stories. Not a shot, not a task in someone else's file — the animation of a whole video, start to finish, paired with a dedicated lighting artist who renders it and a lead who reviews your work.
 




  






 📅 A typical week
 




  






 One morning check\-in with your production manager. That's the only standing meeting.
 





 You animate. Layout, body, expressions, lip sync, camera.
 





 Your lead reviews before publish. Notes come back the same day.
 





 Your lighting artist takes it from viewport to final render.
 





 You work whatever hours suit you. Several of our best artists work at night. We staff leads across time zones so you're never blocked waiting for a review.

 Render farm access. Your laptop is not the render machine. Renders don't eat your week.
 





 A render assistance team for anyone on a slower system.
 





 An asset and environment library — models, rigs, environments, ready to pull. We buy what we don't have.
 





 Blender add\-ons built in\-house for texture, file and character optimisation, lighting presets, and cloth, hair and blink passes.
 





 A named lead who reviews your work and unblocks you, not a queue.
 





 A 200\+ artist Discord where people actually answer.

 We pay per finished minute, published openly, in three tiers. Your tier is set by the quality of your work and reviewed every month — not by how long you've been here.
 





 Tier 3 — ₹4,000 per finished minute At 8–10 minutes a month, that's ₹32,000–₹40,000\. You get a lead whose job is to push you to Tier 2\.

 Plus a quality bonus on every video that clears our animation guidelines.
 




  






 Two things worth saying plainly.
 




  






 None of our leads earns less than ₹1,50,000 a month. Several of them joined as artists within the last few months. We promote on quality and output, and we promote fast, because we are growing faster than we can hire.Your output is yours. We do not cap what you can earn. An artist producing twenty finished minutes a month earns roughly three times one producing seven. Both are welcome. Only one of them becomes a lead.
 





 Payments are monthly, on invoice, on time. Ask anyone in the community.

 Layout and scene setup
 





 Character animation — body mechanics, facial expression, lip sync
 





 Camera animation
 





 Asset optimisation, and keeping heavy scenes workable

 Can own a full video without being chased

title: Chemical Technician
description:
Varex Imaging Corporation is a leading independent supplier of medical X\-ray tubes and image processing solutions. From medical imaging to cargo screening and border security, our components are used by X\-ray imaging system manufacturers around the globe to detect, diagnose, and protect.
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **Chemical Technician** 
 to support our chemical processing and manufacturing operations.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\. Chemical Cleaning Operations** 



* Review and disposition Non\-Conformance Material Reports (NCMRs).
* Perform or coordinate rework activities.
* Investigate root causes of defects and process failures.
* Review work orders for correct material processing requirements.
* Prioritize and allocate work orders to operators.
* Determine electropolishing and electro cleaning process parameters.
* Create, modify, and upload cleaning recipes for automated systems.
* Monitor process compliance and product quality.
* Troubleshoot chemical, mechanical, and material\-related issues.
* Prepare investigation reports and implement corrective actions.



**2\. Coating and Plating Operations** 



* Review coating\-related NCMRs and coordinate rework activities.
* Verify plating processes and work order requirements.
* Determine plating parameters, current density, and processing times.
* Configure automated plating recipes and lead\-coating parameters.
* Prepare and mix plating solutions and specialty chemical baths.
* Support silver plating, etching, and housing plating processes.
* Troubleshoot coating defects and process deviations.
* Generate corrective action and process improvement reports.



**3\. Final Cleaning Operations** 



* Review final cleaning process requirements.
* Investigate contamination\-related issues.
* Coordinate cleaning rework activities.
* Verify cleaning effectiveness and process compliance.
* Support troubleshooting of cleaning equipment and chemicals.
* Document findings and recommend corrective actions.



**4\. Glass Cleaning Operations** 



* Support glass cleaning and nitriding processes.
* Determine required process parameters.
* Investigate and resolve process failures.
* Review production requirements and assign work priorities.
* Maintain process quality standards.
* Prepare investigation and improvement reports.



**5\. Chemical Bath Analysis \& Laboratory Activities** 



* Perform routine chemical analysis of plating and cleaning baths.
* Conduct titration, specific gravity, FTIR, and AES analysis.
* Maintain laboratory equipment and consumables.
* Prepare chemical standards, indicators, and calibration solutions.
* Record analytical results in IQS/MES systems.
* Calculate and recommend bath chemical additions.
* Monitor bath chemistry and process stability.
* Sample and analyze chemical baths according to schedules.
* Investigate unknown chemical contaminants.
* Maintain laboratory housekeeping and 6S standards.



**6\. Equipment Maintenance \& Calibration** 



* Maintain and calibrate:
* XRF Equipment
* Profilometers
* FTIR Systems
* AES Equipment
* Ultrasonic Testing Equipment
* Develop automated testing methods when required.
* Create and maintain instrument files and calibration records.
* Verify equipment performance and compliance.



**7\. Process Troubleshooting \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Investigate process deviations and quality issues.
* Analyze chemical interactions and material compatibility.
* Identify equipment\-related failures.
* Evaluate process performance and recommend improvements.
* Support corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Generate technical reports and documentation.



**8\. Operator Training \& Qualification** 



* Become certified on all chemical processes within the department.
* Train operators on production processes and equipment.
* Certify operators for process competency.
* Provide technical support and guidance to operators.
* Conduct work instruction and SOP training.



**9\. Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure proper use of PPE at all times.
* Promote safe chemical handling practices.
* Monitor compliance with EHS requirements.
* Verify safe storage and segregation of chemicals.
* Support spill response and incident investigations.
* Ensure compliance with company safety procedures and chemical regulations.



**10\. Documentation \& Record Management** 



* Maintain production and laboratory records.
* Update bath analysis logs and process reports.
* Record process parameters in IQS/MES systems.
* Document chemical additions and process changes.
* Prepare NCMR investigation reports.
* Maintain calibration and training records.
* Review and update SOPs, work instructions, and process documentation.



**Required Skills** 



* Chemical handling and process knowledge.

* Laboratory testing and analytical techniques.
* Root cause analysis and troubleshooting.

 :

description:
Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end\-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.
   

  

 We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.
   

  

****Network Support Engineer****
**The Fastly Edge Cloud Platform powers the best of the internet, and our Mission Control Program (MCP) — a key function within our broader Customer Experience organization — ensures this mission is a success through rigorous operational excellence.**
**As a
 **Network Support Engineer** 
 , you are the steward of service quality, distilling vast streams of monitoring data into precise, actionable events before they impact our strategic accounts, high\-profile digital partners, and designated strategic enterprise support customers. You are more than a responder; you are a champion of problem management and continuous improvement, ensuring our platform remains resilient for organizations within our Performance and Focus Centers. During acute platform incidents, you act as a critical advocate for these accounts, collaborating with incident commanders to ensure mitigation strategies prioritize the stability of their unique traffic profiles. Working in association with various engineering teams for network delivery and compute services, you provide the proactive troubleshooting, maintenance coordination, and focus on leading contributing factor analysis required to manage the world's most complex traffic.**
**What You'll Do**
* Distill high\-velocity monitoring data into actionable events for strategic and high\-touch enterprise accounts using the Fastly Observability platform to identify and resolve performance trends
* Lead Live Event Monitoring (LEM) initiatives for high\-profile traffic events, ensuring a high\-quality and seamless digital experience
* Manage administrative updates and coordination via fastlystatus.com to provide transparent, impact\-focused communication between engineering and revenue teams
* Advocate for strategic customers during maintenance planning to ensure early notifications and identify necessary configuration updates before implementation
* Partner with incident commanders and escalation management during acute platform disruptions to advocate for strategic accounts and ensure mitigations are targeted for their specific performance needs
* Drive continuous improvement by developing and maintaining shared customer runbooks with customized, proactive thresholds for our Performance, Focus Center, and strategic enterprise partners
* Lead the transition from incident response to problem management by identifying leading contributing factors and coordinating with engineering teams for network delivery and compute services
* Work with Advanced Professional Services to identify platform gaps that may appear as security vulnerabilities or false\-positive attack patterns
* Manage customer CDN configurations via digital channels while advocating for the unique needs of our performance\-critical accounts
* Help scale our proactive support capabilities by developing global monitoring policies rooted in high\-quality industry standards


**What We're Looking For**
* 5\+ years of experience in network and systems engineering, specifically within a NOC or high\-scale support environment
* Deep foundational knowledge of networking protocols and the ability to debug connections using cURL, traceroute, and MTR
* Hands\-on experience with Linux environments and the ability to navigate complex distributed system infrastructures
* Proven track record of maintaining composure and empathy during high\-pressure live event monitoring situations
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to tailor technical depth for both engineering and executive audiences
* Strong multitasking abilities to manage proactive alerts alongside standard configuration requests in a dynamic environment
* Fluency in written and spoken English


**We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these**
* Practical experience applying ITIL or ISO 20000:1 service management standards to drive operational quality and continuous improvement
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a similar IT discipline, or equivalent technical experience
* Familiarity with programming or scripting languages (e.g., Python, Go) for automation and data analysis
* Prior experience working specifically within the CDN or edge cloud industry


**Work hours**
**This Position Supports Our Global 24/7 Operations. Working Schedule**
* Friday\-Tuesday


**Hours: 2\.30pm \- 11\.30pm**
- 

****Work location(s) and travel requirements****
**This position is open to the following work locations ONLY:**
* India: Pune


**Fastly currently embraces a largely hybrid model for most roles which allows employees flexibility to split their time between the office and home. This position may require travel as required by your role or requested by your manager.**
**Starting salary may vary based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, shift pattern and location. We anticipate a salary of between ₹16 – ₹19 LPA for this role.**
**This role may be eligible to participate in Fastly’s equity and discretionary bonus programs.**
- 

**Benefits**
**We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings?**
**We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet your needs. Our offerings may vary depending on the country where you work and are subject to change.**
**Why Fastly?**
* We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives. Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.

title: Analyst - Credit Risk
description:
About bluCognition
 



 bluCognition is an AI\-powered commercial credit intelligence company serving lenders and financial institutions. Our platform combines commercial credit data contributed by 150\+ lenders with AI\-driven analytics, banking data and fraud detection to help our clients make faster, better credit decisions. Our product suite includes bluSense, which converts bank statements into standardized, categorized transaction data with real\-time financial insights, and FraudLens, which detects document tampering and first\-party fraud. Alongside our data products, we run a managed services business supporting underwriting, fraud review, and KYC/KYB and sanctions screening operations for our clients, with teams across North America, Asia and Europe.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for an Analyst / Senior Analyst – Credit Risk to support credit underwriting and risk consulting engagements. The role will involve financial analysis, credit assessment, underwriting execution and research, with responsibility for accurately evaluating financial and business information and supporting credit decisions. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of financial statements, good analytical and problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with structured and unstructured financial information.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Analyze financial statements, bank statements, tax documents, AR/AP aging and other business/financial documents to assess the financial position and creditworthiness of entities.
* Perform financial spreading, ratio analysis, cash\-flow and working\-capital analysis, support credit underwriting and decisioning, and monitor portfolio performance and key credit risk indicators.
* Conduct business and industry research, including verification of entity information and identification of relevant business or credit risks.
* Review supporting documentation, including commercial contracts, to identify inconsistencies, key terms and potential credit risks.
* Manage assigned underwriting cases and queues, ensuring accuracy, quality and adherence to client SLAs and processes.
* Maintain trackers, MIS and other process documentation, and support SOP, process improvement and automation initiatives.



  





 What we are looking for
 


* 1\-3 years of experience in credit risk, commercial credit underwriting, financial analysis or financial services; experience with US, Canada or LATAM markets preferred.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, ratio analysis, cash flow, working capital and credit fundamentals, with the ability to assess a company's financial position.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to work with large volumes of financial and business information.
* Good understanding of MS Excel, including financial analysis and data handling.
* Strong written \& verbal communication skills and ability to work effectively with stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a structured, deadline\-driven environment \& adapt across multiple client processes / requirements.



  





 Educational Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* MBA / M.Com / CA Inter / Semi\-qualified CA or equivalent qualification is preferred.
* Relevant credit risk/underwriting experience will be considered in lieu of additional qualifications.

title: Manager - UX Design
description:
**UX Manager \- ZAIDYN Platform**
**About ZS**
 ZS is a management consulting and technology firm focused on transforming global healthcare and beyond through data, science, technology, and human ingenuity. We partner with leading organizations to solve complex business challenges, accelerate innovation, and create measurable impact through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation.
   

  

**About The Role**
 ZS seeks a User Experience (UX) Design Manager to join our ZAIDYN UX team in our Pune office. The ZAIDYN UX team is a diverse, collaborative and talented group with offices in India and the United States. The UX team within this group owns the user\-centered strategy, research and design in support of the ZAIDYN platform of commercial, clinical, and medical products. The ideal candidate is a strong UX/UI designer with experience leading and working in cross\-functional digital product teams.
   

  

 The UX Manager is a player\-coach leader accountable for the end\-to\-end user experience of a ZAIDYN product area while building and developing a high\-performing design team. The role blends hands\-on design leadership, strategic ownership, and people management in equal measure. We are looking for someone who has 10\+ years experience as a UX Designer with at least 3 years in UX Design leadership/management. A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field is required.
   

  

 ZAIDYN is a complex, enterprise\-grade, data\-dense B2B platform. You will set the bar for design quality through direct involvement, grow the designers around you, and connect product\-level UX work to platform\-wide standards. Modern UX leadership means designing for interconnected systems spanning users, agents, data, and workflows, applying AI fluently in day\-to\-day design work, and tying design decisions to measurable adoption, retention, and growth.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the experience. Drive end\-to\-end UX outcomes for your product area, including usability, adoption, quality, and feasibility, with an explicit success metric and baseline for every initiative.
* Lead hands\-on. Contribute directly to strategy, problem framing, complex workflows, and data\-dense UI, stepping in personally on ambiguous, high\-risk, or agentic design challenges.
* Develop the team. Hire, coach, and grow UX designers and Leads; maintain development plans, run performance cycles, and foster an accountable, high\-performing critique culture.
* Enable delivery. Set team operating rhythms, ensure resourcing and prioritization, remove roadblocks, and improve productivity and delivery predictability.
* Influence cross\-functionally. Keep Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Success aligned on scope and tradeoffs; turn disagreement into documented decisions and advocate for UX with clear, evidence\-based rationale.
* Align to the platform. Connect your area's work to broader ZAIDYN efforts, collaborate with peer UX Managers on shared standards, and uphold design\-system governance and accessibility as non\-negotiable.
* Contribute to cross\-platform UX initiatives. Including our AI Pattern library and design system, UX metric collection, UX/UI process improvements, and other approaches to grow our team’s impact and delivery of successful product experiences.


**What You'll Bring**
* People leadership. Proven experience managing and developing UX designers, including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
* Enterprise craft. Demonstrated success delivering UX for complex, enterprise\-grade products, operating at both strategic and execution levels on ambiguous, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Complex domains. Experience in domains such as finance, banking, insurance, or healthcare, including data\-heavy workflows and logic\-based systems (formulas, rules, algorithms).
* AI\-driven design. Active, advanced use of AI design tools in daily work, with the ability to show how AI accelerates workflows and improves quality, speed, or decision\-making, beyond basic concept or prototype generation.
* Agentic experiences. Experience designing interfaces for systems that act on users' behalf, making intent, autonomy, transparency, and control clear, safe, and trustworthy.
* Demonstrated UX/UI skills. Candidate will have a strong portfolio showcasing impactful, best\-practice based UX and UI design.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Measurable improvements in product experience, usability, and adoption (e.g., CSAT, SUS, design\-system adherence, accessibility).
* A strong, engaged UX team with clear growth, accountability, and healthy retention.
* Effective operation as both a strategic leader and a hands\-on contributor.
* Strong alignment across product teams, with design decisions consistently grounded in evidence and tied to business and customer outcomes.

title: Product Intelligence, Launch & Adoption Lead
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
 QAD is building a world\-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real\-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
   

  

**This hybrid position requires candidates to be based in Pune with 3\-4 days of in\-office collaboration per week.**
**Job Description**
 QAD is hiring a senior operator to own three connected things: how we measure whether our products are working, how we launch new products into the market, and how we keep them adopted once they're live.
   

  

 The role owns the metrics layer across our product portfolio — telemetry, adoption analytics, value realization — and runs the operational mechanics of every product launch. After launch, you're the person who notices when usage decays, diagnoses why, and routes the fix to the right team. You'll partner closely with the Customer Success organization, which executes the customer\-facing side of adoption work under your diagnostic direction.
   

  

 This is the most operationally demanding seat on the Product Operations team and the one with the most cross\-functional surface area. It reports to the Head of Product Operations.
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

* Own KPI governance and the metrics layer: workflow telemetry, adoption analytics, product\-health dashboards, decision outcomes vs. baseline. Standardize dual success metrics across the portfolio (product outcomes and model metrics) so teams know what "good enough" means at each capability tier.
* Own value\-realization tracking: prove ROI per launched product at the customer level. This evidence does two jobs — it informs stage\-gate decisions, and it underwrites the case for continued investment in the new product portfolio.
* Run NPI launch mechanics: launch readiness, enablement materials, sales and customer success playbooks, pricing\-and\-packaging coordination per product, and the cross\-functional launch calendar.
* Own adoption health monitoring across the entire shipped portfolio. Maintain the leading\-indicator dashboard. When sustained usage decay is flagged (with thresholds defined per product), trigger the adoption response protocol within 48 hours: pull evaluation signals, value\-realization data, and field notes; diagnose the root cause; route to the right owner.
* Be the single accountable owner of root\-cause diagnosis when adoption drops. Route product gaps to the product team, enablement gaps to Customer Success, and customer\-fit issues to the field deployment team. Customer Success executes the human\-side fix; you stay accountable for the signal and the routing.
* Run PM enablement: AI\-native methodology, templates, the experimentation cadence, and the training that helps product managers evolve into operators of AI\-powered products. Partner closely with the AI Quality \& Evaluation Lead so PM training on evaluation\-writing is integrated, not bolted on.
* Standardize the intake process for user feedback, feature requests, and field signals, and own the core product\-ops tool stack.


**Qualifications**
 What we're looking for
   

  

* 5\-8 years in product ops, product launch/GTM operations, customer\-success operations, or product analytics — with demonstrated ownership of at least two of the three (launch, analytics, adoption).
* Hands\-on experience launching products in a multi\-SKU enterprise environment; bonus if you've owned a post\-launch adoption motion working with a separate Customer Success team.
* Strong analytics: dashboards, partnering with data teams to build self\-serve analytics for product managers, SQL and spreadsheet automation expected.
* Strong facilitator who can hold a cross\-functional diagnostic conversation. The job is calling the right meeting at the right time and making sure the right four humans are in it.
* Backbone, in a different flavor than the Head's. You will need to tell Customer Success leadership "this is not an enablement problem, please don't run that playbook" — and be right.
* Curiosity about the AI landscape; you don't need to build evaluations but you need to read them.


**Additional Information**
* Your health and well being are important to us at QAD. We provide programs that help you strike a healthy work\-life balance.
* Opportunity to join a growing business, launching into its next phase of expansion and transformation.
* Collaborative culture of smart and hard\-working people who support one another to get the job done.
* An atmosphere of growth and opportunity, where idea\-sharing is always prioritized over level or hierarchy.
* Compensation packages based on experience and desired skill set


**About QAD**
 QAD \| Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD \| Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.
   

  

 QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. QAD’s DEI program is driving higher levels of diversity, equity and inclusion so that employees can bring their whole self to work.
   

  

 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or local protected class.

 **Messaging Platform Engineer** 
 to support the development, operation, and continuous improvement of our enterprise messaging platform based on
 **IBM MQ** 
 .
   

  

 This role is ideal for an engineer who has hands‑on experience with messaging systems and wants to grow their skills in a large‑scale, business‑critical environment. You will work closely with senior engineers and platform leads to help maintain reliable, secure, and performant messaging services used across the organisation
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Support the day‑to‑day operation of the IBM MQ messaging platform across multiple environments.
* Assist with the installation, configuration, and maintenance of IBM MQ components.
* Monitor platform health, investigate issues, and help resolve incidents and service disruptions.
* Participate in change, release, and patching activities under guidance from senior engineers.
* Help implement and follow operational standards, runbooks, and best practices.
* Work with application teams to support onboarding, connectivity, and troubleshooting.
* Contribute to documentation, knowledge sharing, and platform improvements.
* Support security, compliance, and audit requirements related to messaging services.
* Take part in on‑call or support rotations where required.


**Qualifications**
**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Hands‑on experience working with IBM MQ (or a strong understanding of enterprise messaging concepts).
* Experience supporting production systems in a Linux or Unix‑based environment.
* Basic understanding of:
+ Messaging patterns (point‑to‑point, pub/sub)
+ High availability and resilience concepts
+ Networking fundamentals

* Familiarity with scripting (e.g. Bash, Python, or similar) for operational tasks.
* Experience using monitoring and alerting tools.
* Ability to follow processes, troubleshoot issues, and escalate effectively when needed.
* Good communication skills and willingness to work collaboratively with other teams.


**Nice to Have**
* Exposure to other messaging or streaming technologies (e.g. Kafka, ActiveMQ, AMQ).
* Basic knowledge of containers or Kubernetes.
* Experience working in a regulated or financial services environment.
* Understanding of ITIL or structured incident / change management processes.


**What We Offer**
* Opportunity to work on mission‑critical messaging platforms used across the business.
* Clear learning and progression path towards senior and lead engineering roles.
* Support from experienced messaging and platform engineers.
* A collaborative, professional team environment.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.


**Progression Path**
 Engineers in this role are expected to grow towards
 **Senior Messaging Platform Engineer** 
 , taking on deeper technical ownership, design responsibility, and leadership over time.

**Job Description**
**Job Description Summary**
 We are seeking
 ***VP Database Operations Manager***
 to join our
 ***GTI ( Global Technology Infrastructure)***
 in Global Technology \& Operations.
   

  

**Team/Group Description**
 This position operates in a fast\-paced, innovative, and globally distributed environment with On\-Call responsibilities for critical incidents. If you are a passionate technical leader with deep SQL Server, Oracle and Azure expertise, strong automation capabilities, and a desire to drive excellence within the DBMS Operations group, this role offers an outstanding opportunity to lead enterprise database strategy and deliver transformative business value
   

  

**Role Description**
 The Enterprise Database Operations Lead is a senior technical leadership position responsible for directing the database administration team and ensuring the high availability, security, performance, and scalability of enterprise database platforms across the global organization. This role combines hands\-on expertise in relational database management systems (strong emphasis on Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL in Azure, Oracle and Sybase) with strategic oversight and team management to drive operational excellence, innovation, and alignment with business objectives in a fast\-paced, mission\-critical environment.
   

  

**Applications And Business Or Enterprise Functions The Role Supports**
 Working closely within the Global Technology Infrastructure group, the candidate will collaborate extensively with various support groups, such as Unix and Windows Administration, Storage Management, and global application support teams. This role underpins support for mission\-critical enterprise RDBMS systems, that include financial trading systems, accounting, brokerage, business intelligence and advanced analytics, regulatory compliance and data governance, customer\-facing applications, and disaster recovery/business continuity operations. By maintaining robust, high\-availability database infrastructures, optimizing performance at scale, and enabling seamless data integration, the role minimizes business disruptions, supports real\-time global decision\-making, powers enterprise\-wide reporting and analytics, and enables strategic initiatives such as cloud platform modernization, large\-scale data platform modernization / migrations, and adoption of advanced data services
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Leading, managing, and mentoring a team of Database Administrators within the DBMS Operations group, including performance evaluations, coaching, resource planning, and fostering a high\-performance, collaborative culture centered on knowledge sharing and continuous technical growth.
* Serving as the organization’s primary subject matter expert on database platforms, diagnosing and resolving complex issues, establishing and enforcing best practices, and ensuring rapid, effective incident response to maintain minimal business impact.
* The candidate will be responsible to manage scalable, resilient database solutions, including advanced high\-availability configurations, disaster recovery strategies, and integration of modern technologies—in close partnership with the broader DBMS Engineering group and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Developing and maintaining sophisticated automation frameworks using advanced scripting (PowerShell, T\-SQL) and tools (SQL Agent \& ControlM scheduler) to streamline critical operations such as backups, patching, monitoring, alerting, capacity management, and routine maintenance.
* Collaborating intensively with application development, infrastructure, and business teams to optimize database design, query and indexing strategies, performance tuning, and application\-database integration while safeguarding data integrity and compatibility.
* Driving proactive performance and tuning, capacity planning, monitoring, and bottleneck resolution using enterprise\-grade tools to deliver optimal system efficiency and reliability.
* Championing knowledge transfer, technical training, and continuous improvement initiatives within the DBMS Operations group; analyzing performance metrics and trends to identify and implement impactful enhancements.
* Providing strategic technical guidance and roadmap input to the enterprise application teams on database platform evolution, including Azure cloud adoption (IaaS/PaaS), platform upgrades/migrations, and evaluation of emerging data technologies to support long\-term organizational objectives.


**What Makes This Role Unique Or Interesting**
 This role combines strong technical leadership with operational responsibility inside the Global Technology infrastructure team, giving you real influence over our enterprise\-scale data infrastructure.
   

  

 You'll gain deep expertise in advanced data server management, large\-scale automation, and modern observability/logging systems — while guiding a talented team through complex, high\-impact challenges.
   

  

 With global scope, mission\-critical systems, and the chance to shape the future of our DBMS strategy, this position bridges hands\-on operations with strategic business impact. It's both highly rewarding and intellectually stimulating.
   

  

**Professional development value of this role**
 Working within Global Technology Infrastructure group this role accelerates growth in advanced technical domains (SQL Server high availability/business intelligence stack, Azure PaaS/IaaS database services, enterprise automation, performance and tuning, Database Virtualization \- such as Delphix) and observability, while significantly strengthening leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic planning capabilities. You will gain experience leading in a sophisticated, global operations environment, handling enterprise\-scale complexity, and driving innovation in cloud and data platform modernization. These experiences position the candidate exceptionally well for future advancement into senior roles such as Senior DBMS Architect, Cloud Data Platform Lead, or broader data/infrastructure leadership positions.
   

  

**Job Qualifications (The Ideal Candidate Should Have The Following)**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Demonstrated success leading large\-scale, global or multi\-site database environments with strong emphasis on high availability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and mission\-critical system reliability.


**Qualifications, Experience, Education**
 The ideal person will work closely within the DBMS Operations group and should possess:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
* 15\+ years of progressive, hands\-on experience in database administration and engineering, with at least 3 years in a leadership or team lead role managing database professionals in an enterprise setting.


**Skills**
* Proficiency across RDBMS platforms (Microsoft SQL Server primary; Oracle, PostgreSQL, with some knowledge of Sybase \& IQ, Redis Cache experience beneficial)
* Expert knowledge of SQL Server technologies, including Failover Clustering, AlwaysOn Availability Groups, Log Shipping, SSIS (Integration Services), SSRS (Reporting Services), and SSAS (Analysis Services).
* Advanced programming skills in PowerShell and T\-SQL for sophisticated automation, scripting, and query optimization; familiarity with .NET development is advantageous.
* Strong experience with performance monitoring and management tools (e.g., SCOM, Foglight, or equivalent enterprise solutions). Knowledge in database virtualization techniques such as Delphix
* Deep understanding of Windows Server, Linux and Solaris operating systems.
* Proficiency with Cloud (Azure) technologies, including IaaS and PaaS database offerings, virtual machine sizing, disk and storage management, and related cloud infrastructure components.
* Knowledge of Splunk and other logging/observability technologies for centralized monitoring, alerting, and root\-cause analysis.
* Advanced SQL skills for complex data manipulation, performance tuning, indexing strategies, query plan analysis, and optimization.


**Soft Skills And Other Requirements**
* Exceptional communication skills, with proven ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences (engineers, architects, executives, and non\-technical stakeholders), produce clear documentation, and facilitate productive cross\-team collaboration.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset, rapid adaptability in high\-pressure situations, and the ability to balance independent initiative with effective teamwork.
* Preferred certifications: Microsoft Certified: Microsoft SQL Server\-related certifications, Azure Database Administrator Associate (or equivalent), Oracle Certified Professional (OCP), or relevant Azure/AWS cloud database certifications.
