title: Staff Engineer
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**
**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage. In this high\-impact role, you will be the primary technical driver for building secure\-by\-default features for the NKP and CN\-AOS platforms.
   

  

 You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The NKP (Nutanix Kubertenes Platform) team is building an enterprise\-grade management platform for the containerized world. We are developing a fully cloud\-native architecture designed to securely deploy, run, and manage Kubernetes clusters seamlessly across any hybrid or multi\-cloud environment.
   

  

**Your Role**
 We are seeking a Staff\-level Software Engineer with deep expertise in system security, Kubernetes internals, network security, Linux security, and distributed storage. In this high\-impact role, you will be the primary technical driver for building secure\-by\-default features for the NKP and CN\-AOS platforms.
   

  

 You will design secure\-by\-default architectures, develop Kubernetes Custom Resource Definitions (CRDs) and operators, and ensure our Container Storage Interface (CSI) implementations are hardened against modern attack vectors while effortlessly serving enterprise and AI workloads.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities.**
 Cloud\-Native Development: Design and build advanced Kubernetes Controllers, Operators, and CRDs in Golang to natively orchestrate and secure storage workloads.
   

  

**Platform Hardening, Network \& Container Security**
* Implement and manage Kubernetes Network Policies for micro\-segmentation and least\-privilege communication.
* Configure and enforce OpenShift Security Context Constraints (SCCs) and Multi\-Category Security (MCS).
* Deploy and operate Container Security Operators for continuous vulnerability scanning of running pods and images.
* Build platform functionality for image scanning, signing, and policy enforcement Advanced Cluster Security for runtime threat detection, compliance monitoring, and network policy enforcement.
* Drive platform compliance with CIS benchmarks (Kubernetes and Linux), FIPS, and zero\-trust guidelines.
* Distributed Systems Engineering: Tackle complex problems in large\-scale distributed systems, focusing on performance, scaling out, and resiliency.
* Technical Leadership: Drive architectural reviews, establish secure coding standards, and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers to act as a technical force multiplier.


**What You Will Bring**
* Experience: 12\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3\+ years focused on building scalable distributed systems, cloud platforms, or security infrastructure.
* Kubernetes Expertise: Deep expertise in Golang and extensive hands\-on experience with Kubernetes internals, building Operators/Controllers, Cluster API (CAPI), NetworkPolicies, SCCs, MCS, and related security primitives.
* Storage Fundamentals: Solid conceptual and practical understanding of distributed storage systems (block, file, object), data replication, deduplication, and high availability.
* Systems Engineering: Strong background in Linux OS internals, networking, container runtimes (containerd, Docker), and kernel security modules.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* This role combines deep platform engineering with hands\-on security ownership. You will shape how NKP delivers secure, compliant, and production\-grade Kubernetes \+ storage capabilities at enterprise scale.


**Work Arrangement**
 Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

description:

* Experience with JavaScript frameworks such as AngularJS, Node.js, jQuery, Apache Jelly, or React.
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles, data structures, and algorithms.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Experience in developing and deploying ServiceNow applications and modules including Employee Center, SAM, HAM, HRSD, and ITSM.
* Create and implement Business rules, UI Actions, UI Policies, and Client Scripts for various applications in ServiceNow.
* Develop strategies for identifying issues and gaps for various modules in ITSM and ITOM areas.

* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Working knowledge of ITIL framework and its application within ServiceNow.


**Desirable Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

+ Certified Application Developer

* Experience with enterprise systems such as Workday, SAP, or Microsoft Entra.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and service management principles.


**Why Join Us?**
 At Toll Group, we are committed to transforming enterprise operations through technology. You’ll be part of a team driving automation, improving onboarding processes, and enhancing regulatory compliance through ServiceNow. This is a unique opportunity to grow your skills in a supportive environment while contributing to impactful projects.
   

  

**What moves you?**
 At Toll, you can help play a vital role in delivering what matters. From food, fuel, medicine and rescue services, we keep businesses and communities thriving. Every day brings change. We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000\+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry\-leading training, alongside talented experts. Feel empowered to take on diverse challenges and new responsibilities to move you, our customers, and our world further.
   

  

 Are you excited about this role but are concerned you don’t meet all the requirements? If you have similar skills and are willing to learn then we encourage you to apply anyway. We know that some people hesitate to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Toll, we value a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re interested in this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly then please talk to us – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles we have coming up.
   

  

 At Toll everyone is welcome including those of all ages, ethnicities, genders and abilities.
   

  

 To find out more about us visit www.careers.tollgroup.com

title: Cloud Solution Delivery Lead Consultant
description:
**India T\&M Special Bonus:**
**Req ID:** 
 390443
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Cloud Solution Delivery Lead Consultant to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN\-MH), India (IN).
   

  

**NTT DATA Job Description**
**IDP Platform Engineer**
**Practice**
 Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platform team
   

  

**Location**
 India, offshore delivery centre
   

  

**Start dates**
 November 2026 (x2\); January 2027 (x3\)
   

  

**Positions**
 Grade 10\-11
   

  

**Reports to**
 IDP Technical PM
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 Your job is developer enablement, and it is hands\-on: you own the integration and automation layer of an enterprise internal developer platform built on Port.io. You will write the services and connectors that pull the platform's data together, build the workflows behind every self\-service action using GitHub Actions and Temporal, maintain the reusable pipeline templates and embedded quality gates other teams consume, and operate the containerised runtime it all runs on.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Integration development: Write the integration services and custom connectors that connect the platform to ServiceNow (approvals, CMDB), identity, observability, cloud platforms and the delivery toolchain, using TypeScript or Node.js and Python with the Ocean framework.
* Catalogue data: Build and maintain the ingestion that keeps the software catalogue accurate and current across source control, cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
* Workflow orchestration: Build the automation behind self\-service actions, using GitHub Actions for standard workflows and Temporal for durable orchestrations.
* Pipeline products: Build reusable, versioned CI/CD pipeline templates consumed as golden paths.
* Developer enablement: Unblock developers on pipelines, environments, tooling and automation, and make the supported approach the simplest one to follow.
* Integration runtime: Deploy and operate the self\-hosted integration workloads, such as Ocean\-based connectors and event listeners, as containerised services on Kubernetes.
* Performance testing capability: Operate and improve the k6 framework, covering its GitHub workflow integration, Kubernetes execution model and Grafana and InfluxDB visibility, and onboard engineering teams to it.
* Quality gates: Integrate security scanning (Wiz, Checkov, OPA), testing and cost tooling so the gates apply by default.


**Essential**
* CI/CD depth: 6\+ years in DevOps or platform engineering with advanced GitHub Actions experience, covering reusable workflows, composite actions, secrets and runner strategy. Equivalent platforms are fine if you are happy to standardise on Actions.
* Kubernetes: Solid working Kubernetes
* Scripting and APIs: Strong scripting in TypeScript, Node.js, Python or Go, and automation against REST APIs and webhooks.
* Software engineering: Production coding ability, not just scripting: services and integrations written in TypeScript or Node.js and Python, with the testing, review and documentation discipline that implies.
* API integration: Building and consuming REST APIs, webhooks and event\-driven integrations against enterprise systems, including authentication flows, rate limits and failure handling.
* Enablement mindset: A track record of supporting and unblocking development teams, treating automation as a product with users.
* Pipeline security: Building security into pipelines: secrets management, least\-privilege runners and service identities, and dependency and IaC scanning as enforced gates.
* Test automation in CI: integrate automated testing into pipelines


**Nice to Have**
* Durable orchestration: Temporal preferred. Airflow, Step Functions or Argo Workflows transfer well.
* IaC: Terraform and IaC pipeline integration.
* Performance testing: k6, Gatling, JMeter or Locust. Any load\-testing background transfers well.
* Ecosystem: Port.io or Backstage exposure, the Ocean framework or comparable connector frameworks, JQ for data mapping, and ServiceNow integration.
* Security: Container and Kubernetes security.


**Technologies \& Tools**
 The platform environment:
   

  

* Developer portal: Port.io, or a Backstage background: catalogue, blueprints, self\-service actions and scorecards, with configuration\-as\-code in JSON and YAML. Custom integrations use the Ocean framework in Python, plus the Port API and Terraform provider.
* Languages: TypeScript, Node.js and React, with Python for custom integrations and JQ for data mapping.
* Orchestration: GitHub Actions, with Temporal for durable workflows.
* Delivery toolchain: GitHub and Terraform, an IaC quality and security stack (Wiz, Checkov, OPA, tflint, Infracost, Terratest), and k6 performance testing running on Kubernetes.
* Integrations: ServiceNow for approvals and CMDB, observability tooling, and enterprise identity and RBAC.

description:

**Critical Incident Manager (CIM)**
**Location: Pune / Hybrid**
**Role Purpose**
 As an
 **Critical** 
**Incident Manager (CIM)** 
 , you will lead the end\-to\-end management of business\-critical and high\-visibility production incidents, ensure rapid restoration of services and minimizing customer impact. You will direct incident response activities, coordinate cross\-functional teams, and drive effective communication strategies throughout the incident lifecycle.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be responsible for owning and managing P1/P2 incidents, ensuring timely resolution within SLA commitments, driving structured incident governance, and maintaining alignment between technical teams, business stakeholders, and customers.
   

  

 This position will be responsible for incident management, stakeholder communication, operational governance, root cause analysis, and continuous service improvement. The focus will be on ensuring operational resilience, maintaining customer trust, improving service reliability, and driving proactive incident prevention initiatives in line with
 **Accelya's global business strategy, values, and mission.**
**Duties \& Responsibilities**
**Incident Ownership \& Lifecycle Management**
* Own and manage the lifecycle of critical P1/P2 and high\-priority incidents from detection through resolution and closure.
* Act as the primary escalation point for major incidents, ensuring timely engagement of appropriate stakeholders and technical teams.
* Perform impact assessments, severity classification, and incident prioritization to ensure effective response execution.
* Drive production fixes, workarounds, and mitigation plans required to restore services.


**Incident Coordination \& Bridge Management**
* Assemble and lead Incident Response Teams (IRT) across Engineering, Cloud Operations, Infrastructure, DevOps, and Support functions.
* Initiate, facilitate, and manage incident bridge calls, ensuring clear accountability, ownership, and progress tracking.
* Remove operational roadblocks and maintain resolution momentum throughout the incident lifecycle.


**Stakeholder \& Customer Communication**
* Provide timely, accurate, and structured communications to customers, leadership teams, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure communication consistency across customer notifications, management updates, bridge calls, and service status channels.
* Manage communications for high\-impact incidents affecting strategic customers and business\-critical operations.


**Status Page \& Customer Transparency**
* Own customer\-facing status page updates for all major incidents.
* Publish clear incident updates outlining customer impact, affected services, mitigation activities, and recovery progress.
* Maintain defined communication cadence throughout incident management and restoration activities.
* Ensure alignment of messaging across all communication channels.


**RCA \& Problem Management**

* Identify recurring issues and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to eliminate underlying causes.
* Track corrective and preventive actions through to closure.

* Lead Daily Operations Reviews (DORs), providing updates on incident trends, risks, and operational performance.
* Analyze incident patterns and service trends to identify stability improvements and automation opportunities.
* Support enhancements in monitoring, alerting, reporting dashboards, and operational tooling.

* Coordinate with external vendors and technology partners during critical incidents when required.
* Ensure accountability, ownership, and adherence to escalation processes across all stakeholder groups.


**Operational Excellence**
* Drive accountability throughout incident management, ensuring timely service restoration and closure.
* Participate in a 24x7 rotational on\-call support model to provide uninterrupted major incident coverage.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, operational excellence, and customer\-first service delivery.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* Proven experience in Major Incident Management, Service Operations, Production Support, IT Service Management, or Site Reliability Operations.
* Strong experience managing critical P1/P2 incidents in complex enterprise or SaaS environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross\-functional technical teams during high\-pressure incident situations.
* Hands\-on experience with incident management processes aligned with ITIL best practices.
* Experience conducting incident triage, impact assessments, severity classification, and escalation management.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, customers, and technical teams.
* Experience driving Root Cause Analysis (RCA), corrective action tracking, and problem management initiatives.
* Knowledge of cloud\-based environments, distributed systems, and modern application architectures.
* Experience with ticketing and incident management tools such as Jira, Zendesk, ServiceNow, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Preferred Experience \& Skills**

* Experience supporting airline, travel technology, SaaS, or mission\-critical enterprise platforms.
* Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or cloud\-native operational environments.
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Splunk, or Dynatrace.
* Experience driving automation initiatives within operational support environments.
* Exposure to SRE, DevOps, Problem Management, and Change Management practices.

description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an Order to Cash Lead to oversee end\-to\-end accounts receivable activities, including invoicing, collections, cash application, accounting, reconciliations and controls. The role is based in Pune and focuses on delivering accurate, timely finance operations while driving continuous improvement, compliance, stakeholder collaboration and service excellence across global finance operations.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Lead daily Order to Cash and accounts receivable operations, ensuring activities such as invoicing, collections, cash application, accounting, reconciliations and controls are completed accurately and on time.
   

  

 Work in line with defined operating procedures, policies, SOX, compliance requirements and business partner service level agreements.
   

  

 Collaborate with Global Process Owners, local markets, Finance Operations teams and Finance Business Partners to support sustainable improvements and consistent service delivery
   

  

 Lead and support a team involved in world\-class transactional processing and business partner excellence.
   

  

 Drive process improvement initiatives by identifying development needs, analysing performance trends and supporting practical changes that improve quality, controls and operational efficiency.
   

  

 Support month\-end, half\-year and year\-end finance activities, including balance sheet reconciliations and issue resolution
   

  

 Build strong stakeholder relationships and support proactive issue resolution to improve customer and business partner experience
   

  

 Maintain a strong governance and control environment through adherence to Group policies, audit requirements and key control expectations.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You have strong experience in Order to Cash, accounts receivable management and finance operations.
   

  

 You bring sound knowledge of invoicing, collections, cash application, accounting, reconciliations, controls and compliance requirements.
   

  

 You are confident working with global stakeholders, Finance Business Partners and cross\-functional teams in a multicultural environment.
   

  

 You have experience leading teams and supporting capability development, performance management and operational delivery.
   

  

 You demonstrate clear communication, stakeholder management, governance, problem\-solving and process performance analysis skills.
   

  

 You have working experience with SAP and shared services operations.
   

  

 You hold a degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related discipline.
   

  

 You have significant experience in Order to Cash or accounts receivable management.
   

  

 Knowledge of Agile methodology would be an advantage.
   

  

**Not a perfect fit?**
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to lead a sizeable finance operations team and contribute to high\-quality Order to Cash delivery across a global shared services environment.
   

  

 Exposure to global finance processes, local market stakeholders, Finance Business Partners and wider Finance Operations teams.
   

  

 Scope to influence process improvement, service quality, controls and operational performance across end\-to\-end accounts receivable activities.
   

  

 A role that supports professional growth in stakeholder management, governance, compliance and continuous improvement.
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 End\-to\-end leadership of Order to Cash operations in a global shared services environment.
   

  

 Advanced stakeholder engagement across global process, local market and finance business partner teams.
   

  

 Practical application of SOX, compliance, control frameworks and audit readiness in finance operations.
   

  

 Continuous improvement methods for enhancing process quality, service delivery and operational performance.
   

  

 People leadership skills, including coaching, team development and supporting performance outcomes.
   

  

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
 Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

title: Script Writer
description:
🎬 WE’RE HIRING: CREATIVE SCRIPTWRITER
 



  





 📍 Location: Pune
 



 💼 Job Type: Full\-Time \| On\-Site
 



 🏢 Company: Hype Matter
 



 🎯 Minimum Experience Required: 3–5 Years
 



 💰 CTC: 7\-10\.4 Lpa
 



  





 ABOUT HYPE MATTER
 



  





 Hype Matter is a creative content company that creates viral, engaging, fun and Gen\-Z\-focused content for brands.
 



  





 We work with brands across:
 



  





 \* 🪩 Nightlife \& Clubs
 



 \* 🎉 Events \& Entertainment
 



 \* 🏠 Real Estate
 



 \* 🍻 Hospitality \& Lifestyle

 We don’t create boring content.
 



  





 We create content that makes people stop scrolling, watch, share and talk.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 🚀 THE ROLE
 



  





 We’re looking for a highly creative Scriptwriter who understands how short\-form content works.
 



  





 But this is not just a writing job.
 



  





 You will be responsible for taking a content idea from:
 



  





 💡 IDEA → ✍️ SCRIPT → 🎬 SHOOT → 🎞️ EDIT → 📱 FINAL REEL
 



  





 You should know how to write viral Reel scripts and also have the ability to direct the execution of your scripts during shoots.

 \* Write strong scroll\-stopping hooks
 



 \* Create scripts specifically designed for Instagram Reels and short\-form content
 



 \* Write content that improves:
 



   \* Retention
 



   \* Shares
 



   \* Comments
 



   \* Watch time
 



   \* Virality
 



 \* Turn trends and internet culture into original content formats
 



 \* Research trending topics, memes, creators and viral content
 



 \* Create content for different industries and brands
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 🎬 REEL DIRECTION
 



  





 Your job doesn’t end after writing the script.
 



  





 You will also be expected to direct the execution of your content.
 



  





 This includes:
 



  





 \* Explaining the script to the Videographer
 



 \* Directing models, hosts and talent
 



 \* Helping decide how a scene should be performed
 



 \* Planning the flow of the Reel
 



 \* Suggesting shots and creative moments
 



 \* Making creative decisions during shoots
 



 \* Ensuring all required shots are captured
 



 \* Adjusting the script when required during production
 



 \* Making sure the shoot matches the creative vision
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 🎞️ WORK WITH THE EDITOR
 



  





 You will work closely with the Video Editor to ensure the final Reel is executed properly.
 



  





 You will:
 



  





 \* Brief the editor about the concept
 



 \* Explain the tone and style of the content
 



 \* Provide references when required
 



 \* Guide the pacing and storytelling
 



 \* Review rough cuts
 



 \* Give creative feedback
 



 \* Suggest improvements
 



 \* Ensure the final content matches the original idea
 



  





 You don’t necessarily need to edit every Reel yourself.
 



  





 But you should understand editing, pacing and storytelling well enough to direct the editor.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 🧠 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 We want someone who:
 



  





 ✅ Thinks differently
 



 ✅ Understands why content goes viral
 



 ✅ Has a strong understanding of Instagram Reels
 



 ✅ Can write strong hooks
 



 ✅ Understands audience retention
 



 ✅ Has a naturally fun and creative personality
 



 ✅ Understands Gen\-Z humour and internet culture
 



 ✅ Follows trends, memes and creators
 



 ✅ Can turn simple ideas into interesting content
 



 ✅ Is confident directing people during shoots
 



 ✅ Can take ownership of content
 



 ✅ Doesn’t wait for instructions for everything
 



 ✅ Can manage multiple projects and brands
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 🔥 YOU SHOULD BE GOOD AT WRITING
 



  





 Different types of content such as:
 



  





 \* Funny content 😂
 



 \* Relatable content 🤝
 



 \* Gen\-Z content 🔥
 



 \* Meme content 📱
 



 \* Vox\-pop content 🎤
 



 \* Street interviews
 



 \* Skits 🎭
 



 \* Trend\-based Reels
 



 \* Nightlife content 🪩
 



 \* Real estate content 🏠
 



 \* Brand content
 



 \* Entertainment content 🎬
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 📊 YOUR SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED BY
 



  





 We care about quality and performance, not just the number of scripts written.
 



  





 Your performance will be evaluated based on:
 



  





 \* Quality of ideas
 



 \* Creativity of scripts
 



 \* Number of strong concepts created
 



 \* Content execution
 



 \* Shoot direction
 



 \* Final Reel quality
 



 \* Content performance
 



 \* Views
 



 \* Engagement
 



 \* Retention
 



 \* Consistency
 



 \* Team coordination
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 🛠️ REQUIRED SKILLS
 



  





 Must Have
 



  





 \* Strong Scriptwriting Skills
 



 \* Excellent Storytelling
 



 \* Strong English \& Hinglish Writing
 



 \* Instagram Reels Knowledge
 



 \* Content Ideation
 



 \* Creative Thinking
 



 \* Trend Research
 



 \* Understanding of Viral Content
 



 \* Shoot Direction
 



 \* Team Coordination
 



  





 Good to Have
 



  





 \* Basic Video Editing Knowledge
 



 \* Understanding of Cinematography
 



 \* Experience with Creators or Influencers
 



 \* Agency Experience
 



 \* Social Media Strategy
 



 \* Content Analytics Knowledge
 



 \* AI Tools for Content Creation
 



 \* Experience working with Video Editors and Videographers
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 💼 EXPERIENCE
 



  





 3–5 years of experience preferred.
 



  





 Experience in any of the following will be a plus:
 



  





 \* Creative Agency
 



 \* Social Media Agency
 



 \* Content Studio
 



 \* Creator/Influencer Team
 



 \* Media Company
 



 \* Entertainment Brand
 



 \* Startup
 



  





 However…
 



  





 Portfolio matters more than years of experience.
 



  





 If you’ve created great content, written viral scripts and have the creativity to prove it — we want to hear from you.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 📍 WORK DETAILS
 



  





 Location: Pune
 



 Job Type: Full\-Time
 



 Work Mode: On\-Site
 



 Experience: 3–5 Years
 



  





 This is a hands\-on role.
 



  





 You will be expected to attend shoots and work directly with the creative production team.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 💰 COMPENSATION
 



  





 Competitive salary based on experience, portfolio and creative ability.
 



  





 Exceptional candidates with a strong portfolio of high\-performing content will be given preference.
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 📩 HOW TO APPLY
 



  





 Please send us:
 



  





 1️⃣ Resume
 



 2️⃣ Portfolio
 



 3️⃣ Best scripts you’ve written
 



 4️⃣ Links to Reels/content you’ve worked on
 



 5️⃣ Your current location
 



 6️⃣ Current salary
 



 7️⃣ Expected salary
 



  





 ⸻
 



  





 🚨 IMPORTANT
 



  





 This role is not for someone who only wants to sit and write scripts all day.
 



  





 We want someone who wants to:
 



  





 Think. Write. Direct. Create. Improve. Repeat.
 



  





 If you can take ownership of an idea and make sure it becomes a Reel that people actually want to watch—
 



  





 🚀 YOU’LL FIT RIGHT IN.
 



  





 HYPE MATTER
 



  





 CREATE DIFFERENT. MAKE PEOPLE WATCH.

**Full\-Time (Payroll / Consultant)**

**Immediate / 1st October** 




**About Grey Sim Learnings Foundation (GSLF)** 




**Grey Sim Learnings Foundation (GSLF) is a Section 8 not\-for\-profit organisation established in 2013, dedicated to empowering underserved youth through demand\-driven vocational education, industry\-aligned technical skilling, and sustainable livelihood generation. Operating across multiple states, GSLF collaborates closely with corporate CSRs, state agencies, and educational institutions across three core domains: Skill Development \& Livelihoods, ITI Transformation, and Education \& STEM.** 




**Through strategic partnerships with HCLFoundation, GSLF establishes modern technology labs across Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) and schools, equipping students and instructors with future\-ready skills in automation, advanced electronics, and emerging technical trades.** 




**Role Overview** 




**The New Age Skills Trainer will lead hands\-on instruction and lab sessions in cutting\-edge emerging technologies, including Robotics, Drones, IoT, 3D Printing, and Electric Vehicle (EV) fundamentals. Based at Pune or Lucknow, the trainer is responsible for conducting practical learner workshops, supporting Training\-of\-Trainer (ToT) initiatives for ITI faculty, maintaining advanced lab equipment, and ensuring robust project tracking aligned with HCLFoundation deliverables.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Practical Lab Training:** 
 Deliver hands\-on practical sessions in emerging domains: Robotics, Arduino microcontrollers, IoT sensor integration, 3D Printing (slicing \& additive manufacturing), Drone assembly/operation, and basic Electric Vehicle (EV) systems.
* **Instructional Content \& Exercises:** 
 Develop engaging lesson plans, practical lab exercises, hardware project briefs, and competency assessment rubrics tailored for vocational learners.
* **Faculty Development \& ToT:** 
 Support and facilitate Training\-of\-Trainer (ToT) capacity\-building sessions for ITI instructors to sustain new\-age technology adoption in institute curriculums.
* **Lab Infrastructure \& Technical Support:** 
 Oversee daily lab operations, calibrate and maintain 3D printers, drone kits, development boards, sensors, and tooling jigs; handle troubleshooting and inventory logs.
* **Project Documentation \& Reporting:** 
 Track learner attendance, project\-based learning milestones, and pre/post assessment scores; prepare structured weekly and monthly progress reports for project governance.
* **Student Project Mentorship:** 
 Mentor learners through capstone prototypes and project exhibitions, guiding them toward industry readiness, technical competitions, and employment pathways.



**Desired Profile** 




**Educational Qualifications** 



* B.E. / B.Tech or Diploma in Electronics Engineering, Electronics \& Communication (ECE), Mechatronics, or related disciplines.
* 0–2 years of overall experience (candidates with at least 1 year of practical project/teaching experience in embedded systems or maker\-lab setups preferred).



**Technical Skills** 



* Hands\-on proficiency with Arduino/microcontroller programming, sensors, actuators, and basic circuit design.
* Working knowledge of 3D modeling/slicing software (e.g., Cura, Tinkercad) and FDM 3D printer operation.
* Practical understanding of basic Drone electronics (flight controllers, ESCs, motors, transmitters) and fundamentals of IoT and EV drive trains.
* Familiarity with spreadsheet tools (MS Excel / Google Sheets) and presentation tools for progress tracking and reporting.



**Behavioural Traits** 



* Genuine passion for maker culture, emerging hardware technologies, and hands\-on teaching.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts for vocational learners and non\-tech audiences.
* Strong verbal and written communication in English and Hindi (Marathi proficiency is an added advantage for the Pune role).
* High ownership, proactive troubleshooting mindset, and punctuality.



**Why Join GSLF?** 



* Deliver on\-ground impact by introducing cutting\-edge future tech into grassroots ITIs and vocational centers.
* Work on high\-visibility CSR initiatives backed by HCLFoundation and institutional partners.
* Grow your career at the convergence of technology, education reform, and social impact.

Our mandate is to reimagine and elevate the way we operate — across internal support functions and client\-facing teams — through process optimization, technology enablement, and digital innovation. ODEX sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology. The team leads high\-impact initiatives that improve efficiency, scalability, and client delivery. This includes applying principles of process re\-engineering, automation, and data driven decision\-making, as well as exploring the responsible and practical use of AI. It is a highly selective and agile team made up of high\-performing individuals who bring a deep understanding of our business, high integrity, willingness to learn, and a strong appetite for change. Joining ODEX means stepping into a visible, high\-impact role with the opportunity to shape the future of our operations and contribute to firm\-wide excellence.

You will build MVPs, experiment with large language models and AI agents, and help convert ideas into working solutions quickly. You will work closely with senior engineers, product owners, and domain experts to test feasibility, iterate fast, and lay the groundwork for scalable AI systems. This is not a research\-only role.  ▪ Hands\-on experience with LLMs and generative AI use cases

title: Security Consultant II
description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 Security Consultant owning VAPT and Red Teaming engagements across infrastructure, network, web, mobile, API, thick\-client, cloud and AI/LLM environments. The role involves identifying and exploiting security weaknesses, simulating real\-world adversary techniques, developing proof\-of\-concept exploits, documenting findings and providing clear remediation guidance to technical and business stakeholders. The consultant will also support purple\-team activities, mentor junior resources and contribute to offensive security capability development.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing across infrastructure, network, web, mobile (Android/iOS), API, thick\-client and cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Identify, validate and document vulnerabilities using manual testing techniques and automated security tools; develop PoCs to demonstrate exploitability.
* Conduct database security testing and configuration reviews across MySQL, Oracle and NoSQL platforms.
* Plan, execute and document Red Team engagements simulating real\-world threat actor TTPs mapped to MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Execute attack chains covering initial access, lateral movement, privilege escalation and data exfiltration.
* Conduct Active Directory exploitation, phishing/social\-engineering campaigns and endpoint security bypass exercises.
* Use and adapt adversary\-emulation tools and frameworks such as Cobalt Strike, Metasploit and Caldera.
* Collaborate with Blue Teams during purple\-team exercises to validate and improve detection and response capabilities.
* Perform security testing of AI/ML and LLM\-based applications, including prompt injection, jailbreak, model extraction and adversarial\-input testing.
* Apply relevant AI security frameworks such as OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS to identify AI\-specific risks.
* Prepare detailed technical reports covering assessment methodology, vulnerabilities, severity, evidence, PoCs and remediation recommendations.
* Present security findings and risk implications clearly to technical teams, management and business stakeholders.
* Stay current with emerging vulnerabilities, APT techniques, malware trends and offensive\-security research and incorporate relevant techniques into assessments.
* Mentor junior consultants on penetration\-testing tools, techniques and methodologies and contribute to internal security capability building.


**Mandatory Qualifications**
* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience in VAPT, Red Teaming and Application Security, including client\-facing or security advisory exposure.
* Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, OSSTMM, NIST and CIS security frameworks.
* Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including OSI and TCP/IP, and network/infrastructure security.
* Hands\-on experience with penetration\-testing and vulnerability\-assessment tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Nessus, Nmap, Metasploit, Kali Linux, Nikto, ZAP and MobSF.
* Ability to perform manual penetration testing beyond automated scanner capabilities.
* Working experience with scripting and exploit development using Python, Bash or PowerShell.
* Working knowledge of security assessment across AWS, Azure and/or GCP environments.
* Strong analytical, technical documentation, report\-writing and client communication skills.
* BE/B.Tech/MCA or equivalent qualification.
* Ability to communicate security risks and remediation requirements effectively with technical and business stakeholders.

description:

title: IDP Platform Engineer
description:
**Role Purpose** 




  





 Your job is developer enablement, and it is hands\-on: you own the integration and automation layer of an enterprise internal developer platform built on Port.io. You will write the services and connectors that pull the platform's data together, build the workflows behind every self\-service action using GitHub Actions and Temporal, maintain the reusable pipeline templates and embedded quality gates other teams consume, and operate the containerised runtime it all runs on.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Integration development:** 
 Write the integration services and custom connectors that connect the platform to ServiceNow (approvals, CMDB), identity, observability, cloud platforms and the delivery toolchain, using TypeScript or Node.js and Python with the Ocean framework.
* **Catalogue data:** 
 Build and maintain the ingestion that keeps the software catalogue accurate and current across source control, cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
* **Workflow orchestration:** 
 Build the automation behind self\-service actions, using GitHub Actions for standard workflows and Temporal for durable orchestrations.
* **Pipeline products:** 
 Build reusable, versioned CI/CD pipeline templates consumed as golden paths.
* **Developer enablement:** 
 Unblock developers on pipelines, environments, tooling and automation, and make the supported approach the simplest one to follow.
* **Integration runtime:** 
 Deploy and operate the self\-hosted integration workloads, such as Ocean\-based connectors and event listeners, as containerised services on Kubernetes.
* **Performance testing capability:** 
 Operate and improve the k6 framework, covering its GitHub workflow integration, Kubernetes execution model and Grafana and InfluxDB visibility, and onboard engineering teams to it.
* **Quality gates:** 
 Integrate security scanning (Wiz, Checkov, OPA), testing and cost tooling so the gates apply by default.



  





**Essential** 




  




* **CI/CD depth:** 
 6\+ years in DevOps or platform engineering with advanced GitHub Actions experience, covering reusable workflows, composite actions, secrets and runner strategy. Equivalent platforms are fine if you are happy to standardise on Actions.
* **Kubernetes:** 
 Solid working Kubernetes
* **Scripting and APIs:** 
 Strong scripting in TypeScript, Node.js, Python or Go, and automation against REST APIs and webhooks.
* **Software engineering:** 
 Production coding ability, not just scripting: services and integrations written in TypeScript or Node.js and Python, with the testing, review and documentation discipline that implies.
* **API integration:** 
 Building and consuming REST APIs, webhooks and event\-driven integrations against enterprise systems, including authentication flows, rate limits and failure handling.
* **Enablement mindset:** 
 A track record of supporting and unblocking development teams, treating automation as a product with users.
* **Pipeline security:** 
 Building security into pipelines: secrets management, least\-privilege runners and service identities, and dependency and IaC scanning as enforced gates.
* **Test automation in CI:** 
 integrate automated testing into pipelines



  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* **Durable orchestration:** 
 Temporal preferred. Airflow, Step Functions or Argo Workflows transfer well.
* **IaC:** 
 Terraform and IaC pipeline integration.
* **Performance testing:** 
 k6, Gatling, JMeter or Locust. Any load\-testing background transfers well.
* **Ecosystem:** 
 Port.io or Backstage exposure, the Ocean framework or comparable connector frameworks, JQ for data mapping, and ServiceNow integration.
* **Security:** 
 Container and Kubernetes security.



  





**Technologies \& Tools** 




  





 The platform environment:
 



  




* **Developer portal:** 
 Port.io, or a Backstage background: catalogue, blueprints, self\-service actions and scorecards, with configuration\-as\-code in JSON and YAML. Custom integrations use the Ocean framework in Python, plus the Port API and Terraform provider.
* **Languages:** 
 TypeScript, Node.js and React, with Python for custom integrations and JQ for data mapping.
* **Orchestration:** 
 GitHub Actions, with Temporal for durable workflows.
* **Delivery toolchain:** 
 GitHub and Terraform, an IaC quality and security stack (Wiz, Checkov, OPA, tflint, Infracost, Terratest), and k6 performance testing running on Kubernetes.
* **Integrations:** 
 ServiceNow for approvals and CMDB, observability tooling, and enterprise identity and RBAC.

 Hands\-on experience with Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling — Cursor, Codex CLI, Cline, Aider): writing custom skills for test automation, building subagents for coverage analysis, and configuring MCP servers for test infrastructure
   

  

 Experience with modern test frameworks and tooling (Jest, Playwright, Cypress, pytest, or similar) and the ability to integrate AI tooling alongside them
   

  

 Understanding of AI\-native SDLC practices and how testing must evolve when code is generated or augmented by AI
   

  

 Experience with test architecture at scale — knowing when to test, what to test, and how to maintain fast feedback loops in large codebases
   

  

 Ability to coach engineers on testing practices — shifting quality left and making testing a shared responsibility rather than a bottleneck
   

  

 Comfortable assessing unfamiliar codebases and quickly identifying the highest\-impact quality improvements
   

  

**Desirable Skills \& Experience**

 Background in performance or reliability engineering (load testing, chaos engineering, SRE practices)
   

  

 Familiarity with contract testing in microservice architectures (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract)
   

  

 Experience in financial services quality assurance (regulatory testing requirements, audit trails)
   

  

 Experience defining and tracking quality metrics (defect escape rate, test cycle time, coverage trends)
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Assess the engineering team’s current testing maturity during the discovery phase — identifying gaps in coverage, slow feedback loops, and manual bottlenecks that block rapid delivery
   

  

 Design and implement AI\-native testing strategies: using Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling) to generate test cases from requirements, analyse coverage gaps, and detect regression risks
   

  

 Build custom Claude Code (or equivalent agentic CLI tooling) skills and subagents focused on quality engineering — automated test generation, test data management, and intelligent test selection
   

  

 Define quality gates within the AI\-native SDLC that provide fast, automated feedback without creating delivery drag

 Create reusable testing patterns (frameworks, templates, agent configurations) that are made centrally available for use across all engineering teams
   

  

 Work alongside squad developers to ensure AI\-generated code meets quality standards and that testing keeps pace with accelerated delivery

Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

title: Pega Business Architect / Analyst - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Pega Business Architect / Business Analyst to lead requirements discovery, process design, and delivery governance for Pega Business Process Management (BPM) and Case Management implementations. Based in Pune with a hybrid working model requiring office attendance two days per week, this role will act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, translating operational transformation objectives into scalable Pega workflow solutions. The position is ideally suited to professionals with strong expertise in Pega BPM, process modelling, stakeholder engagement, and Agile delivery environments.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Lead requirements workshops with business stakeholders and delivery teams to capture and document current and future\-state process flows for Pega BPM initiatives.
   

  

 Model and document end\-to\-end business processes using BPMN, case lifecycles, and workflow diagrams to support solution delivery.
   

  

 Design case types, stages, processes, flows, and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) within the Pega Platform, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
   

  

 Collaborate with Pega architects and developers to ensure workflow designs align with platform best practices, case management capabilities, and enterprise architecture standards.
   

  

 Conduct fit\-gap assessments between business requirements and Pega platform capabilities, recommending configuration\-led solutions where appropriate.
   

  

 Define and govern business rules, decision tables, decision trees, routing logic, and escalation workflows.
   

  

 Maintain end\-to\-end traceability from business requirements through design, testing, and deployment.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 Experience of 5\+ years in enterprise IT and business analysis, including 4\+ years focused on Pega implementations.
   

  

 Strong functional expertise in Pega BPM and Case Management, including case design, stages, processes, SLAs, work parties, and routing.
   

  

 Proficiency in BPMN process modelling and translating business processes into effective Pega case designs.
   

  

 Working knowledge of Pega decisioning capabilities including decision tables, decision trees, and when rules.
   

  

 Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies, ideally SAFe, with exposure to Scrum and Kanban practices.
   

  

 Ability to create high\-quality business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, acceptance criteria, and user stories.
   

  

 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate across business, architecture, engineering, testing, data, and integration teams.
   

  

**Not a perfect fit?**

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to shape enterprise\-wide business transformation programmes through Pega BPM and Case Management solutions.
   

  

 Exposure to multi\-market and global stakeholder environments.
   

  

 Hybrid working model based in Pune.
   

  

 Opportunity to collaborate with business leaders, architects, product teams, and technology specialists across complex programmes.
   

  

 Involvement in strategic process improvement, workflow automation, and digital transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Exposure to emerging technologies including low\-code platforms, automation, and AI\-enabled workflows.
   

  

**What Skills You Will Learn**
 Advanced Pega BPM and Case Management design practices.
   

  

 Enterprise\-scale process modelling and workflow transformation techniques.
   

  

 Fit\-gap analysis and business architecture methodologies.
   

  

 Agile and SAFe delivery governance approaches.
   

  

 End\-to\-end requirements traceability and business analysis best practices.
   

  

 Stakeholder engagement and executive\-level presentation capabilities.
   

  

 Automation strategy development and AI\-assisted workflow design concepts.

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.

 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

title: Community Growth & Acquisition (Unpaid Internship)
description:
Community Growth \& Acquisition Intern
   

  

 Organization: StairlessJourney
   

  

 About StairlessJourney
   

  

 StairlessJourney is a youth\-led accessibility platform working to help people discover more accessible places across India. We identify and highlight accessibility information about real\-world places while building a community of people who actively contribute accessible places to the platform.
   

  

 Our goal is to build a strong, active user and contributor community through creative campaigns, digital platforms, partnerships, and offline initiatives.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 StairlessJourney is looking for a creative, strategic and people\-focused Community Growth \& Acquisition Intern who can help us grow our user base and build a strong contributor community.
   

  

 This role goes beyond social media management. The person will be expected to think about where our users can come from, what motivates them to engage, what makes them return, and what can turn an active user into a StairlessJourney contributor.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have some prior exposure to community building, social media strategy, marketing, campaigns, growth, psychology, communications, or a related field, and should be comfortable bringing ideas as well as executing them.
   

  

 This is an unpaid internship offering flexible duration options, creative freedom, and the opportunity to work closely with the founding team.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 • Develop creative strategies to attract new users to StairlessJourney
   

 • Identify online and offline communities, platforms, organisations, events and networks where potential users can be reached
   

 • Design and execute campaigns to increase website visits, user engagement and place submissions
   

 • Develop strategies to convert visitors into active users and active users into contributors
   

 • Develop ideas for contributor\-focused campaigns, challenges, initiatives and community activities
   

 • Create and contribute to social media strategies across relevant platforms
   

 • Think beyond social media and explore offline, partnership\-led and community\-led growth opportunities

 • Help develop long\-term systems for contributor engagement and retention
   

 • Coordinate with content, design, outreach and other team members whenever required
   

  

 Required Skills \& Qualifications
   

  

 • Some prior experience or practical exposure to community building, social media strategy, marketing, campaigns, growth, communications or a related area
   

 • Extremely creative and willing to think beyond conventional approaches
   

 • Strong understanding of how people behave, engage and make decisions
   

 • Ability to think from different perspectives and understand what may motivate different audiences
   

 • Strong strategic and problem\-solving mindset
   

 • Ability to turn an idea into an executable campaign
   

 • Good communication and storytelling skills
   

 • Comfortable researching and exploring unfamiliar platforms, communities and opportunities
   

 • Ability to work independently and take ownership of ideas
   

 • Basic understanding of social media platforms and digital communities
   

 • Basic understanding of analytics and measuring campaign performance
   

 • Interest in accessibility, inclusion and social impact
   

  

 Preferred but not mandatory:
   

  

 • Background or interest in psychology, behavioural science, marketing, communications or community building
   

 • Experience running a campaign, community initiative or growth experiment
   

 • Experience with Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, WhatsApp communities or other digital platforms
   

 • Basic knowledge of content creation, Canva or video editing
   

 • Previous experience working with a startup, student organisation, NGO/social initiative or community
   

  

 Duration \& Commitment
   

  

 Flexible internship duration options available:

 • 3 Months
   

 • 6 Months
   

 • 12 Months
   

 • Flexible working hours
   

 • Remote/online work with occasional coordination or on\-ground involvement as required
   

 • Commitment based on agreed responsibilities and ongoing campaigns
   

  

 What You Will Gain
   

  

 • Hands\-on experience in community building and user acquisition
   

 • Practical exposure to growth strategy and campaign development
   

 • Opportunity to work directly with the founding team
   

 • Freedom to experiment with creative growth ideas
   

 • Experience working on a real\-world accessibility platform
   

 • Portfolio\-building experience through campaigns and community initiatives
   

 • Understanding of how users can be converted into active contributors
   

 • Certificate of Completion (upon successful contribution)
   

 • Letter of Recommendation (based on performance)
   

  

 Expectations
   

  

 • Creativity, curiosity and willingness to challenge conventional ideas
   

 • Ability to think strategically rather than only execute instructions

 • Professionalism and reliability

title: Senior Coordinator – Agent Communication, Engagement, and Events
description:
**About The Company**
 Global University Systems (GUS) is an international education group that empowers students to transform their lives through education. We believe education drives careers, lives, and society forward, enabling a brighter future for all. Our network of 30 institutions offers the broadest range of industry\-relevant skills through inclusive, accessible, and digital\-first learning. We currently educate around 122,000 students on campuses worldwide and have 20M\+ unique subscribers to our courses. Our global ecosystem powers accessible digital learning and academic achievement.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Senior Coordinator – Agent Communication, Engagement, and Events is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing marketing campaigns, agent engagement initiatives, webinars, events, and operational activities that support student recruitment across AUA, GBC, and other assigned GUS institutions.
   

  

 Working closely with Business Development, Marketing, Operations, Salesforce, Design teams, and external vendors, the role ensures the successful delivery of recruitment campaigns, promotional materials, partner communications, reporting, and operational projects. The position plays a key role in strengthening brand awareness, supporting agent engagement, and driving both offshore and onshore recruitment initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Plan, coordinate, and execute marketing campaigns to support recruitment and brand awareness initiatives across assigned institutions.
* Create and manage Salesforce marketing campaigns, campaign administration, and lead uploads in collaboration with Business Development teams.
* Develop marketing content and copy for emails, webinars, events, WhatsApp communications, promotional materials, landing pages, and other recruitment initiatives.
* Coordinate artwork requests through Jira, manage stakeholder feedback, and ensure timely approval and delivery of creative assets.
* Organise and coordinate webinars, recruitment events, roadshows, and partner engagement activities, including promotional communications, registrations, logistics, and post\-event reporting.
* Manage agent communications and engagement initiatives to strengthen relationships with recruitment partners and support recruitment objectives.
* Prepare, analyse, and distribute operational, recruitment, campaign, admissions, and agent performance reports using Salesforce, Power BI, Excel, and other reporting tools.
* Coordinate printing requests, branded merchandise, supplier quotations, vendor communications, approvals, and delivery of marketing collateral.
* Maintain campaign planners, project trackers, and operational documentation to ensure marketing activities are delivered on schedule.
* Work collaboratively with Business Development, Marketing, Operations, Salesforce, and Design teams to coordinate projects and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Monitor project timelines, follow up on outstanding actions, and provide regular updates to stakeholders.
* Support operational processes, continuous improvement initiatives, and cross\-functional projects that enhance marketing effectiveness and recruitment operations.
* Ensure all marketing activities, communications, and campaigns comply with brand guidelines and organisational standards.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy, quality, and attention to detail.
* Perform other marketing, operational, and project coordination duties as assigned.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Events Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 3–5 years of experience in marketing, communications, project coordination, recruitment operations, or a similar role.
* Experience in higher education, international student recruitment, or a global organisation is preferred.
* Experience working with Salesforce CRM, Jira, Microsoft Office, Power BI, SharePoint, and virtual event platforms is highly desirable.


**Candidates will be required to complete an Excel skills assessment during the interview.**
**Knowledge, Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong project management and organisational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with strong copywriting ability.
* Experience coordinating integrated marketing campaigns and events.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills.
* Excellent analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively under tight deadlines.
* High attention to detail with strong problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a cross\-functional, international environment.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Timely delivery of marketing campaigns, webinars, events, and operational projects.
* Accuracy and effectiveness of campaign administration, reporting, and communications.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and timely completion of assigned projects.
* Quality and consistency of marketing materials and brand communications.
* Contribution to agent engagement, brand awareness, and recruitment outcomes.


**Other Information**
 Please note this position is only available on our Consultancy agreement.
   

  

 We acknowledge receipt of your resume for a position at Global University Systems and sincerely appreciate your interest in our company.
   

  

 We will screen all applicant CVs and select the candidates whose qualifications and experience meet our requirements. Please note due to the high volume of applications we will only contact you if you are selected to continue for the next stage of the recruitment process. We wish you every success.
   

  

 GUS is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, or religion or belief.

title: Content & Communications Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Content \& Communications Specialist to create clear, compelling, and technically accurate content across Agivant’s internal and external communication channels.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on individual\-contributor role that brings together technical writing, content and communications, and business\-oriented storytelling. You will work closely with the Marketing Lead, engineers, architects, subject\-matter experts, sales teams, business leaders, and designers to translate technical and business inputs into structured, engaging, and publish\-ready content.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong writing and editorial skills, prior experience in the IT services industry, and the ability to communicate technology concepts, business value, and organizational messages effectively to different audiences.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Writing**
* Write and edit technical blogs, solution briefs, case studies, points of view, whitepapers, presentations, and service\-related content.
* Work with engineers, architects, delivery teams, and subject\-matter experts to understand technical concepts and convert their inputs into clear and accurate content.
* Simplify technology topics across AI, cloud, data, SaaS, and digital engineering for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Ensure technical terminology, solution descriptions, capabilities, and claims are accurate and validated before publication.


**Content \& Communications**
* Create and edit website copy, LinkedIn content, newsletters, campaign content, partnership announcements, and company updates.
* Draft internal communication, including leadership messages, employee announcements, employer\-branding content, and event communication.
* Maintain Agivant’s established brand voice, messaging, tone, and editorial standards across internal and external channels.
* Own and execute the content calendar by tracking deliverables, coordinating inputs, managing reviews and approvals, and ensuring timely publishing.


**Business\-Oriented Storytelling**
* Develop case studies and client success stories that clearly articulate the business challenge, technology solution, implementation approach, and measurable outcomes.
* Translate technical capabilities into clear business value across efficiency, growth, cost reduction, customer experience, risk, and operational improvement.
* Support the creation of sales collateral, company credentials, solution narratives, presentations, and other client\-facing communication.
* Work with marketing, sales, leadership, and business teams to align content with organizational priorities, client needs, service offerings, and market opportunities.


**Content Operations**
* Coordinate with marketing, design, leadership, and business teams to ensure content is accurate, on\-brand, and delivered on schedule.
* Maintain content repositories, templates, style guides, messaging documents, and approved brand assets.
* Use content performance insights and stakeholder feedback to improve clarity, relevance, reach, and engagement.
* Use AI\-assisted writing and editing tools to improve productivity without compromising accuracy, originality, or editorial quality.


**Requirements**
**Required Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of experience in content, communications, technical writing, editorial, or related roles.
* Prior experience working in an IT services organization is mandatory.
* Strong writing, editing, proofreading, storytelling, and content\-structuring skills.
* Experience creating both technical and business\-oriented content across long\-form and short\-form formats.
* Experience developing technical blogs, case studies, solution briefs, website copy, presentations, social media content, and internal communication.
* Ability to understand technology concepts and translate technical inputs into clear, accurate, and audience\-friendly communication.
* Working knowledge of enterprise technology areas such as AI, cloud, data, SaaS, and digital engineering.
* Strong understanding of how technology capabilities connect with client challenges, business outcomes, and enterprise value.
* Experience interviewing and collaborating with engineers, architects, subject\-matter experts, business teams, and senior stakeholders.
* Proven experience managing and executing a content calendar across multiple channels, stakeholders, and deadlines.
* Strong coordination, stakeholder\-management, and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and deliver high\-quality content within agreed timelines.
* A portfolio of published or professionally produced technical, business, and communications content.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Mass Communication, English, Engineering, Technology, Business, or a related field.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience writing for B2B enterprise technology audiences and global clients.
* Experience creating thought\-leadership, sales\-enablement, internal communication, or employer\-branding content.
* Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, content\-management systems, and social media analytics.
* Experience using AI\-assisted tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grammarly, or similar platforms.

**Job Description**
 We are looking for a Product Analyst with a background in technology, or a related field. In this role, you will communicate with team members and business partners on a regular basis. The Business Analyst will analyze our requirements and design solutions to meet those requirements. You will also be responsible for testing, implementing, and maintaining software applications to improve business processes.

 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

 Define the needed business cases with project team and process owner, defining business outcomes, including current baseline and future target metrics, such as leading and lagging indicators, and linking to strategic key performance indicators (KPIs).
   

  

 Proven experience with business and technical requirements analysis, elicitation, modeling, verification, and methodology development
   

  

 Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including planning and organizing
   

  

 You will report toTeam Lead \-IT
   

  

**What We Offer**

You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
