title: Educational Consultant
description:
**About Application Ally** 




 Application Ally is a boutique education consulting firm that provides highly personalized guidance to students navigating the global admissions process. We combine thoughtful mentorship, strategic advice, and meticulous application support to help students present their strongest and most authentic candidacy.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an Education Consultant to support students applying primarily to Master’s programs around the world, with a particular focus on universities in the US and UK.
 



 This is a multifaceted role combining graduate admissions consulting, writing and editing, student mentorship, and project and program management. You will guide students through the entire application journey: from early\-stage planning and university selection to developing application materials and managing final submissions.
 



  





 You will also contribute to broader initiatives such as student workshops, school and institutional partnerships, and internal programs and projects. We welcome candidates with direct admissions experience, as well as accomplished writers, communicators, and project managers from other professional backgrounds who are excited about working in education."
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




*Graduate Admissions Consulting* 



* Guide students through the end\-to\-end graduate application process, primarily for Master’s programs.
* Help students identify suitable universities and programs based on their academic background, professional goals, interests, and preferences.
* Develop individualized application strategies, timelines, and action plans.
* Support students in shaping compelling personal narratives across their applications.
* Provide detailed guidance and editorial feedback on statements of purpose, personal statements, essays, résumés, and other application materials.
* Prepare students for admissions interviews where required.
* Track multiple application requirements and deadlines, ensuring that each application is complete, accurate, and submitted on time.
* Communicate regularly with students.



*Project and Program Management* 



* Plan and conduct workshops, information sessions, and other student\-facing programs.
* Support projects involving colleges, counsellors, and institutional partners.
* Coordinate timelines, stakeholders, communications, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.
* Collaborate closely with the Application Ally team to ensure a consistently high standard of service.
* Contribute ideas for improving student resources, programs, workflows, and internal processes.
* Take ownership of assigned projects and follow them through from planning to delivery.



  





**Who We’re Looking For** 



* An exceptional writer and editor with a strong command of English.
* A polished, thoughtful, and highly effective communicator.
* Strong project\-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple students, deadlines, and priorities simultaneously.
* An attentive listener who can understand a student’s experiences and help them communicate their story authentically.
* Detail\-oriented, dependable, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership.
* Able to provide candid, constructive, and empathetic feedback.
* Comfortable working collaboratively as part of a close\-knit team.
* Interested in higher education and motivated by helping students achieve meaningful academic and professional goals.



  





**Experience** 




 We are flexible about years of experience and will evaluate candidates based on the strength and relevance of their overall profile.
 



 Previous experience in graduate admissions, education consulting, counselling, writing, editing, communications, project management, program management, or a related field is valuable but not essential. Strong writers and project managers seeking to transition into education consulting are encouraged to apply.
 



  





**Why Join Application Ally?** 



* Do meaningful, high\-impact work with students at an important stage in their academic and professional journeys.
* Work in a boutique environment where every student receives personalized attention.
* Take on a varied role spanning consulting, mentorship, writing, workshops, partnerships, and program delivery.
* Join a collaborative team that values excellent work, thoughtful communication, and continuous learning.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Please apply through LinkedIn with your résumé or email it to anushkadesai@applicationally.net.

title: Seller Support Associate
description:
**Role Purpose** 




**The Seller Support Associate** 
 will be responsible for providing high\-quality, accurate, 
 



 and timely support to sellers across multiple contact channels. The role involves 
 



 understanding seller queries, diagnosing issues, providing appropriate resolutions within 
 



 defined processes and policies, and ensuring a positive seller experience throughout 
 



 the seller journey. The Associate will be accountable for individual quality and 
 



 productivity performance while also identifying recurring seller issues, contact drivers, 
 



 and Voice of Seller insights that can help improve processes and the overall seller 
 



 experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Handle Seller Contacts \& Provide End\-to\-End Support
 



 Respond to seller queries across assigned channels such as voice, chat, email, 
 



 or other supported channels and provide professional, timely, and accurate 
 



 assistance. Understand the seller's concern, demonstrate ownership, and 
 



 manage the interaction through to resolution or appropriate escalation in 
 



 accordance with defined processes and SLAs.
 



  





 2\. Support Sellers Across the Complete Seller Journey
 



 Handle queries across relevant seller processes, including onboarding, account 
 



 management, catalog and listings, pricing, inventory, orders, fulfillment, shipping, 
 



 returns, refunds, payments, seller performance, account health, promotions, 
 



 disputes, appeals, and other supported seller\-services processes. Build sufficient 
 



 process knowledge to accurately diagnose and resolve common seller issues.
 



  





 3\. Diagnose Issues \& Deliver Accurate Resolution
 



 Ask appropriate questions, understand the underlying issue, research available 
 



 information and systems, and provide the correct resolution using approved 
 



 SOPs, knowledge resources, policies, and tools. Ensure responses are complete 
 



 and accurate and avoid unnecessary transfers, repeat contacts, or incorrect 
 



 information.
 



  





 4\. Deliver a Strong Seller Experience
 



 Demonstrate ownership, professionalism, empathy, active listening, and clear 
 



 communication throughout every seller interaction. Simplify complex information 
 



 for sellers, set appropriate expectations, and ensure sellers understand the 
 



 resolution or next steps. Never provide unauthorized commitments, unsupported 
 



 information, or policy interpretations outside the Associate's defined authority.
 



  





 5\. Meet Individual Quality, Productivity \& SLA Expectations
 



 Consistently achieve assigned targets for quality, productivity, AHT, 
 



 SLA/adherence, FCR, attendance, schedule adherence, and other applicable 
 



 performance measures. Take ownership of individual performance, understand 
 



 performance gaps, actively participate in coaching, and implement feedback 
 



 provided by Team Leaders, Quality, SMEs, and Operations.
 



  





 6\. Follow Process, Policy, Security \& Compliance Requirements
 



 Strictly follow approved SOPs, workflows, policies, communication standards, 
 



 access controls, data privacy, information\-security requirements, and other client 
 



 or regulatory controls. Protect confidential seller and business information and 
 



 immediately escalate suspected fraud, policy violations, security concerns, or 
 



 other high\-risk issues through the defined escalation process.
 



  





 7\. Manage Escalations \& Exceptions Appropriately
 



 Identify issues that cannot be resolved at L1 based on defined processes, 
 



 authority levels, or available tools and escalate them through the appropriate 
 



 channel. Provide complete and accurate case information when escalating to 
 



 SMEs, Team Leaders, or other support teams and ensure appropriate 
 



 documentation and follow\-up are completed.
 



  





 8\. Maintain Accurate Case Documentation \& Records
 



 Document seller interactions, issue details, troubleshooting performed, resolution 
 



 provided, commitments, and escalation information accurately in the designated 
 



 CRM or case\-management system. Ensure case notes are clear, complete, and 
 



 sufficient for another team member or downstream function to understand the 
 



 interaction and continue support without unnecessary seller repetition.
 



  





 9\. Capture Contact Drivers \& Voice of Seller
 



 Identify recurring seller concerns, emerging issues, process gaps, system 
 



 problems, policy confusion, and other contact drivers observed during seller 
 



 interactions. Proactively share meaningful Voice of Seller (VoS) insights with 
 



 Team Leaders and SMEs, including seller pain points, recurring questions, 
 



 reasons for dissatisfaction, and opportunities to improve the seller journey.
 



  





 10\.Contribute to Continuous Improvement \& Team Success
 



 Actively participate in process improvements, knowledge updates, calibration 
 



 sessions, training, coaching, team initiatives, and operational improvement 
 



 activities. Share practical feedback from seller interactions, adopt approved 
 



 process changes quickly, support a collaborative team environment, and 
 



 continuously improve product, process, communication, and problem\-solving 
 



 capabilities.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




  6 month Experience in E\-Commerce, Seller Support, Customer Support, Contact Center, 
 



 BPO, or a similar customer\-facing environment is preferred.
 



  Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate 
 



 clearly and professionally with sellers.
 



  Strong customer/seller service orientation with empathy, active listening, and 
 



 ownership.
 



  Ability to understand, troubleshoot, and resolve process\-related queries 
 



 accurately.
 



  Comfortable working in a high\-volume, target\-driven environment.
 



  Strong attention to detail and ability to follow defined processes and policies.

  Ability to manage difficult interactions and maintain professionalism under

 quickly.

 performance.

title: Copilot Engineer
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Role: Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio**
**Position Summary**
 EY’s GDS Assurance Digital team designs and deploys AI‑enabled solutions that transform audit and assurance workflows at scale. As a
 **Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio** 
 , you will be responsible for designing, engineering, testing, and governing high‑quality prompts, agents, and conversational workflows that power Microsoft Copilot–based solutions for Assurance professionals.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of
 **Assurance domain knowledge, Generative AI behaviour, and Microsoft Copilot platform engineering** 
 . You will ensure Copilot solutions are
 **accurate, explainable, safe, compliant, and engagement‑ready** 
 , while delivering measurable productivity and quality outcomes for audit teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Prompt Engineering \& AI Behaviour Design**
* Design, refine, and optimize prompts for Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio to support audit, controls, risk, and reporting use cases.
* Engineer multi‑turn conversational flows, system prompts, grounding instructions, and response constraints aligned to Assurance methodology.
* Apply prompt patterns such as role‑based prompting, chain‑of‑thought structuring, guardrails, and retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG).
* Continuously test and improve prompt performance for accuracy, consistency, explainability, and hallucination reduction.


**Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio Engineering**
* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents including topics, triggers, entities, actions, plugins, and orchestration logic.
* Integrate Copilot Studio with enterprise data sources, workflows, APIs, and assurance tools in line with security and governance standards.
* Design agent routing and orchestration logic to support multi‑agent or domain‑specific Copilot experiences.
* Collaborate with platform and engineering teams to align Copilot implementations with Microsoft and EY architectural standards.


**AI Quality, Risk \& Governance**
* Define and execute AI testing strategies including prompt validation, negative testing, edge‑case handling, and output evaluation.
* Ensure Copilot solutions meet AI governance, risk management, and compliance expectations (e.g., explainability, traceability, human‑in‑the‑loop).
* Support AI certification, QRM reviews, and engagement‑readiness assessments for Copilot‑based solutions.
* Document prompt logic, assumptions, limitations, and usage guidance for audit and risk review purposes.


**Adoption, Change \& Enablement**
* Support rollout of Copilot solutions through user guidance, prompt playbooks, and best‑practice documentation.
* Train Assurance users on effective Copilot interaction and responsible usage.
* Gather user feedback and usage insights to iteratively improve prompt effectiveness and agent design.


**Research \& Continuous Improvement**
* Stay current on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, and emerging prompt engineering techniques.
* Evaluate new Copilot features and GenAI capabilities for applicability to Assurance use cases.
* Contribute to reusable prompt libraries, agent templates, and design standards across the Assurance Digital portfolio.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 4–7 years of experience in AI‑enabled product, automation, or digital roles.
* Hands‑on experience with prompt engineering for LLM‑based systems.
* Practical experience building solutions using Microsoft Copilot and/or Copilot Studio, Python, LangGraph.
* Strong understanding of LLM behaviour, limitations, risks, and evaluation techniques.
* Ability to translate complex business or regulatory requirements into structured AI interactions.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models with cross‑functional global teams.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to explain AI behaviour to non‑technical stakeholders.


**Preferred / Additional Capabilities**
* Familiarity with Assurance, Audit, Risk, or Regulatory workflows.
* Experience with RAG patterns, vector search, and enterprise data grounding.
* Exposure to AI governance, risk management, or model validation frameworks.
* Knowledge of Azure services and API‑based integrations.
* Ability to create conversation flows, prompt maps, and AI interaction diagrams.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Copilot solutions that deliver trusted, high‑quality, audit‑ready outputs.
* Prompts and agents that are reusable, scalable, and compliant by design.
* Strong adoption and positive feedback from Assurance practitioners.
* Reduced rework, improved efficiency, and enhanced audit quality through AI assistance.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**Job Description**
**Manager \- Network \& Cyber Security**
**Role Overview**
 Lead Medline's Network security \& Cyber Security functions by driving security strategy, network security operations, threat and vulnerability management, incident response, and cloud security across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments. Partner with cross\-functional teams to deliver resilient, compliant, and scalable security solutions aligned with business objectives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead, mentor, and develop the Network \& Cyber Security team by setting performance goals, providing coaching, and fostering a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Define and execute the enterprise network and cybersecurity strategy, roadmap, and service improvement initiatives aligned with business objectives and evolving security threats.
* Manage day\-to\-day security operations, including threat detection and monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, security assessments, risk remediation, and major security incident escalations.
* Design, implement, and support secure network and cloud architectures across on\-premises, hybrid, and multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP), including firewalls, Secure Web Gateways (SWG/SSE), VPN, DDoS protection, network segmentation, and cloud\-native security controls.
* Develop, implement, and maintain enterprise security policies, standards, procedures, and technical baselines while ensuring compliance with regulatory and industry frameworks such as HIPAA, HITRUST, NIST, and other applicable standards.
* Lead security governance activities, including internal and external audits, third\-party security assessments, software security reviews, certification support, and validation of security controls.
* Establish and monitor security KPIs, SLAs, operational metrics, and cybersecurity reporting to measure performance, drive continuous improvement, and communicate security posture and risks to executive leadership and key stakeholders.
* Partner with Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Audit, Compliance, and business teams to integrate security into technology initiatives, ensure secure solution design, and deliver resilient, scalable security capabilities.
* Drive security awareness and education initiatives, including phishing simulations and organization\-wide cybersecurity training, to strengthen the overall security culture.
* Evaluate emerging cybersecurity threats, technologies, and industry trends to continuously enhance the organization's security capabilities while ensuring cost\-effective delivery of security services.


**Skills \& Knowledge Requirements**
**Experience \& Leadership**
* 12\+ years of experience in Network Security, Cyber Security, or Information Security, including 3\+ years in a leadership or management role, leading security engineering, SOC, and operations teams.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, crisis management, project management, and decision\-making skills, with experience driving team development, training, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Deep expertise in enterprise network and cybersecurity architecture, including TCP/IP, traffic analysis, next\-generation firewalls, VPNs, Secure Web Gateways (SWG/SSE), SASE, Zero Trust, and secure remote access technologies.
* Hands\-on experience with leading security technologies such as Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA), Check Point, Cisco Security, Cloudflare, Illumio, CrowdStrike, ExtraHop (or other NDR solutions), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Email Security Gateways, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Identity \& Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM/PIM), and related security platforms.
* Strong experience securing on\-premises, hybrid, and multi\-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, and GCP), including cloud\-native security capabilities for IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.
* Proven expertise in security operations, including threat detection and hunting, incident response, vulnerability management, log analysis, event correlation, third\-party risk management, and defining remediation strategies.
* Extensive knowledge of security governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks, including NIST, HIPAA, HITRUST, ITGC, and industry best practices, with experience supporting audits, risk assessments, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience developing and maintaining enterprise security policies, standards, procedures, technical baselines, and governance frameworks to strengthen organizational security posture.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity risk, business continuity, security controls, and emerging threat landscapes, with the ability to align security initiatives to business objectives.


**Academic \& Professional Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline.
* Preferred professional certifications include CISSP, CISM, and vendor certifications from Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Check Point, CyberArk, CrowdStrike Cisco, or equivalent cloud and security technologies.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Global Managed Service – Privileged Identity and access Management – Senior**
 The Senior CyberArk Operations Support Analyst is a key member of the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, responsible for the advanced support and management of the CyberArk infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of PAM principles, CyberArk architecture, and cybersecurity best practices. The Senior Analyst will lead initiatives to enhance security, streamline processes, and ensure the stability and integrity of privileged account management systems
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Lead the administration and advanced support of the CyberArk PAM solution, including complex troubleshooting, policy management, and platform optimization.
* Design and implement enhancements to the CyberArk infrastructure to improve security, efficiency, and compliance with industry standards.
* Oversee the onboarding of new accounts, platforms, and integrations into the CyberArk environment, ensuring adherence to strict security guidelines.
* Conduct regular system audits to identify potential vulnerabilities and recommend remediation strategies.
* Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on best practices and technical challenges.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for system configurations, procedures, and service records.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to support enterprise\-wide cybersecurity initiatives and projects.
* Manage the response to critical incidents involving privileged accounts, including root cause analysis and preventive measures.
* Stay abreast of emerging threats and technologies in the PAM space and evaluate their impact on the organization.
* Lead the planning and execution of system upgrades, patches, and maintenance activities, minimizing disruption to business operations.
* Support compliance and regulatory activities by providing expertise and documentation as needed.
* Develop and maintain a comprehensive disaster recovery and business continuity plan for the CyberArk infrastructure, ensuring minimal downtime and quick restoration of services in the event of an outage.
* Collaborate with the cybersecurity architecture team to design and implement a robust privileged access management strategy that aligns with the organization's overall security posture.
* Lead security incident investigations related to privileged accounts, including forensic analysis, and collaborate with the incident response team to develop a coordinated response plan.
* Proactively monitor the CyberArk environment for unusual activities and potential threats using advanced security tools and techniques.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for CyberArk within the organization, providing insights and recommendations to senior management on PAM\-related matters.
* Participate in vendor management, including evaluating potential software solutions, negotiating contracts, and managing relationships with CyberArk and other security vendors.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by regularly reviewing and updating CyberArk policies and procedures to reflect the evolving threat landscape and business needs.
* Facilitate cross\-training and knowledge sharing sessions within the team to ensure redundancy in critical skill sets and promote a culture of continuous learning.
* Engage with the broader cybersecurity community to stay informed about new vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and defense mechanisms related to privileged access management.
* Influence and enforce security policies and procedures across the organization, ensuring that privileged access is managed in accordance with best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Assist in budget planning and management for the CyberArk operations team, including forecasting future needs for resources, tools, and training.


**Preferred Skills:**
* Advanced knowledge of CyberArk PAM solutions, with relevant certifications such as CyberArk Certified Delivery Engineer (CDE), Defender, or Sentry.
* Proven experience in managing complex CyberArk environments, including components such as EPV, CPM, PSM, and AIM.
* Strong understanding of network security, identity and access management (IAM), and related technologies (e.g., SIEM, firewalls, multi\-factor authentication).
* Expertise in scripting and automation to streamline operations and incident response.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Leadership qualities and experience in mentoring or managing junior staff.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non\-technical stakeholders


**Education:**
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
   

  

**Work Requirements:**
* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required

 UKG is seeking a transformational Director, WFM Implementation Services, India, to lead and scale a high\-performing organization delivering complex Workforce Management SaaS solutions across global customer segments.
   

  

 This leader will shape the India operating model and connect it to UKG’s broader delivery strategy—advancing quality, speed, predictability, productivity, and customer experience. The role partners across Global Services, Partner Delivery, Sales, Product, Engineering, Enablement, and Support to create a seamless path from solution design through adoption and value realization.
   

  

 Success means more than a technical go\-live. Customers should realize tangible improvements in workforce visibility, scheduling and labor efficiency, time and payroll accuracy, compliance, manager productivity, and employee experience.
   

  

 What you will lead
   

  

 Strategy and transformation — Define and execute the India WFM implementation strategy in alignment with UKG priorities. Modernize delivery through standardized methods, scalable operating models, and a bias for measurable improvement.
   

  

 AI\-enabled delivery — Move the organization from manual to AI\-assisted and increasingly AI\-led execution. Apply AI and automation across requirements, configuration, testing, validation, project reporting, documentation, risk sensing, and customer communications.
   

  

 Customer value realization — Establish business outcomes at the start of each engagement and track progress through go\-live and stabilization. Help customers achieve measurable ROI, faster adoption, labor optimization, payroll accuracy, compliance, and improved manager and employee experiences.
   

  

 Operational and delivery excellence — Own predictable delivery across implementation, enablement, transition to support, and post\-go\-live optimization. Balance speed, quality, capacity, utilization, forecast accuracy, financial performance, and employee development.
   

  

 People leadership and capability building — Lead, coach, and scale a high\-performing India organization. Build capabilities in architecture, governance, advisory, analytics, customer outcomes, and continuous improvement while creating a culture of accountability and innovation.
   

  

 Global and partner collaboration — Build trusted relationships with global leaders and implementation partners. Establish governance, enablement, quality controls, escalation paths, and shared accountability for consistent customer outcomes.
   

  

 Change leadership — Guide teams through evolving priorities, technology advancements, AI adoption, organizational change, and new delivery models while maintaining engagement, clarity, and execution discipline.
   

  

 How success will be measured
   

  

 Customer outcomes, adoption, value realization, and satisfaction
   

  

 Time to value, go\-live predictability, delivery quality, and risk reduction

title: Senior Patch Research Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
   

  

**About The Role**
 Qualys is looking for a detail\-oriented Windows Patch Management Catalog Researcher to join the Patch Management product team. In this role, you will be responsible for building and maintaining a comprehensive, accurate patch catalog covering a wide range of third\-party Windows software.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Patch Catalog Research \& Authoring


 Research, author, and maintain patch metadata for third\-party Windows applications across a broad software catalog.
   

  

 Identify new software releases, security updates, and version changes from vendor sources, changelogs, and security advisories (CVE/NVD).
   

  

 Map vendor releases to structured metadata schemas, including version strings, download URLs, detection logic, and installation parameters.
   

  

 Track software End\-of\-Life (EOL) dates and update catalog entries accordingly.
   

  

* Windows Patching \& Installation Knowledge


 Document and validate silent installation parameters for diverse installer types (MSI, NSIS EXE, InnoSetup, WiX, etc.).
   

  

 Research and verify correct msiexec.exe flags, NSIS /S switches, and equivalent silent/unattended arguments per software.
   

  

 Determine accurate reboot behavior (Yes / No / Maybe) per installer type and document exit codes (success, reboot\-required).
   

  

 Manually test patch installation in sandbox environments and verify detection logic post\-install.
   

  

* Detection Logic \& Registry Research


 Research and validate Windows registry keys used to detect installed software versions (Uninstall hive, vendor\-specific keys, DisplayVersion, etc.).
   

  

 Identify and document file\-based detection paths (FileVersion, ProductVersion attributes on key executables).
   

  

 Understand the difference between 32\-bit and 64\-bit registry views (WOW6432Node) and apply correct detection architecture per installer variant.
   

  

 Validate detection logic against fresh installs and upgrades across supported Windows versions.
   

  

* Backend Patch Tool Understanding


 Understand how enterprise patch management platforms (e.g., Qualys Patch Management, SCCM, Ivanti, Adaptiva) discover, deploy, and verify patches.
   

  

 Familiarity with how catalogs are consumed by patch engines — detection\-before\-install logic, supersedence evaluation, and deployment policy enforcement.
   

  

* Required Skills \& Qualifications


 4\-5 years of experience in Windows systems administration, patch management, or software packaging.
   

  

 Strong understanding of Windows OS internals — registry structure, file system, user vs. system installation scopes, environment variables, and PATH management.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with Windows patching tools (WSUS, SCCM/ConfigMgr, Ivanti, Qualys, Chocolatey, or equivalent).
   

  

 Experience with manual patch installation — running MSI/EXE installers, using msiexec.exe with switches, repackaging software.
   

  

 Solid understanding of installer technologies: MSI/WiX, NSIS, InnoSetup, Squirrel, and their silent install mechanisms.
   

  

 Familiarity with the Windows registry and the ability to trace installation artifacts to their registry keys.
   

  

* Nice to Have


 Experience building or maintaining a software patch catalog (Adaptiva, Chocolatey, ManageEngine, or similar).
   

  

 Experience with Windows Installer (MSI) internals — product codes, upgrade codes, component tables.
   

  

 Knowledge of ARM64 Windows platform nuances and multi\-architecture software distribution.
   

  

 Good understanding of Windows Update infrastructure (WUA, WSUS, CBS/SFC).
   

  

 Scripting experience in Python or PowerShell.

title: Content Planning & Execution
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an
 **AVP – Brand (Content Focused)** 
 to own the planning, production and execution of content across key consumer touchpoints.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, delivery\-oriented role for someone who knows how to take a content plan from brief to final output, coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders, and ensure a consistent volume of high\-quality content is shipped on time.
   

  

 The role will work closely with the growth team and leadership to translate the brand direction into content across social media, app, WhatsApp, packaging and other consumer\-facing channels. A significant part of the role will also involve managing shoots, creators, freelancers and external production partners.
   

  

 This is
 **not a traditional Creative Director role** 
 . While strong creative judgement is important, success in this position will be defined primarily by the ability to run a disciplined content engine and deliver consistently.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Content Planning \& Execution
   

  

* Own and manage the monthly content calendar across social media, app, WhatsApp, packaging and other relevant brand channels.
* Translate the content plan into clear briefs, timelines and deliverables for internal and external teams.
* Coordinate assets from briefing through production, review and final delivery.
* Ensure content is delivered consistently and within agreed timelines.
* Maintain visibility on work in progress, dependencies and upcoming content requirements.


 Content Production \& Vendor Management
   

  

* Manage a network of freelance editors, photographers, designers, production partners and shoot crews.
* Write clear creative and production briefs and ensure external partners understand the expected output.
* Review creative work and provide actionable feedback on quality, brand fit and execution.
* Manage production costs and work towards maintaining an efficient cost per asset without compromising output quality.
* Build a reliable production workflow capable of supporting a consistent volume of content.


 Shoots \& On\-Ground Production
   

  

* Own product, farm and factory\-related shoots end\-to\-end, including planning, coordination and execution.
* Work with photographers, videographers, production teams and relevant internal stakeholders to ensure shoots are completed as planned.
* Be comfortable being present on location and managing the practical requirements of content production.
* Ensure shoot outputs are translated efficiently into usable content across multiple formats and channels.


 Creator \& Influencer Operations
   

  

* Run the creator and influencer programme as a structured operating process.
* Source and evaluate relevant creators and influencers.
* Manage negotiations, briefs, timelines, deliverables and follow\-ups.
* Track output quality and ensure creator content is aligned with the broader brand direction.


 Growth Creative Support
   

  

* Work closely with the growth team to ensure a consistent weekly pipeline of creative assets.
* Understand creative performance data and use it to inform what types of content and formats should be produced next.
* Help increase the volume of relevant creative while maintaining brand and execution standards.


 Brand Consistency
   

  

* Maintain consistency in the brand's voice, visual identity and core consumer narrative across all content.
* Ensure the brand's farm\-to\-home trust story is represented consistently across touchpoints.
* Translate the leadership team's positioning and brand direction into day\-to\-day content execution.
* Review outgoing content for quality, consistency and adherence to the agreed brand direction.


 Candidate Profile
   

  

* 4\-7 years of experience in a brand, creative or D2C growth agency environment.
* Experience in account management, client servicing, brand solutions or a similar role involving ownership of content delivery.
* Demonstrated experience managing content calendars across multiple brands, campaigns or workstreams.
* Strong track record of coordinating production teams, freelancers and external creative partners against deadlines.
* Experience managing content from briefing through production, review and final delivery.
* Comfortable working directly with photographers, editors, designers, creators and shoot teams.
* Strong creative judgement with the ability to assess whether content meets the expected quality and brand standard.
* Highly execution\-oriented, organised and comfortable managing several content deliverables simultaneously.
* Comfortable working with performance data and using creative learnings to influence subsequent content production.
* Willing to take a hands\-on role in shoots and on\-ground content production.
* Pune\-based or willing to relocate to Pune.


**Preferred Experience**
* Exposure to food, dairy, wellness, FMCG or adjacent consumer categories.
* Experience working with D2C or digitally led consumer brands.
* Hands\-on ability to produce or edit content independently would be a strong advantage.
* Experience managing creator or influencer programmes as an ongoing operating process.


 What Success in This Role Looks Like
   

  

 Success in this role will come from building a dependable content operation: calendars are planned ahead, briefs are clear, production partners deliver on time, shoots run smoothly, creators are managed systematically, the growth team receives the creative volume it needs, and everything that reaches the consumer remains consistent with the brand's voice and positioning.

title: Payroll Specialist
description:
Why join us?
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity to join a global payroll function supporting approximately 4,000 colleagues across multiple locations. As a Payroll Specialist, you will play a key role in ensuring accurate, timely and compliant payroll processing while working closely with the Group Payroll Manager and wider payroll team.
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative HR environment where accuracy, service delivery, continuous improvement and stakeholder support are highly valued.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage the end\-to\-end processing of payrolls across multiple countries and jurisdictions.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date, and confidential payroll records.
* Complete payroll data entry, reconciliations, and audit checks to ensure accuracy and compliance. Respond to payroll\-related queries from employees and internal stakeholders in a timely and professional manner.
* Partner with HR and Finance teams to ensure employee data integrity and accurate payroll reporting.
* Support compliance with local statutory requirements and international payroll regulations.
* Assist with payroll audits and ensure adherence to internal controls and regulatory standards. Contribute to process improvements and payroll transformation initiatives to enhance efficiency and service delivery.
* Work collaboratively with the Global Payroll Manager and wider payroll team to ensure payrolls are processed accurately and on time.
* Deliver a high level of customer service and support to colleagues across the business.


 What will help you succeed in this role?
   

  

 To succeed in this role, you will ideally bring minimum
 **2 years of experience** 
 in a specialist payroll role, preferably within a professional services or multi\-jurisdictional environment. Strong numerical and analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to work accurately with confidential information will be important.
   

  

 You should be a confident communicator with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment. You will also be someone who manages time effectively, embraces change with a positive attitude, and works proactively and independently to support the team in delivering results.
   

  

 Familiarity with payroll software and systems, preferably ADP, would be beneficial but is not essential as training can be provided. A strong understanding of statutory regulations will also support success in this role.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 We offer the opportunity to be part of a global organisation with a supportive, inclusive and people\-focused culture. You will work within a collaborative payroll team, contribute to meaningful payroll operations across multiple locations, and have the opportunity to support continuous improvement within the function.
   

  

 We are committed to creating a positive experience for all colleagues and providing the necessary adjustments and support to help everyone perform at their best.

title: Workplace Specialist
description:
What You'll Do
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive
 **Workplace Specialist** 
 to join our Workplace team. The Workplace Specialist will lead the planning, execution, and monitoring of technical operations related to workplace infrastructure, ensuring optimal functionality, compliance, and safety. This includes oversight of HVAC, electrical systems, fire safety, preventive maintenance, and Emergency Response Team (ERT) management. The role is a full time in office and would be reporting directly to the Director, Workplace Asia, Middle East \& Africa
   

  

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
* Emergency Facility Repairs \& Breakdown Handling
* Lead coordination during critical infrastructure breakdowns and service disruptions.
* Mobilize internal and external resources to resolve facility emergencies promptly.
* Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
* Maintain a facility incident log for review, audits, and trend analysis.
* Preventive Maintenance (PPM) Management
* Plan, execute, and track preventive maintenance schedules for all workplace systems.
* Ensure all PPM records are updated, validated, and compliant with audit standards.
* Monitor vendor SLAs and maintenance quality metrics to ensure service excellence.
* Promote data\-driven maintenance practices to optimize asset performance and longevity.
* Workplace Infrastructure Assessments
* Conduct routine assessments of all workplace infrastructure including HVAC systems, electrical panels, fire safety equipment, and structural facilities.
* Evaluate the physical condition and performance of workplace assets to detect wear\-and\-tear, potential failures, or inefficiencies.
* Collaborate with vendor partners and internal stakeholders to ensure timely inspections, servicing, and reporting.
* Oversee the maintenance and operational condition of workplace furniture, including workstations, chairs, and ergonomic equipment, to prevent breakdowns or safety hazards.
* Coordinate with external vendors for repairs, replacements, or reconfiguration of furniture systems and seating to avoid user discomfort or injury.
* Ensure asset tagging, tracking, and inventory of movable infrastructure items is kept up to date.
* Document all assessments with detailed reports, action plans, and timelines for corrective or preventive measures.
* Provide recommendations to improve workplace functionality and employee safety based on audit findings.
* Regulatory Compliance \& Workplace Safety
* Ensure full compliance with local/national safety regulations (e.g., OSHA, NFPA, ASHRAE).
* Maintain and review technical and safety documentation for all workplace systems.
* Liaise with auditors and safety inspectors during regulatory inspections and audits.
* Lead efforts to close non\-compliance gaps with documented proof of resolution.
* HVAC, Electrical \& Fire Maintenance Oversight


**HVAC Systems**
* Oversee operations and scheduled maintenance of Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning systems.
* Ensure efficient airflow, appropriate climate control, and compliance with air quality standards.
* Monitor critical parameters like temperature, humidity, refrigerant pressure, and energy usage.


**Electrical Systems**
* Manage power distribution systems, UPS units, switchgear, and emergency generators.
* Ensure electrical load balancing, safe wiring practices, and redundancy in critical systems.
* Maintain electrical schematics and conduct periodic electrical safety checks.


**Fire Safety Systems**
* Administer testing, maintenance, and documentation of fire detection and suppression systems.
* Ensure availability of functional fire extinguishers, alarms, smoke detectors, and sprinklers.
* Collaborate with certified vendors for statutory fire equipment inspections and certifications.
* Emergency Response Team (ERT) Management
* Lead the formation, training, and readiness of the Emergency Response Team.
* Plan and conduct scheduled fire evacuation drills, mock emergency scenarios, and safety briefings.
* Develop ERT protocols aligned with company policies and local emergency guidelines.
* Ensure availability and maintenance of emergency equipment (first\-aid kits, stretchers, PA systems, etc.).
* Keep detailed records of all ERT activities, drills, incident responses, and post\-drill assessments.
* Drive compliance with workplace emergency response regulations and best practices.


 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Facilities Management, or a related field.
* 6\+ years of technical project management experience in corporate facilities or infrastructure.
* Proven expertise in HVAC, electrical, fire safety, and emergency systems.
* Solid understanding of workplace safety regulations and technical compliance frameworks.
* Strong communication, vendor management, and documentation capabilities.
* Familiarity with AI tools and technologies to drive smarter decision\-making, automate routine tasks, and enhance workplace operations efficiency.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Client Experience Executive
description:
Markup Club is a SEBI\-registered Research Analyst firm offering Model Portfolios and Bespoke trading strategies to subscribers who execute recommendations through their own connected broking accounts. This role exists to make sure every subscriber, especially a first\-time one, actually has a smooth experience getting their portfolio live, executing their first rebalance, and getting unstuck when something on the platform confuses them.
   

  

 This role owns proactive onboarding for every new subscriber, following up shortly after activation to guide them through accepting their first portfolio or pushing their first rebalance, rather than waiting for them to get stuck and write in. The goal is a smooth first experience, since this is often where a new subscriber's confidence in the platform is won or lost.
   

  

 This role also owns first\-line resolution of subscriber support queries received through email and the Zoho Desk ticketing system, covering payment and activation questions, rebalance and execution confusion, dashboard queries, and subscription or billing matters. Every reply should be accurate, warm, and written in a professional, clear tone, within the committed first\-response timeline.
   

  

 Ticket volume is modest on most days but spikes meaningfully around scheduled rebalances, particularly for Bespoke strategies, so this role needs to handle a quiet day and a high\-volume day equally well without either one suffering. Where a query turns out to be a genuine platform issue rather than a misunderstanding, this role coordinates with the technical team to get a root cause and follows up until it is resolved.
   

  

 A meaningful part of this role is proactive, not reactive. When a pattern of similar queries emerges across subscribers, the expectation is to recognise it, flag it, and either draft or update a knowledge base article covering it.
   

  

 This role also involves occasional subscriber calls where a written reply will not resolve the concern, particularly for a confused first\-time subscriber, a rebalance gone wrong, or an escalation, and is expected to de\-escalate calmly and represent Markup Club's tone and values on those calls.
   

  

**Requirements**
 As a mandatory requirement under SEBI regulations for Research Analyst firms, the selected candidate will be required to clear the NISM\-Series\-XXV\-A: Persons Associated with Research Services (Sales and Other Non\-Core Services) Certification Examination before joining. Candidates should also be comfortable working on\-site in Pune and be able to demonstrate strong written communication and problem\-solving skills through a practical screening assignment as part of the hiring process. Familiarity with a ticketing system such as Zoho Desk, or the willingness to learn it quickly, is expected.
   

  

 Prior trading or broking industry background is a good to have, not a requirement. What matters most is excellent written English, patience with non\-technical users, comfort on the phone, and the willingness to genuinely learn how the platform, brokers, and rebalancing mechanics work well enough to explain them simply. A basic understanding of SEBI regulations around Research Analysts, particularly around what language can and cannot be used regarding automated execution and investment advice, will be built on the job.
   

  

**Benefits**

title: SAP Data Migration and Data Integration Expert
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
 You work within Siemens Energy’s SAP S/4HANA environment, focusing on master data migration and integration. Your day combines hands\-on MDG migration execution with deep data analysis, mapping design, and business validation. You collaborate with data governance, integration, and business teams to ensure migrated master data is technically correct, deduplicated, and usable in end\-to\-end business processes.
   

  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Execute SAP MDG master data migrations (BP, Customer, Vendor, Material) within the S/4HANA environment.
* Define and implement data migration strategies, mapping rules, and transformation logic for legacy to S/4 conversion
* Perform data profiling, cleansing, enrichment, and deduplication activities aligned with business rules
* Design and execute ETL processes (Extraction, Transformation, Load) using SAP BODS, Snowflake, or similar tools.
* Build and run staging, reconciliation, and validation frameworks using Snowflake and advanced SQL.
* Manage large\-scale MDG mass processing / CMP loads, including error handling and reprocessing.
* Define and validate business mapping rules (e.g., bank, tax, sales areas, partner functions, roles) across segments
* Perform data reconciliation and migration testing (unit, SIT, mock loads, cutover) to ensure completeness and accuracy.
* Analyze and resolve MDG migration errors, data inconsistencies, and replication issues across integrated systems.
* Collaborate with business and governance stakeholders to ensure data usability, compliance, and process fit.
* Support cutover planning, migration sequencing, and go\-live readiness activities.
* Work with data governance, business, and integration teams to ensure end\-to\-end usability of data.


**What You Bring**
* 5–8 years of experience in SAP MDG functional processes and data model management.
* Strong understanding of SAP MDG data models, including Business Partner (BP), Material, Customer, Vendor, and the staging and active areas.
* Expertise across key master data domains, including:
+ Address and communication data
+ Bank and payment data
+ Tax structures
+ Business Partner roles and relationships
+ Identification objects

* Strong understanding of cross\-object dependencies and integration impacts, including BP ↔ Customer ↔ Vendor ↔ FI/SD/MM.
* Hands\-on experience with Snowflake and SQL for staging, reconciliation, and validation.
* Strong expertise with ETL tools such as SAP BODS and migration automation.
* Experience managing large\-volume datasets and optimizing performance for mass data loads.
* Ability to design and execute data quality checks, reconciliation reports, and error logs.
* Experience extracting and staging data from legacy systems such as SAP ECC and non\-SAP platforms.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot and resolve migration failures related to data inconsistencies, mapping issues, configuration gaps, and replication failures.
* Experience with log analysis including SAP BODS logs, MDG staging logs, and IDoc/DRF errors.
* Hands\-on experience with MDG mass processing, CMP loads, migration testing cycles, mock loads, data validation, and reconciliation.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks and business sign\-off processes.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, data stewards, and integration teams.


**Nice\-to\-Have**
* Experience with MDG key mapping and value mapping frameworks and integration patterns.
* Knowledge of BRF\+ for validations, derivations, and duplicate check tuning.
* Familiarity with MDG staging, extensibility, and governance workflows.
* Exposure to SAP migration tools and accelerators.
* Experience with cutover planning, migration sequencing, and hypercare support.

Join us as a Senior Application Support Analyst at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 You will be accountable for ILP (Mortgage Mainframe) , follow\-the\-sun mode with focus on exceling in service we provide to our colleagues and customers, you will be providing incident and problem management across the ILP.
   

  

 Meeting the Banks SLA for incident management, joining MIM calls and supporting 24 x 7 x 365 systems.
   

  

**To be successful as a Senior Application Support Analyst, you should have experience with:**
* Must have skill \# 1 Mainframe skills \- Cobol
* Must have skill \# 2 JCL, VSAM
* Must have skill \# 3 DB2
* Must have skill \# 4 CICS
* Flexible approach and ability to work under pressure.
* Communication and Collaboration: Ability to communicate effectively with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Documenting configurations, processes, and best practices for the team.
* Analytical and Problem\-Solving Skills: Strong analytical skills to address complex challenges \& effective trouble\-shooter towards production issues in Mainframe environments.
* A proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risks.
* Identify issues \& analysis: Must have understanding of Mainframe logs and understand of flow.
* System Maintenance: Regularly review system health and Batch jobs , Service first queues \- ensuring platform stability.
* On call support, 24\*7 available when he/she is on call
* Good to have knowledge on REXX tool.
* ITIL v3 certified
* Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution: Diagnosing and resolving system, application, and performance\-related issues.
* Providing technical support and collaborating with other IT teams to resolve issues promptly


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Nice to have skill \# 1 Good to have knowledge on REXX tool.
* Nice to have skill \# 2 ITIL v3 certified
* Nice to have skill \# 3 Service First Knowledge or Experience
* Work experience in incident and problem management /business analysis is strongly desired
* Good analytical investigation techniques.
* Own maintain and track incidents through their entire lifecycle, Strong Analytical Skills
* Flexible approach and ability to work under pressure.
* Provide 24/7 cover and support, providing expertise and specialized system knowledge to allow resolution of key incidents outside of business hours
* Hands\-on and should be able to work independently and if required guide
* Good written \& oral communication skills
* Ability to work under own initiative and handle pressure situations.
* Good time management skills
* Previous second line support experience.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role is based in Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To effectively monitor and maintain the bank’s critical technology infrastructure and resolve more complex technical issues, whilst minimising disruption to operations.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Provision of technical support for the service management function to resolve more complex issues for a specific client of group of clients. Develop the support model and service offering to improve the service to customers and stakeholders.
* Execution of preventative maintenance tasks on hardware and software and utilisation of monitoring tools/metrics to identify, prevent and address potential issues and ensure optimal performance.
* Maintenance of a knowledge base containing detailed documentation of resolved cases for future reference, self\-service opportunities and knowledge sharing.
* Analysis of system logs, error messages and user reports to identify the root causes of hardware, software and network issues, and providing a resolution to these issues by fixing or replacing faulty hardware components, reinstalling software, or applying configuration changes.
* Automation, monitoring enhancements, capacity management, resiliency, business continuity management, front office specific support and stakeholder management.
* Identification and remediation or raising, through appropriate process, of potential service impacting risks and issues.
* Proactively assess support activities implementing automations where appropriate to maintain stability and drive efficiency. Actively tune monitoring tools, thresholds, and alerting to ensure issues are known when they occur.


**Analyst Expectations**
* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in\-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub\-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Medical Coding Educator
company: Clinical Research Courses in Pune - TechnoBridge Systems Pvt Ltd
description:
**Company Description** 
 TechnoBridge Systems Pvt Ltd is a healthcare education provider offering online and offline courses in Clinical Research, Medical Coding, Pharmacovigilance, Medical Writing, Regulatory Affairs, and Clinical Data Management. With campuses in Pune and Bangalore, the organization focuses on preparing learners for employment through expert faculty, practical training, and modern facilities. TechnoBridge provides comprehensive placement assistance, including mock interviews and resume\-building support, to help learners transition smoothly into the healthcare industry. The company’s mission is to bridge the gap between learning and earning by equipping individuals with job\-ready skills and industry\-relevant knowledge.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Telesales Executive will work full time on\-site in the Pune District, engaging prospective learners and promoting TechnoBridge’s clinical research and healthcare\-related courses. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include making outbound calls, responding to inbound inquiries, explaining course details and benefits, and guiding potential students through the enrollment process. The role involves generating and qualifying leads, maintaining accurate records of interactions in the CRM, and following up with prospects to convert inquiries into admissions. The Telesales Executive will collaborate with the admissions and marketing teams, handle customer queries professionally, and meet or exceed individual and team sales targets.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills for clear, professional, and persuasive interactions over phone and email.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Customer Support skills to handle inquiries, resolve concerns, and ensure a positive experience for prospective learners.
* Candidates should possess Lead Generation and Sales skills to identify potential learners, nurture leads, and achieve enrollment targets.
* Relevant experience in telesales, inside sales, or educational counseling is beneficial.
* Ability to work with CRM tools, maintain accurate records, and follow structured calling processes is preferred.
* A minimum of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in any discipline is an advantage.
* Strong work ethic, willingness to learn about healthcare education programs, and readiness to work on\-site in Pune District.

title: Senior Infrastructure Analyst (Linux Administrator)
description:
**Job Purpose**
 Ensures availability and scalability of technology platforms in collaboration with internal and external teams to meet the current and future business needs in line with prescribed IT measures and ISAs adopted policies and procedures
   

  

 Key Result Responsibilities

 Strong automation experience using Ansible for configuration management and orchestration.

 Support and manage virtualization platforms including VMware, KVM, and Proxmox.
   

  

 Manage and support cloud infrastructure services including EC2 Instances, Load Balancers, VPC, S3, IAM, and DNS.
   

  

 Assist with cloud migrations, disaster recovery planning, and hybrid infrastructure design.
   

  

 Monitoring \& Logging
   

  

 Experience with enterprise monitoring and observability tools including Datadog.
   

  

 Hands\-on experience with metrics visualization using Grafana.
   

  

 Knowledge of time\-series monitoring using Prometheus.
   

  

 Experience implementing infrastructure and service monitoring using Zabbix.
   

  

 Exposure to application performance monitoring tools such as Dynatrace.
   

  

 Containerization \& Orchestration
   

  

 Proficiency with container technologies such as Docker and Podman in Linux environments.
   

  

 Operations \& Incident Management
   

  

 Act as Level 3 support for complex Linux, automation, and infrastructure\-related issues.
   

  

 Participate in incident handling, root cause analysis (RCA), and preventive action planning.
   

  

 Ensure SLA compliance and high availability for mission\-critical airline applications.
   

  

 Provide on\-call and shift support as per operational requirements.
   

  

 Key Result Responsibilities\-Continued
   

  

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**
 RHCSA / RHCE Linux certification is preferred.
   

  

 Cloud certifications such as AWS, OCI, Azure, or GCP are an added advantage.
   

  

 Fluent in English Language
   

  

 Work Experience
   

  

 8 to 10 years in IT Infrastructure design and management 24x7 critical operations preferably with Airlines
   

  

 IAC(Ansible, Terraform), Cloud experience (OCI/AWS/Azure), Load balancer(Nginix/HAProxy)
   

  

 Working experience in implementation of infrastructure projects solution designs and architecture
   

  

 Holistic IT Knowledge in heterogeneous technology environments experience with different types of end to end technology stacks
   

  

 Operations and management of technology platforms,both internally and externally hosted
   

  

 Hands on technical leadership technical solution design and architecture
   

  

 Proven skills in analyzing data identifying pitfalls and recommending cost effective solution
   

  

 Capable of conducting cost benefit analysis for IT investments
   

  

 Cost oriented possesses effective problem solving and decision making skills
   

  

 Employs technical expertise and interpersonal relations to execute new initiatives and achieve companys objectives
   

  

 Demonstrates the ability to contribute and successfully deliver against business strategy and set KPIs

**Global Managed Service – Identity and access Management – Staff**
 The Okta Operations Staff is responsible for the management and operational integrity of the Okta Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform within the organization. This role involves ensuring the secure and efficient operation of Okta services, including user lifecycle management, application integration, access policies, and multi\-factor authentication. The analyst will work closely with IT, security, and business teams to support and enhance the identity management infrastructure
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Provide L2 support for Okta\-related issues, including troubleshooting user access problems, application integration issues, and system outages.
* Assist with the management of user identities and organization groups within the Okta platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Participate in the integration of new applications into the Okta environment, working closely with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor Okta system performance and logs to proactively identify and address potential issues before they impact users.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of Okta policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices.
* Engage in regular security reviews and audits of Okta configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements.
* Support the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained.
* Assist in the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Okta, prioritizing based on impact and urgency.
* Keep abreast of new Okta features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform.
* Provide feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Okta service, including automation opportunities.
* Work with Okta support and third\-party vendors as needed to resolve complex issues and maintain system stability.


**Preferred Skills** 
 :
   

  

* Basic understanding of identity and access management concepts and Microsoft Entra services.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.
* Good problem\-solving abilities and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment
* Extensive experience in IAM operations, with a strong focus on Microsoft Entra and related Microsoft identity solutions.
* Knowledge of federation protocols – SAML, OAuth \& OpenID
* Understanding of IAM concepts, cloud security, and operational best practices.


**Education** 
 :
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Work Requirements** 
 :
   

  

* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Associate CASR
description:

Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 18,000 employees and has over 450 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment. Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
