title: People Service Specialist
description:
**About PX Operations**

 PX Operations is SKF’s global people experience engine — delivering precise, reliable, and human‑centered services that keep our organization moving. We ensure accurate pay, high‑quality data, efficient lifecycle services, and clear, timely support. As a globally connected team, we simplify processes, enhance experience, and help SKF create a better tomorrow for our people, our customers, and the industries we serve.
   

  





**PX Operations — Precision in Service. Better Tomorrow in Motion.**




**Job Description**




**Role Title:** 
 People Service Specialist
   

  





**Location:** 
 Pune, India
   

  





**Purpose of the Role**




 The People Service Specialist is responsible for managing end\-to\-end HR operations with a strong focus on onboarding, offboarding, employee lifecycle processes, and HR digitization. The role ensures a seamless employee experience, data accuracy and completeness, compliance, and effective stakeholder coordination.
   

  





**Responsibilities**




**Key Responsibilities – Onboarding and Employee Life Cycle management** 
  

  





* 
+ Manage end\-to\-end New Hire Joining and Onboarding process
+ Handle pre\-employment medical check\-ups and documentation
+ Manage Background Verification (BGV) for all new hires
+ Conduct HR orientation sessions covering policies, systems and company overview
+ Oversee first two days of the induction plan
+ Process joining expenses, daycare and nanny allowance claims
+ Arrange factory visits for new hires at Pune and Bangalore locations
+ Manage end to end employee life cycle process including transfers etc.
+ Responsible for maintaining complete and accurate salary master data and share inputs with payroll
+ Work hands\-on with SuccessFactors HRMS for onboarding and employee life cycle activities
+ Manage employee queries with strong focus on employee experience
+ Work with cross functional teams for any process or systems enhancements.






**Key Responsibilities – Offboarding** 
  

  





* 
+ Manage end\-to\-end offboarding process for employees
+ Design, update, and manage exit clearance forms
+ Share exit process guidelines with employees
+ Issue relieving letters and exit\-related documents
+ Maintain master exit tracker for data and recoveries
+ Capture actual reasons for exit for analysis
+ Share exit data with Compensation and Benefits team
+ Ensure timely termination of GADD and system IDs
+ Process Full and Final settlements accurately and on time in coordination with payroll team






**Other Responsibilities** 
  

  





* 
+ Create and maintain PAN India holiday calendar starting October
+ Publish Company Intranet announcements for new joiners and role changes
+ Support internal and external HR audits, HR Compliances
+ Issue internship and contract letters for consultants
+ Review and update employee policies on Spider Intranet platform
+ Act as SPOC for centralized HR data requirements
+ Drive Process improvements \& HR digitization initiatives
+ Manage and enhance HR Chatbot adoption and effectiveness






**Requirements / Qualifications** 
  

  





* 
+ MBA in Human Resources Management
+ 4–6 years of experience in HR Operations, Employee Data and systems management or similar role
+ Hands\-on experience with HRIS platforms such as SuccessFactors, Workday and Darwinbox
+ Strong understanding of HR policies and compliance
+ Excellent communication, problem\-solving, customer and interpersonal skills
+ Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
+ Ability to work with minimal supervision
+ High attention to detail and data accuracy
+ Proven experience in onboarding, end to end employee life cycle and offboarding processes






**Benefits** 
  

  





* 
+ Opportunity to work with most valued global brand
+ Competitive salary package
+ Health insurance and other employee benefits
+ Opportunities for professional development and growth
+ Collaborative and supportive work environment






**Why join PX Operations?**




 You will be part of a team that powers the engine of SKF — ensuring every core people process runs smoothly so the organization can focus on innovation, performance, and growth. Here, you’ll help shape a better tomorrow while building a global career with purpose.
   

  





**About SKF**




 SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Manager, Benefits & Leave Administration Transformation & Process Optimization (GBSC People & Capability)
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Manager, Benefits \& Leave Administration Transformation \& Process Optimization (GBSC People \& Capability)
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere, by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.
   

  

 Who is GBSC?
   

  

 The Global Business Solutions Center (GBSC) is a powerhouse of innovation and strategic partnership inside of Mastercard that combines operational excellence with a vision for what’s next. More than a service provider; it is a collaborative force that delivers impactful outcomes. Anchored in strong, reliable operations, the GBSC brings to life bold ideas that empower teams across Finance, Legal, People \& Capability, Sales, Marketing, and Product.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Manager, Benefits \& Leave Administration Process Design \& Optimization Lead is responsible for designing, optimizing, and continuously improving global benefits and leave administration processes to ensure they are standardized, compliant, employee centric, and digitally enabled across countries.
   

  

 This role applies leading practice process architecture, documentation, governance enablement frameworks, and optimization initiatives across the end to end benefits lifecycle—including benefit eligibility, enrollment, life event changes, ongoing administration, vendor interactions, employee communications, reporting, and post event activities—while partnering closely with regional Benefits teams, Technology, Risk, and external providers.
   

  

 The role enables consistent benefits outcomes and improved employee experiences by defining scalable process standards, controls, and metrics that support Mastercard’s broader modernization and automation agenda, while execution accountability remains with regional and in country Benefits teams.
   

  

 Success in this role requires working in close alignment with Benefits leadership to translate strategic direction into executable, scalable, and continuously improving process outcomes.
   

  

 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Partner with Benefits and Leave Administration leadership to support global benefits process design and optimization efforts, contributing insights, analysis, and structured frameworks that inform the evolution of future state process standards across the benefits lifecycle.
* Enable and support the development, alignment, and use of benefits process flows and documentation by partnering with Benefits, Leave Administration, and related teams, to ensure artifacts are clear, practical, and reflective of agreed upon operating models; support consistent understanding and execution across regions while accounting for local regulatory, plan design, and business requirements.
* Manage the Benefits and Leave Administration Transformation portfolio, including intake, prioritization, transformation roadmap, and work sequencing.
* Provide structured analysis and recommendations to Benefits leadership on global versus localized benefits approaches, helping articulate global standards and permissible country level variation; assess process variation and present fact based insights to support leadership decision making.
* Act as a process design lead and trusted advisor for benefits related changes, system enhancements, vendor transitions, country implementations, and operating model evolution—translating business needs into tangible, prioritized process requirements aligned to Benefits strategy.
* Partner with Product \& Engineering to simplify, automate, and optimize benefits processes and data flows, ensuring designs align to Workday Benefits capabilities and third party provider integrations.
* Support enhancement testing by providing relevant use cases and executing user testing to validate optimized process designs are viable, system enabled, and fit for purpose.
* Leverage benefits and leave administration process performance metrics to identify trends, prioritize optimization opportunities, and track continuous improvement over time.
* Support cross functional and vendor process alignment by partnering with P\&C, Legal, Tax, Risk \& Compliance, and benefits providers to promote service quality, regulatory adherence, data privacy, security, and operational efficiency.
* Assess benefits process impacts of policy changes, acquisitions, technology advancements, workforce changes, and regulatory developments; support impact analysis, documentation updates, and stakeholder communications.


 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
   

  

**Qualifications \& Leadership Profile**
* 7\+ years of experience in global benefits and leave administration, benefits and/or leave administration process design, or shared services environments, with strong knowledge of multi country benefits programs, regulatory requirements, and operational controls.
* Demonstrated experience designing, standardizing, and enabling end to end processes within complex, matrixed, global organizations—ideally within a Global Business Services, consulting, or transformation led model.
* Strong working knowledge of HR and benefits technology/vendor ecosystems (for example, Workday Benefits and third party administrators), including process enablement for automation and workflow tools.
* Proven understanding of audit requirements, regulatory reviews, and risk management expectations, with the ability to translate control needs into practical, scalable process design.
* Advanced analytical and problem solving skills, with the ability to balance precision, scalability, and employee experience in regulated environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority across regions, functions, and leadership levels.
* Enterprise first mindset with clear accountability for process integrity, quality, and continuous improvement, paired with a calm, structured, and pragmatic decision making approach.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Description**

 For more than 25 years, Fortune 100 organizations, government agencies, and large enterprises have trusted Forescout as their foundation to manage cyber risk, ensure compliance, and mitigate threats. You will need a solid understanding of Forescout products and basic knowledge of the environments in which they are deployed. You will take ownership of assigned projects and support configurations to address and resolve customer issues. Competencies essential to your success in this role include customer service, problem\-solving, organization, time management, combined with agility of learning and technical aptitude, and operating Forescout solutions in real\-world customer environments. * Interface with Forescout Support and/or R\&D to resolve issues that may impede success.

**What You Will Bring To Forescout**

* Hands\-on experience in both Windows and Linux, Mac OSX platforms, with a solid understanding of networking principles and security best practices
* Computer Networking Systems Administrator level knowledge of all protocol layers
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking environments
* Industry Certifications such as CASP\+, Security\+, CEH, CCNA, SANS (GCIA, GCIH, GREM, GPEN) is a plus.
* Advanced Administrator’s level of understanding of Operating Systems (Linux, Windows, Macintosh, and UNIX) is a plus.
* Experience installing, implementing, and debugging network access control security solutions is a plus.
* Desired skills: VMware \-vSphere, Microsoft Hyper\-V, and PGSQL
* Understanding of programming languages: C, Java, Bash, and Python is a plus
* Minimum 3 years of experience with network hardware configuration.
* 3 years of significant experience with Windows\-based operating systems and Unix systems, specifically Linux.
* Expertise in deploying large\-scale enterprise deployments/data centers.
* Experience deploying and/or supporting enterprise security software products such as firewalls, IPS, Anti\-Virus solutions, application firewalls, high availability solutions, network management systems, and virtual systems.
* Experience implementing complicated software products that involve multiple components.
* Experience in working and troubleshooting in heterogeneous environments.
* Ability to clearly document complicated steps and procedures.
* Working knowledge of shell, Perl, and XML scripting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong customer orientation, good organizational skills, self\-driven with the ability to multi\-task on various projects, and aptitude to learn new technologies.
* Knowledge/experience utilizing Salesforce.com or similar CRM tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and experience working in demanding and challenging environments.
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
* ForeScout Certified Administrator (FSCA) and/or ForeScout Certified Engineer (FSCE) within the first year of employment.
* A self\-motivated individual with a ‘can do’ attitude.


**What Forescout Offers You**
 Managing cyber risk, together – We are led by a visionary leadership team who encourages professional growth and development. We promote a diverse and inclusive culture providing for a collaborative and innovative environment where our team can make an impact on worldwide security while working on technology which is at the forefront of the industry. We are also proud of our competitive compensation and benefits offered. If you have a strong work ethic, are visible and lean in, you will be recognised. We are in growth mode and there is a ton of opportunity at Forescout. Apply now to find out more!
   

  

**Our Mission**
 To continuously identify, protect, and ensure the compliance of all cyber assets across the modern organisation.
   

  

**Our Vision**
 A world where every cyber asset is seen, secure and compliant.
   

  

**Our Core Values**
* One Team – We all work together, and we all win together.
* Cyber Obsessed – We are curious about technology, and we are innovative and passionate about solving big programs.
* Customer Driven – We listen, we learn, and we make it right.
* Relentless – We're smart, determined, and find a way. We figure stuff out.
* Collaborative, without Ego – No one succeeds alone. We strive to be the humble person that people want to work with.


**Thank you for taking the time to learn more about us.
   

  

 If this opportunity intrigues you, we would love for you to apply!**
**Pre\-Employment Screening and Verification**
 At Forescout, we are “Cyber Obsessed”. As a global cybersecurity company, we are committed to maintaining a secure environment for our customers, employees, and business operations. To support these efforts, candidates may be asked to complete job\-related pre\-employment screening and verification processes, to the extent permitted by applicable law. Depending on the role and location, these measures may include identity verification, employment verification, background screening, work authorization verification, and other lawful security\-related checks. Forescout conducts these processes in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, including privacy and data protection requirements, and obtains any required notices, authorizations, or consents before conducting such screenings.
   

  

**Notice Regarding the Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment**
 As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence ("AI") or automated decision\-support tools to review applications, assess job\-related qualifications, match candidates to role requirements, and coordinate interviews. These tools support, but do not replace, the judgment of qualified recruiters and hiring managers, who remain involved throughout the process. We use AI responsibly and in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal governance standards.
   

  

**Note to Employment Agencies**
 We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Forescout does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies.  Submissions made without a signed Employment Placement Agreement and an authorized search engagement for the specific position through our Talent Acquisition team will be considered unsolicited, and no placement fee will be paid.
   

  

 Forescout Technologies is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We value and embrace diversity, equality, inclusion, and collaboration at the core of our “One Team” philosophy. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

* Develop and execute BiofuelCircle's brand and communication strategy aligned with business strategy, growth priorities and brand positioning.
* Translate business and customer insights into communication strategies, campaign briefs and narratives.
* Develop communication frameworks for different stakeholder groups including industrial buyers, suppliers, farmers, partners, policymakers, employees and ecosystem stakeholders. ·
* Ensure consistency of brand voice, tone, visual identity and messaging across all customer and stakeholder touchpoints.
* Act as the custodian of the BiofuelCircle brand and ensure every communication strengthens the desired brand perception.



  





**Corporate Storytelling \& Thought Leadership** 



* Develop BiofuelCircle's overarching corporate narrative and storytelling platform.
* Identify and build compelling stories around innovation, digital platform capabilities, technology, supply\-chain transformation, rural ecosystem impact, customer success, sustainability impact, business growth and industry leadership.
* Identify opportunities for leadership participation in industry forums, conferences, panels, podcasts, interviews and digital platforms.
* Establish BiofuelCircle as a credible voice on bioenergy, biomass, circular economy, decarbonization and digital transformation of the bio\-carbon supply chain.



  





**Product Positioning \& Marketing Communication** 



* Develop clear, differentiated and compelling positioning for BiofuelCircle's products, solutions and business offerings.
* Translate complex platform capabilities, technology and operational solutions into simple, customer\-centric narratives.
* Partner with Product, E\-Commerce, Business and Marketing teams on Go\-to\-Market strategy and product launches.
* Lead integrated brand campaigns across digital, social, PR, events, trade media, industry platforms and relevant offline channels.



  





**Media Relations \& PR** 



* Lead day\-to\-day media relations and develop press releases, media pitches, press kits, Q\&As, backgrounders and media briefs.
* Proactively identify opportunities for earned media and editorial storytelling.
* Support issues and crisis communication, including rapid response coordination and development of appropriate communication.



  





**Digital \& Social Communications** 



* Own the strategic direction and content narrative for BiofuelCircle's external digital presence.
* Manage and strengthen corporate social media channels in partnership with the digital/content team.



  





**Content \& Storytelling** 



* Develop high\-quality external content including corporate stories, blogs, articles, whitepapers, case studies, website content, press releases, leadership articles, social media content, videos and event narratives.
* Build a strong repository of customer, supplier, farmer, partner and ecosystem stories.



  





**Internal Alignment \& Employer Brand** 



* Partner with HR and leadership to develop employee advocacy and leadership communication programs where relevant.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen BiofuelCircle's reputation as an employer in climate\-tech, digital platforms and the bioenergy ecosystem.



  





**Agency \& Partner Management** 



* Manage PR, creative, content, digital and other communication agencies.
* Manage communication budgets and optimize external agency investments.



  





**Measurement \& Brand Intelligence** 



* Track metrics such as brand awareness, share of voice, media quality and reach, sentiment, leadership visibility, digital engagement, campaign effectiveness, content performance and thought\-leadership impact.
* Go beyond activity reporting to identify what communication is changing in the market and how it is contributing to business outcomes.



  





**Opportunity:** 



* Work with a fast\-growing company in the bio\-energy sector.
* Collaborate with a dynamic and motivated cross\- functional team of sales, customer success, operations, and product development



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile:** 



* 8–10 years of experience in Brand, Corporate Communications, PR, Marketing Communications or Integrated Communications.
* Experience in a B2B, technology, industrial, energy, climate\-tech, infrastructure or digital\-platform environment is preferred.
* Strong strategic thinking and business understanding
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Strong storytelling and narrative\-building ability
* Ability to simplify complex technical/business concepts
* Strong media and PR skills
* Campaign strategy and execution
* Thought\-leadership development
* Digital and social media understanding \& Stakeholder management
* Data\-driven decision making
* Agency management
* Presentation and influencing skills
* Ability to operate comfortably with senior leadership and cross functions

title: Growth Associate (EA to CEO)
description:
**Role Overview**
 This is not a typical Executive Assistant role where you manage calendars and book meeting rooms. As a Growth Associate, your primary focus will be on business development, partnerships, outreach, and operational coordination. You will work directly with the CEO to help open new revenue streams and ensure that day to day operations run smoothly across the organisation.
   

  

 Think of this role as a mix of business development, operations management, and team coordination, all rolled into one. You will be handling partner outreach, corporate client engagement, campaign execution, event logistics, media coordination, and team task management. The CEO will rely on you to independently drive these areas forward so that the company's growth never slows down because of a lack of bandwidth.
   

  

 If you are someone who enjoys taking ownership, talking to new people, managing multiple workstreams, and seeing your work directly impact the business, this is the role for you.
   

  

**Who Should Apply?**
 This role is a great fit for you if you enjoy talking to new people and building professional relationships. You should be comfortable writing emails, making calls, and following up persistently until things get done. If you can manage multiple tasks at the same time without dropping any, this role will suit you well.
   

  

 It is ideal for someone who likes working in a fast paced, small team environment where your work directly impacts the business. You should be comfortable using cloud tools and AI tools like ChatGPT, ClaudeAI, Genspark, and other to get things done faster. If you want a role where no two days look the same and you get to be involved in everything from partnerships to team management, this is the one.
   

  

**Key Responsibility Areas**
* Partnership and Collaboration Outreach A significant part of your role will involve identifying and reaching out to potential partners across the financial ecosystem. This includes financial advisors, influencers, platforms, and media houses. You will be responsible for drafting outreach emails, following up systematically, maintaining a partnership pipeline, and scheduling calls between the CEO and interested parties. The goal is to take a partnership from the first point of contact all the way to closure.
* Corporate Client Development You will research and identify companies that could benefit from our financial wellness offerings. This involves finding the right decision makers within organisations, preparing pitch materials, booking presentations for the CEO, and handling all follow up after meetings. You will manage the entire cycle from initial outreach to final onboarding.
* Campaign Management You will own and manage outreach campaigns end to end. This includes maintaining contact databases, scheduling and coordinating virtual sessions, sending invitations and reminders, tracking attendance, following up with participants, and managing referral pipelines. The expectation is that you can run a campaign independently without the CEO needing to step in at every stage.
* Event and Webinar Logistics Whenever the company hosts webinars, orientations, or live events, you will handle the complete logistics. This covers registration management, attendee communication, calendar coordination, reminders, post event follow ups, and reporting. You will also work with the marketing team to make sure the scheduling and promotion run smoothly.
* Office and Task Management You will act as the office manager for the team. This means setting up and managing project management tools, creating task lists, assigning deadlines, following up on pending items, and preparing weekly completion reports for the CEO. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks and every team member delivers on time. You will also evaluate team performance and flag any bottlenecks.
* PR and Media Relations You will support the company's public relations efforts by drafting press releases, preparing media pitches, and reaching out to relevant financial publications. This also includes coordinating interviews, managing media budgets when allocated, and tracking all coverage and mentions.
* Day to Day Coordination Beyond the structured responsibilities, you will handle miscellaneous coordination across the team and with external parties as needed. This includes follow ups, scheduling, and any coordination that requires someone to connect multiple people or parties. This part of the role is dynamic and driven by the CEO's daily priorities.


**How a Typical Week Looks Like For This Position**
 At the start of the week, you will review the task board, check what is pending from the previous week, and plan your priorities. Monday typically involves a pipeline review where you assess where each partnership and outreach effort stands and decide what needs immediate attention.
   

  

 Through the middle of the week, you will be focused on execution. This means sending outreach emails, following up with people who have not responded, coordinating meetings and presentations for the CEO, working on campaign logistics, and updating project trackers. If there is an upcoming event or webinar, this is when the bulk of the coordination happens.
   

  

 Towards the end of the week, you will shift to tracking and reporting. You will update the CRM, check on the team's task completion status, prepare the weekly report for the CEO, and flag anything that needs attention going into the next week. If there are media or PR tasks, you will use this time to draft pitches or follow up with publications.
   

  

 Throughout the week, there will always be ad hoc tasks and coordination requests from the CEO that require quick turnaround. Flexibility and the ability to switch between tasks smoothly is key.
   

  

**Requirements**
**Must Have Skills**
* Strong communication skills are essential. You should be able to write clear emails, pitch messages, and follow up notes on your own without needing someone to review everything.
* You need to be outgoing and confident. This role involves reaching out to people you have never spoken to before, whether they are potential partners, corporate decision makers, or media contacts. Being hesitant or shy will hold you back.
* Being organised and detail oriented is critical. You will be managing multiple campaigns, pipelines, and task lists at the same time, and nothing should slip.
* You should be a team player with the ability to lead when needed. Part of your job is tracking the team's progress, making sure deadlines are met, and flagging issues before they become problems.
* You must be comfortable with technology and willing to learn new tools quickly. Using AI tools like ChatGPT, Genspark, ClaudeAI to speed up your work (drafting emails, doing research, creating content) is expected, not optional.
* Finally, you need to be proactive and self driven. If something needs to be done, you do it. You should not need to be reminded to follow up or close the loop on tasks.


**Tools You Will Use Daily**
 Zoho Suite (Zoho Projects, Zoho CRM, Zoho Recruit) for project management, client tracking, and recruitment coordination. Google Workspace (Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Calendar, Google Drive) for day to day communication and collaboration. Zoom for scheduling and coordinating virtual meetings and webinars. ChatGPT and other AI tools for drafting emails, research, and content support. Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) especially for pitch decks and proposals. Social media platforms like LinkedIn and X for outreach and PR coordination.
   

  

**Benefits**
**What Does Success Look Like in This Role?**
* You are succeeding in this role when the outreach pipeline is always moving forward. New contacts are being added, follow ups are happening on time, and conversations are progressing towards outcomes.
* Success means that presentations and meetings are being booked regularly and executed well, with all preparation and follow up handled without the CEO needing to get involved in the logistics.
* Campaigns and events run smoothly from start to finish. Registrations, communication, and post event follow ups happen like clockwork because you own the process completely.
* The team's tasks are tracked, deadlines are being met, and the weekly report is always ready on time. When something is stuck, you have already flagged it and proposed a solution.
* The CEO's bandwidth is freed up because you are handling operations, outreach, and coordination independently. The less the CEO has to remind you or step in, the better you are doing.
* Media and PR efforts are building momentum over time, with increasing coverage and visibility for the company.


**Compensation And Benefits**
* Annual CTC: Between ₹3\.5 LPA to ₹4\.2 LPA (depending on experience and fit)
* Incentive Bonus: This position is entitled to a performance based incentive bonus. The structure and details will be shared at the time of joining.
